descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Team


The Product Merchandising organization connects members to our world of entertainment by creating a Netflix experience that is engaging, relevant, and truly delightful for everyone, everywhere. Blending intuitive discovery and local expertise, the team positions, promotes, and presents content so members find it easy and enjoyable to choose what they'll love.

Within this organization, the Content Experience Innovation (CEI) team of Product Managers is leading the strategy to shape how Netflix members discover and engage with emerging content. This includes areas like Games discovery, Live & Sports streaming events, Podcasts, and much more. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes features and experiences across discovery/browse, player, profiles, and new surfaces.

The Role

We're hiring a Product Manager, Emerging Formats to join the CEI team. You'll lead the evolution of discovery and engagement experiences for emerging content types as Netflix's offering grows.

You'll set the vision and shape discovery experiences, partnering with cross-functional teams on features and capabilities that delight members. You'll turn those concepts into a well-scoped roadmap, prioritize among competing efforts, and help the team deliver its best work.

As Netflix expands beyond film and series, you'll work across the PM community so the member experience for new formats fits into the bigger picture, alongside Live, Games, Podcasts and more.

You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Tech, Content, and Production, and act as the connective tissue that keeps our product surface in step with our content strategy. Your mission is to define the product strategy, member needs, roadmap, and experimentation approach that let diverse content types thrive on one unified platform. You'll bring curiosity and a collaborative approach to translating Emerging Formats and CEI goals into product strategy.


You'll thrive at the hub of a fast-moving environment, working daily with experts across the tech and entertainment sides of the business and balancing requirements and tradeoffs along the way. You're passionate about building alignment, and you can keep momentum and move forward amid ambiguity, even when full consensus isn't possible.


What You'll Do


As Product Manager, Emerging Formats, you'll be the strategic lead for emerging content types on Netflix:

  • Work through open-ended problems and identify opportunities to evolve existing experiences or define new discovery, capability, or feature requirements
  • Build a roadmap and take product concepts from idea through validation, shipping, measurement, and iteration
  • Author strategy memos and presentations that represent your team's work, so the broader organization understands the Emerging Formats product strategy and roadmap
  • Proactively seek diverse viewpoints to keep our focus on the most strategic and impactful work in Emerging Formats
  • Influence and align a team of talented colleagues across design, engineering, consumer insights, merchandising, and data science to deliver outstanding products
  • Build business cases and measure the impact of your product innovation with your data science partners
  • Deeply understand and socialize the evolving needs of our members with your consumer insights and design partners

What You'll Bring


As Product Manager, Emerging Formats, you're passionate about the work and bring:

  • 7+ years of experience developing consumer products and features, and comfort operating with complex tradeoffs
  • Experience owning the product development lifecycle end to end, from inception through planning to launch
  • Demonstrated leadership of a space, working effectively across organizations to drive alignment
  • Experience with A/B testing and strong business acumen, including identifying, tracking, and acting on metrics, designing tests, and collaborating with data science partners
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to connect the smallest experience elements to company and team goals
  • Data-informed judgment, and the ability to use data to tell the right story, not the other way around
  • A balance of collaboration and openness to alternative views with clear, timely decision-making and communication of vision
  • An eagerness to seek feedback and improve

Nice to have:

  • Responsibility & Autonomy: We believe in transparency and empower our employees with the autonomy to innovate. Our unique Netflix culture is a cornerstone of how we drive innovation.
  • Creative Freedom: Enjoy the freedom to tackle interesting challenges and influence outcomes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Collaborative Excellence: Work alongside intelligent, driven individuals who are passionate about solving complex problems together and who support each other in doing their best work.

Location of Work


The Product Merchandising organization embraces flexibility with regard to location of work, with most folks working remotely. This US-based role has flexibility from West to East coasts, with the understanding that key collaborators are primarily based in our California offices (Los Angeles and Los Gatos). We therefore expect availability during California working hours. Remote team members will need to travel to the California offices for key meetings as needed and for occasional team gatherings.

title: Associate Technical Supervisor (Back-End) - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Vancouver, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

The Opportunity:

As an Associate Technical Supervisor at Netflix Animation Studios, you’ll help support the technical vision on an animated feature film by working in close partnership with the Technical Supervisor, Solutions Engineering and creative leadership. You’ll contribute to shaping and evolving the pipeline tools, and workflows to meet the show’s unique creative and technical challenges, ensuring solutions that serve both the artists and align with studio standards. 

Focused on the technical success of Fx, Lighting and Compositing on the show, your primary focus will be supporting the creative and visual objectives by providing day-to-day technical oversight for pipeline troubleshooting, user support, direction and tool development.

The Associate Technical Supervisor (Back End) oversees the technical direction and support for the later stages of the production pipeline.  This includes departments and workflows such as:

  • Lighting

  • Rendering

  • Compositing

  • Imaging

  • Final Output/Delivery

  • Simulation/FX (if not covered by another Associate Tech Sup)

  • Pipeline integration and troubleshooting for these stages

The Back End Associate Tech Sup ensures that all technical processes, tools, and workflows in these areas are running smoothly, meet the show’s creative and technical requirements, and integrate well with the rest of the pipeline. They also provide hands-on technical leadership to TDs in these departments, support artists with technical challenges, and collaborate with the Technical Supervisor and other Associate Tech Sups to maintain consistency and quality across the entire production.

What You’ll Do:


Technical Responsibilities

title: Media Systems Engineering - L4 Media Systems Engineer
locations: London, United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About Media Systems Engineering

Media Systems Engineering helps filmmakers bring their vision to life, through the design and support of all technical workstations, image & sound equipment, and playback systems currently in use across all Netflix creative spaces. That includes screening rooms, post-production suites, QC environments, audio facilities, and specialty creative spaces that power content creation from capture through delivery. You will work at the intersection of creative intent and technical excellence, partnering closely with the Global Media Systems Engineering team to spearhead new technology deployments across the corporate and studio portfolio.


Role Overview

Netflix is seeking a Full-Time Media Systems Engineer to join our Global Media Systems Engineering team. In this role, you will serve as an EMEA based team member of a globally aligned Engineering organization—ensuring that Netflix’s creative and technical spaces operate reliably, consistently, and to the highest industry standards. You will also have a direct impact on the development and implementation of Netflix internal system design standards alongside your peer group of engineers.


This role requires strong technical depth, effective execution in high-priority situations, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively with the broader team.

Responsibilities:


Technical System Design 


Serve as a subject matter expert and technical authority in image, sound, and integrated system design across Netflix’s global portfolio of specialty creative spaces.


Maintain a deep understanding of industry standards, emerging technologies, and best practices across room types, including audio mix facilities, post-production environments, and review spaces leveraging both projection and emissive display technologies.


Bring strong fluency in audio formats, playback standards, and end-to-end media workflows, with the ability to translate creative and technical requirements into clear system designs and project-level specifications.


Act as a key partner to construction teams, architects, and subcontractors to inform technical requirements, including:

  • Acoustic standards (e.g., NC ratings, isolation)
  • Room geometry, sightlines, and viewing conditions
  • Functional Room Orientation & layouts aligned to production and post-production workflows

Ensure design intent is upheld from concept through delivery, maintaining alignment between engineering standards, creative needs, and real-world implementation.


Contribute directly to the evolution of Media Systems Engineering standards, bringing informed perspectives on new technologies, workflows, and design approaches, supporting continuous improvement and consistency across the global portfolio.


Technical Support & Infrastructure


  • Maintain and troubleshoot complex audio, video, and networking systems across post-production facilities, theatrical screening rooms, QC environments, and creative spaces.
  • Perform routine and emergency audio and video calibrations to ensure compliance with Netflix, theatrical, and broadcast standards.
  • Partner with internal network engineering teams to troubleshoot high-performance media and corporate networks, ensuring reliable A/V transport, data flow, and remote access.
  • Support post-production pipelines and video encoding workflows, enabling creative teams to deliver world-class content without friction.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


  • Partner closely with the global Media Systems Engineering team across all regions to ensure consistent tooling, behaviors, and support standards worldwide.
  • Create and maintain clear documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and troubleshooting guides, keeping them current as systems evolve.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve system reliability, operational efficiency, and the overall support experience.
  • Operate autonomously within your region while maintaining transparency through documentation, reporting, and global syncs.

Core Values


  • Sound, professional judgment in high-visibility and time-sensitive situations with creative stakeholders.
  • Strong customer service instincts and the ability to translate complex technical issues for non-technical audiences.
  • Accountability for project delivery, system reliability, and measurable outcomes.
  • Effective collaboration across cultures, time zones, and technical disciplines.
  • Strategic problem-solving that balances immediate resolutions with long-term architectural improvements.

Core Qualifications


  • 7 or more years of experience supporting post-production, studio, or creative technology infrastructure
  • Proven technical background in designing, calibrating, or troubleshooting professional audio, video, and integrated systems
  • Solid understanding of network infrastructure and media transport, including the OSI model, IP networking (VLANs, subnets), and routing
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across post-production hardware, operating systems, and media workflows
  • Effective communication skills across written technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration
  • Ability to manage regional projects independently while maintaining close alignment with global engineering teams

Preferred Qualifications


  • Direct experience with cinema infrastructure, including theatrical calibration, DCI-compliant systems, and cinema audio standards (e.g., Dolby Atmos, SMPTE)
  • Experience supporting live production systems, digital audio consoles (e.g., Avid S6), KVM systems, or communications infrastructure
  • Practical familiarity with Audiovisual over IP (AVoIP) protocols (such as Dante, AES67, ST 2110, or NDI)
  • Experience troubleshooting post-production creative software (e.g., Avid Media Composer, Adobe Creative Cloud, DaVinci Resolve, Pro Tools, Transkoder)
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous technical learning and adopting emerging studio technologies

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About the Team

Ads Data Engineering is at the core of building a data ecosystem that powers Netflix's understanding and decision-making about the impact of ads on our business. This team builds rich, connected, and easily accessible data products spanning ad inventory, forecasting, targeting, ad serving, pacing, and more. This role will lead the Ads Signals & Measurement team across three core areas:

  • Conversion & Attribution: Building the data and attribution capabilities that connect advertising exposure to outcomes, powering conversion measurement and ML-based optimization.

  • Measurement Data Foundations: Building the data foundations that power our first-party measurement solutions across the full funnel, including incrementality, lift, experimentation, and third-party measurement studies.

  • Audience Onboarding & Identity: Enabling audience onboarding, identity resolution, and rich signal generation to power audience and targeting solutions.

Horizontally, the team connects these areas through a data flywheel where signals, identity, measurement, attribution, and optimization continuously reinforce one another. This role sits at the intersection of these domains, ensuring they come together as a cohesive data ecosystem that powers both measurement and performance optimization. We're looking for a Staff Data Engineer to help set the technical bar and lead teams across these domains.

Who are you?

  • A seasoned technologist with 12+ years building data-foundation, backend, or data engineering systems, someone other engineers naturally look to for direction.

  • You've spent real time in advertising or ad-tech data, specifically in domains like Ads identity graph, measurement, targeting, and while your depth may run deepest in one domain, you're comfortable moving across several.

  • You've built trust and driven technical direction across organizational lines, not just within your own team, and you've done it in more than one company or role.

  • You take data privacy and governance seriously, not as a checkbox, but as something you've actually built for.

  • You're a clear, thoughtful communicator who can translate technical nuance for engineers and business context for leaders, often in the same conversation.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity, and just as comfortable helping a room of smart, opinionated engineers land on a shared answer.

  • You genuinely enjoy helping other engineers grow, and see that as just as core to the job as your own technical output.

What will you do?

  • Set technical direction and design coherence across the various orgs, connecting the dots between domains rather than optimizing just one.

  • Weigh in on and help resolve cross-domain design decisions, helping teams converge on approaches that scale across the org, not just within a single team.

  • Mentor and coach data engineers, helping them grow technically and adopt AI and emerging tools and technologies.

  • Build strong partnerships with senior engineers on our data platform and D&I teams, contributing to and shaping horizontal and platform-wide efforts.

What (ideally) do you know?

  • Modern data stacks end-to-end: ingestion, processing, storage, and serving.

  • Ad-tech systems and data flows, ideally with direct exposure to at least 2 domains across measurement, attribution, identity , audience, targeting 

  • Large-scale distributed data systems such as Spark, Kafka, or columnar stores.

  • The latest in AI and agentic technologies as they apply to data engineering.

  • A graduate degree in Computer Science with a data focus is a plus, as is experience formally mentoring engineers on their technical growth.

Netflix is seeking an experienced and inspiring Senior Manager of Production to lead our Korea Production Management team, overseeing series, film, and nonfiction productions.

  • Stay abreast of industry trends and integrate best practices into daily production operations

title: Software Engineer Rendering - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Vancouver, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:

Are you a Software Engineer interested in joining our core R&D group to develop and enhance our proprietary rendering software (Glimpse); including our state-of-the-art rendering engine, shading system, and scene representation? If the answer is yes, then read on!

For more information on Glimpse

What You’ll Do:

  • Work on all aspects of the renderer, including scene representation, render and sampling engine, raytracer, shading system: everything required for generating highly realistic images for our films.

  • Create and maintain tools that are directly used in our lighting, shading, and compositing workflows.

  • Closely collaborate with technically minded artists to design, implement and rapidly deploy into production.

  • Be part of a small, dynamic and self-motivated team of individuals with varied backgrounds.

  • Take on responsibility, get stuff done, and make our artists happy!

  • Collaborate with grace, humility, inclusion, and open-mindedness.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years’ experience developing 3D rendering software using C++ in high performance computing environments.

  • Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • Have a background in film, animation, television, visualization, games, or come fresh out of academia with a strong focus on computer graphics.

  • Strong mathematical skills and familiarity with numerical methods, probability and statistics used for rendering such as Monte Carlo integration and importance sampling

  • A talent and passion for optimisation and a working knowledge of efficient spatial data structures.

  • A thorough understanding of photorealistic rendering, light transport and global illumination techniques.

  • A passion for algorithms, optimization, and data structures.

  • Working knowledge of shading technologies such as RSL, OSL, GLSL

  • An ability to work in a challenging environment, take direction and possess good communication skills.

  • Willingness to work in a highly dynamic production environment and collaborate with artistic staff.

  • Real-time rendering experience.

  • Exposure to raytracing and shading technologies such as Embree and OIIO/OpenPGL/RSL/OSL/GLSL.

  • Experience with developing shading or raytracing algorithms on massively parallel architectures such as multi-threaded CPUs and GPUs.

  • Practice in writing high performance code, vectorized code, with a good understanding of parallel programming, compilers and optimization.

  • Familiarity with DCC applications such as Houdini and Maya, including their APIs.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and e-social communication skills.

This role is based in Vancouver, British Columbia. Hybrid Role (Minimum of 3 days a week in the office).

We rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, location, skills, and experience.  The overall market range for this role is typically $124,000 - $179,000 CAD.  This reflects total compensation; we do not have stock options.

title: Video Algorithms Intern, Video Coding (Gaussian Splatting), Fall 2026
locations: Los Gatos, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Role

Gaussian Splatting (GS) is a 3D/4D scene reconstruction technique that enables photorealistic novel-view synthesis with low rendering complexity, making it attractive for deployment on consumer devices such as TVs, streaming sticks, phones, and laptops. Realizing this vision requires addressing several open technical challenges, such as a significant reduction in model training/encoding time and more efficient compression. As part of the Video Algorithms team during this 24-week Fall internship, you will help us investigate the potential of GS as a future streaming format and explore possible improvements, with a focus on building towards a practical system.

During the internship, you will:

  • Explore GS model compression strategies using open datasets

  • Contribute to early thinking on additional dataset needs for representative scenes.

  • Characterize trade-offs among GS model size, training time, and rendered quality, and quantify the gap relative to streaming-rate targets

  • Identify and experiment with strategies to reduce training/encoding time and/or to improve GS compression efficiency

  • Design and implement a proof-of-concept (PoC) that showcases GS-based rendering on content of interest

Who Are You?

  • Currently pursuing a PhD in a technical field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or Statistics,  with an expected graduation date in June 2027 or later.

  • Thrives working in complex, dynamic, and fast-moving environments. 

  • Strong software development skills and feels comfortable with software engineering best practices (e.g., version control, testing, code review, etc.).

  • Successful track record in research of 3D/4D scene reconstruction, novel-view synthesis, Gaussian Splatting or NeRF, differentiable rendering, neural graphics, or 3D computer vision.

  • Solid understanding of machine learning and deep learning concepts, with hands-on experience training and evaluating ML models.

  • Able to program fluently in Python 

Nice to Have: 

  • Familiarity with real-time rendering and GPU programming (CUDA, WebGL, graphics pipelines).

  • Background in video compression, streaming systems, or codec standards such as HEVC and AV1.

descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

At Netflix, we are shaping the future of entertainment by rethinking how the world discovers and experiences stories. As the industry evolves—from on-demand viewing to live events, new formats, and diversified monetization—understanding audiences deeply and connecting that understanding to decisions has never been more critical.


In Japan—one of Netflix’s most important and distinctive markets globally—this requires more than market knowledge. It demands a nuanced understanding of local audiences, creative communities, and cultural dynamics, and the ability to turn that into clear strategic direction for the business.


About this role
In this role, you will lead Consumer Insights (CI) for Japan, informing both the direction of the business and execution of key projects across Content (anime, live action, unscripted, live/sports) and increasingly Commerce and Product. You will help shape how Netflix identifies and creates “must-watch” moments, and how those moments drive audience growth and engagement.


This is a senior Consumer Insights leadership role in the market. The expectation is to operate as a strategic thinking partner to senior leaders—shaping how consumer understanding informs decisions, alongside delivering high-quality research.
You will own the end-to-end leadership of a thoughtfully constructed portfolio of work—ranging from high-impact strategic initiatives to more immediate business needs—based on what will drive the most value for the Japan business. This includes defining the right questions, driving research and synthesis, and ensuring insights land in decision-making forums with clear implications and actions.
The bar is on clarity of thinking, depth of insight, and business impact—rather than simply volume of output. A core part of the role is exercising strong judgment in shaping the right portfolio of work: balancing immediate business needs with longer-term, higher-impact opportunities, and making deliberate prioritization calls where needed.
Success in this role requires a deep and instinctive understanding of Japan—its audiences, media habits, and creative ecosystem—as well as the judgment to connect local nuance to broader strategic implications. Experience in entertainment, media, or advertising research is highly valuable, given the close connection between consumer insight and creative decision-making in this space.

Contextual Fit

  • Over 10 years of significant experience living and working in Japan in a senior research / insights capacity

  • Native fluency Japanese and Business fluent in English

  • Comfortable operating within Netflix’s culture of high ownership, candor, and autonomy

  • Defines the most important consumer questions for the market and proactively identifies where insights can drive impact

End-to-End Consumer Insight Initiative Leadership

  • Proven track record of leading end-to-end Consumer Insight initiatives, including both strategic projects and high-impact business-driven work:

  • problem framing

  • stakeholder alignment

  • research design and execution

  • synthesis and landing insights into decisions

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity across cross-functional teams

Insight Craft & Synthesis

  • Strong ability to turn consumer understanding into clear, compelling insights and recommendations that shape strategy

  • Able to move beyond individual studies when needed, synthesizing across signals, titles, and data sources into forward-looking narratives

  • Deep expertise in primary research (qualitative and quantitative), with strong judgment on when and how to apply each

  • Solid grounding in secondary data and business metrics to contextualize findings

Operating Model & Ways of Working

  • Operates effectively in a lean, high-impact environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Designs work around business priorities and decisions, not just research outputs

  • Exercises strong autonomy while staying closely connected to regional and global context

  • Leverages GenAI tools pragmatically to enhance research, synthesis, and stakeholder communication

  • Represents Japan within APAC Consumer Insights and the global Data & Insights organization, proactively bringing Japan perspectives into regional and global discussions to inform broader strategy

  • Mentors and develops the Japan team, providing clear direction, feedback, and coaching to the researcher to ensure strong delivery and continued capability growth


Essential Qualifications

  • Proven experience operating in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional, and globally distributed organization

locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix’s Infrastructure Engineering organization provides the backbone that powers Netflix's global scale and operations across business verticals. Within this organization, Data, AI & Experimentation Platforms accelerate product velocity and business impact by providing cohesive, reliable foundations for data, analytics, machine learning, and experimentation. We reduce friction across the insight-to-production loop so teams can move from questions to decisions and from prototypes to shipped features quickly, with confidence, and with measurable outcomes.

We enable teams to build and scale ML-powered products end-to-end with AI platform capabilities for training, model management, evaluation, observability, developer tooling, and production inference. Our experimentation platform makes it easy to design, launch, monitor, and interpret experiments so teams can iterate faster and validate impact with statistical rigor and accountability.

Our data and analytics foundations make information usable and trustworthy: streamlined data movement (ingestion, streaming, processing), standardized online data stores for real-time serving, and analytics experiences that accelerate discovery while enforcing consistent metrics, quality, lineage, ownership, and access controls. Ultimately, we make data- and AI-driven product development faster, safer, and more dependable at scale so teams can focus on building great experiences that entertain the world.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly technical Product Manager to lead Data Developer & Analytics Experiences within the Analytics Platform & Experiences team.

Your primary mission is to deliver a unified, AI-native experience that spans how practitioners build data assets, build and operate data agents, and orchestrate data workflows at scale. On the Data Developer side, you will own the practitioner “inner loop”; SQL and Python-first code authoring in AI-native IDEs (Cursor, Claude Code, JupyterLab), Python libraries, lifecycle and CLI tooling, data quality tooling, and the developer experience for building data agents that can securely discover, query, and act on data. On the Workflow Orchestration side, you will own the end-to-end experience for defining, scheduling, executing, monitoring, and operating data workflows, including dependency management, backfills, retries, and workflow observability—making it easy for practitioners to reliably move data pipelines and agents from development to production.

Analytics engineers, data engineers, and data scientists will be your primary customers, with a focus on making it easier for them to build data assets, orchestrate reliable workflows, and develop data agents. Partnering closely with engineering, design, and data leaders, you will shape product direction and deliver impactful capabilities across developer productivity, workflow orchestration, data quality and observability, and AI-native development.

In this role, you will shape the future of Data Developer Experiences and Workflow Orchestration at Netflix by leading a high-impact product portfolio. You will operate with significant autonomy to set strategic direction, define multi-year roadmaps, and make high-leverage tradeoffs across developer productivity, workflow orchestration, reliability and observability, data quality, and AI-native development—including how practitioners build and operate data agents.

What makes this role exciting is the blend of strategic vision and hands-on leadership. You'll maintain a broad portfolio view while selectively diving deep where your expertise makes the biggest difference. Your success will be measured by enabling Netflix's growth, innovation, and competitive advantage, while delighting users with exceptional experiences that empower teams to work more efficiently and with greater satisfaction.

What You Will Do

As the Product Manager for Analytics Experiences, you will have the following responsibilities:

  • Set Direction: Develop a compelling long-term vision and strategy for your portfolio, aligning user needs with business objectives and industry trends for the Analytics Experiences.

  • Champion Users: Build deep user understanding and empathy through regular engagement, research, and feedback loops to identify pain points and opportunities.

  • Manage Roadmap: Develop and prioritize initiatives across the portfolio, from IDE-centric inner-loop productivity to centralize Semantic layer and conversational analytics, balancing immediate needs with strategic evolution.

  • Guide Development: Partner with design and engineering to define requirements, create intuitive interfaces, and validate solutions that ensure cohesive user journeys across the platform ecosystem. 

  • Support Architecture: Partner with engineering on critical architecture decisions that ensure platform sustainability, scalability, and flexibility while strategically managing technical debt.

  • Drive Adoption: Create effective rollout strategies and promote new capabilities through targeted communication, education, and roadshows, while providing comprehensive documentation, learning resources, and self-service tools that accelerate adoption and reduce support burden.

  • Drive Improvement: Define success metrics centered on user delight and productivity gains, and implement tracking to continuously improve platform capabilities through data-informed experiments.

  • Establish Governance: Develop platform standards and processes that balance flexibility with standardization and innovation with stability to maintain quality and consistency, including API design guidelines, versioning policies, and deprecation protocols.

  • Align Stakeholders: Build strategic relationships and foster cross-functional collaboration to drive alignment and create shared ownership of outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

We value candidates who can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, technical depth with user empathy, and decisive leadership with collaborative partnership. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity, can navigate complex technical and organizational landscapes, and ultimately delivers significant impact for your users and Netflix as a whole.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following attributes and experiences:

Technical Excellence

  • Expertise: 8+ years of Technical Product Management experience (or equivalent technical role) in complex technical domains. Comfortable discussing technical design trade-offs and system quality attributes with engineering teams.

  • Domain Knowledge: Strong knowledge of modern analytics architectures and data developer tooling — including dbt-based transformation workflows, workflow orchestration and scheduling, and deep familiarity with the practitioner stack: IDEs and notebooks (Cursor, JupyterLab, VS Code), Python/SQL developer tooling, interactive compute environments, and data quality/observability frameworks.

  • Curiosity: Demonstrated passion for Analytics with a pulse on emerging trends. Actively seeks new perspectives and brings fresh thinking to technical challenges. Regularly uses products and observes customers to identify improvement opportunities.

Product Leadership

  • Strategic Vision: Proven track record of managing product portfolios in complex technical domains with clear vision and strategy to maximize portfolio impact. Skilled at connecting business objectives with user needs, balancing quick wins with strategic bets, and making thoughtful trade-offs.

  • Customer Obsession: Deeply understands user needs through continuous engagement. Exceptional at identifying and articulating clear problem statements. Develops innovative solutions with strong product intuition and taste, thinking holistically about end-to-end user experience.

  • Business Acumen: Understands how platform investments drive business outcomes. Articulates the ROI of technical investments in business terms and connects platform capabilities to Netflix's strategic priorities. Balances technical excellence with business pragmatism.

  • Data Driven: Deeply analytical mindset that leverages quantitative and qualitative data to understand user behavior, validate assumptions, and inform product decisions. Builds a metrics-driven culture with clear success metrics to measure impact and drive continuous improvement.

  • Decisive Leadership: Makes timely decisions that provide clear direction and reduce ambiguity without analysis paralysis. Shows conviction in product opinions while remaining open to new information. Removes decision bottlenecks and shields teams from unnecessary scope creep.

Collaboration & Influence

  • First Team Player: Creates psychological safety through vulnerability and assuming best intent. Values diverse perspectives and operates with a collaborative mindset where team success trumps individual accomplishments. Skilled at giving and receiving feedback with a growth mindset.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Builds strong relationships across organizational boundaries based on mutual respect and shared goals. Navigates complex organizational dynamics to drive alignment. Adapts communication style to different audiences and contexts to maximize effectiveness.

  • Influential Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence and inspire. Great at rallying teams around a vision and motivating others to action.

Execution Excellence

  • Delivery Focus: Builds reputation through consistent, high-quality delivery. Disciplined prioritization with clear timelines and accountability. Drives initiatives to completion rather than letting them linger. Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and adjusting course as needed.

  • Learning Mindset: Champions incremental learning and fast feedback loops with customers. Values progress over perfection and breaks down large initiatives into manageable increments that deliver value at each stage. Adapts quickly based on real-world user feedback.

descriptionHtml:

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering teams build advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state of the art content delivery, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers, while ensuring brand safety during serving.


Ads policies are the foundational guidelines that govern what ads can be shown, where they can run, and under what conditions on the Netflix platform. Policies ensure that every ad campaign complies with both local regulations and Netflix standards, by defining rules related to restricted categories, maturity levels, and brand restrictions. The Ads Policy Infrastructure team is responsible for building the platform-level components required to manage Netflix policies and ensure their enforcement across the entire ads ecosystem, including creative review, campaign setup, targeting, serving, Live, and reporting.


The Role

As a Software Engineer on Ads Policy Infrastructure, you will help build the systems that define, govern, evaluate, and explain advertising policy across Netflix's ads ecosystem. You will own components end to end - from the policy service and its APIs to parts of the Ad Connect authoring experience - with support from senior engineers as you grow into full-stack ownership.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys turning ambiguous policy needs into working software. You will contribute to design discussions, deliver production code, and learn the domain alongside partners in Policy, Product, Operations, and consumer engineering teams.


What You'll Do

  • Build and operate services and APIs (JVM services, GraphQL, gRPC) that compile authored policy into execution objects and serve policy decisions to consumer systems.
  • Build parts of the Ad Connect Policy module (React and TypeScript) so policy authors can create, inspect, and safely change rules, exceptions, and overrides.
  • Contribute to the migration of line-item and Live Manifest policy rules, using shadow evaluation, parity reporting, and rollback criteria to keep enforcement correct at every step.
  • Improve observability and operability of what you build: reason codes, decision traces, blocked-demand metrics, tests, dashboards, and alerts. Participate in on-call for the services your team owns.

Skills & Experience We're Seeking

  • Production software engineering experience building services or user-facing applications, ideally on the JVM or with React and TypeScript, and a demonstrated desire to grow across the stack.
  • Solid fundamentals in API design, data modeling, and schema evolution, including an understanding of versioning and backward compatibility.
  • Comfort working with ambiguity: this is a new team building a new product, so requirements and boundaries evolve. You make progress without a predetermined solution and revise your decisions as the team learns.
  • An operational mindset: testing, monitoring, tracing, and ownership of the services you ship.
  • Strong collaboration and communication, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, and operations partners.
  • Ownership and drive: you follow a feature from design through deployment, operations, and improvement.

descriptionHtml:

The Core Assets Technical Director supports creative and visual objectives by owning the pipeline troubleshooting, tool development, and artist support for Modelling, Rigging, and Surfacing of Characters and Environments. This role requires a solid technical understanding of these craft groups to design tools, troubleshoot workflows, and enable high-quality, standardized technical outcomes in partnership with Solutions Engineering and R&D.

What You’ll Do:

  • Understand the visual requirements for productions and suggest new technologies, or design procedures, techniques, and tools that will enable these to be met.

  • Lead the technical direction, evolution, and maintenance of core technology and workflows for Modelling, Rigging, and Surfacing.

  • Design, develop, and write well-maintainable and consistently high-quality code.

  • Track, debug and resolve workflow issues in partnership with Lead TDs, Technical Supervisors, Associate Technical Supervisors, Solutions Engineers and R&D.

  • Work closely with other TD’s on your team to drive the technical success of key development initiatives.

  • Ensure that technology, tools, and procedures support the creative process.

  • Provide solutions to visual problems through existing tools or by leading the implementation of new tools.

  • Take responsibility for the troubleshooting & optimization of tools, software, and workflows.

  • Actively participate in or drive QA, technical testing, and validation of new technology, tool releases, or pipeline changes, such that artist workflow is not impacted.

  • Understand the processes of adjoining departments, provide input where required to maximise pipeline efficiency and quality.

  • Actively participate in brainstorming and problem-solving, contributing technical expertise and insight, to create and maintain technology within the canonical production pipeline.

  • Support the organisation’s overall technical goals as required.

  • Be aware of the deadlines for development initiatives and actively engage in keeping these on track.

  • Continuously monitor the scope of development initiatives and help to ensure scope adjustments have additional estimates, etc.

  • Prioritise and break down technical projects into organised parts.

  • Provide technical guidance to other TDs and TAs, where appropriate, with day-to-day issues and escalation through the right channels when necessary.

  • Mentor more junior team members and assist in orientation with new starters.

  • Create synergies between different work groups to promote efficiency and optimization and to generate innovative ideas and approaches to how we do things.

What You’ll Need:

Experience:

  • 5+ years of proven pipeline TD experience in large-scale animated features, animated TV series, the gaming industry, and/or VFX feature films.

  • Solid production/industry experience as a TD.

Skills/Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of OpenUSD and its architecture like composition and Hydra.

  • Comprehensive experience using and troubleshooting in Maya and Houdini, as well as their respective APIs.

  • Good development skills and understanding of department workflows and technology across Modelling, Rigging or Surfacing.

  • Ability to review code and troubleshoot problems as they arise.

  • Familiarity with Asset Management Systems and associated processes like asset publishing and validation.

  • Solid Python expertise, including PyQt or PySide.

  • Knowledge of concepts like data flow, data dependencies, metadata, publishing, and retrieval.

  • Understanding of C++ is a plus.

  • Knowledge of Flow Production Tracking (shotgrid) is a plus.

  • Knowledge of code management software such as git and github and code review processes.

title: Senior Manager, Change Management & Technology Enablement - Finance PMO
locations: Los Gatos, California, United States of America
Los Angeles, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

In this newly created, high-impact role within our Finance Program Management Office (PMO), you will serve as the architect and champion of change management across our portfolio of Finance transformation programs. This includes defining how the Finance PMO approaches change - establishing frameworks, standards, and toolkits that become the backbone of every project we run - and cultivating a small, high-performing team of change professionals, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous development.

As a visible, strategic partner to program managers, business stakeholders, and Finance leadership, you will translate complex transformations into clear, human-centered adoption experiences that stick. The role is accountable for the full change journey - from stakeholder analysis and impact assessment to training, readiness validation, and go-live sustainment - and leverages strong Finance process expertise to understand and manage impacts on Finance teams and the wider organization.

The position operates at both the strategic level (designing frameworks, advising leadership) and the tactical level (building detailed comms plans, running workshops, tracking adoption metrics, etc.). You understand that technology only delivers value when people actually use it - and you make that happen.

This is a hybrid position that can be based in either Los Angeles or Los Gatos and offers the flexibility to work remotely part-time. Occasional travel may be required to other office locations, including internationally.

Responsibilities

Change Management Practice & Framework

  • Define and own the Finance PMO change management methodology - establishing a scalable, repeatable framework (tools, templates, and standards) that elevates the consistency and quality of change delivery across all PMO-led programs.

  • Develop and maintain a library of reusable change management artifacts: stakeholder analysis templates, change impact assessment frameworks, communication plan structures, readiness survey toolkits, RACI models, and training design guides.

  • Act as the internal expert and coach on change management best practices; build change capability across the PMO team and broader Finance organization so that change management becomes a core competency, not a one-off activity.

  • Benchmark against industry frameworks (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter, McKinsey Influence Model) and adapt them pragmatically to Netflix's culture and operating model.

Portfolio Change Management

  • Provide holistic change management strategies across the Finance PMO project portfolio - ensuring that change impacts are assessed, sequenced, and managed at the portfolio level, not just the individual project level.

  • Lead change management on significant, high-visibility PMO initiatives from end to end: scope change impact assessments, develop and execute communication plans, manage stakeholder engagement, design and oversee training programs, and conduct readiness assessments prior to go-live.

  • Proactively identify change saturation risks across the portfolio - flagging moments when concurrent programs may overwhelm stakeholder groups - and recommend sequencing or pacing adjustments to protect adoption outcomes.

  • Partner closely with Finance PMO Senior Program Managers and Program Managers to integrate change management activities into project plans, ensuring change is never treated as an afterthought.

  • Manage and track change management deliverables across the portfolio; provide regular reporting on change health, adoption progress, and stakeholder sentiment to PMO leadership.

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, develop, and retain a team of direct reports; set clear performance expectations, provide consistent coaching, and conduct formal performance management with transparency and care.

  • Build a culture of high standards - holding the team to rigorous craft while creating the psychological safety needed for iteration and growth.

  • Manage team capacity across the portfolio; make deliberate prioritization calls when demand exceeds bandwidth and escalate tradeoffs clearly to PMO leadership.

  • Build change management capability across the broader Finance PMO — coaching program managers and business partners to embed change thinking into their work, extending the team's reach without extending headcount.

Stakeholder Experience & Communications

  • Build strong relationships with Finance stakeholders to gain deep understanding and awareness of their unique needs.

  • Design stakeholder engagement strategies that go beyond information sharing — creating experiences that build genuine understanding, confidence, and commitment to change.

  • Develop executive-ready communications, leadership roadmaps, and briefing materials that equip sponsors and Finance leaders to actively champion change.

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and we are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

  • Core Accounts: We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

  • Account Intelligence: We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality. 

  • Account Cohort and Verification Automation: Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

  • Spend Attribution: We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • 7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

  • 4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

  • Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

  • Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

  • Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

  • Familiarity with Object/Entity lifecycle management and data governance associated with it.

  • Operational excellence experience with customer-facing APIs, including SLO tracking, incident management, and observability tooling, 

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Nice to haves:

  • Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g  VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML/genAI techniques and an ability to apply them to the account management lifecycle or API reliability monitoring.

  • Early experience with customer-facing MCP concerns, such as defining tools contracts,  security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration), and integration with other AI agents.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

title: Distributed Systems Engineer 6 - Ad Eventing

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched our ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building a world-class, in-house ad tech ecosystem. Ad Eventing is the backbone of that ecosystem — the high-throughput, low-latency pipeline that captures, validates, deduplicates, and processes every ad impression, click, and completion event at Netflix scale. The accuracy and reliability of this data directly powers billing, reporting, pacing, and optimization across the entire ads platform.

Our Team

The Ad Eventing team sits within the Ad Serving & Decisioning org at Netflix Ads. We own the systems that ingest and process billions of ad events per day — from client-side beacons fired during playback to server-side signals from our ad server. Our work spans real-time event ingestion, deduplication and validation, stream processing pipelines, and the authoritative data contracts that downstream systems (billing, reporting, pacing, ML) depend on. We operate at the intersection of reliability engineering, data infrastructure, and ads domain expertise.

We are looking for a senior technical leader to own the technical direction of this pod, set the architectural bar, and drive execution on the hardest problems in event processing at Netflix scale. This is a 60% builder / 40% influencer role: you will write code, ship a proof-of-concept in your first weeks, and earn the trust of an opinionated senior team while simultaneously setting direction across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical direction of the Ad Eventing team: architecture reviews, incident leadership, capacity planning, and scaling

  • Architect and evolve the end-to-end ad event pipeline — from client beacon receipt through validation, deduplication, enrichment, and downstream fan-out — under strict latency and throughput constraints

  • Scale our event ingestion infrastructure to handle billions of events per day with high availability, exactly-once semantics, and sub-second processing SLAs

  • Design and implement robust deduplication and validation systems  that ensure event accuracy across retries, network failures, and client-side inconsistencies

  • Built and operated event deduplication, validation, and attribution systems in an ads or similarly high-stakes data environment

  • Strong understanding of exactly-once and at-least-once delivery semantics, idempotency patterns, and the tradeoffs between them

  • Experience designing event schemas and data contracts that serve multiple downstream consumers with different latency and consistency requirements

  • Familiarity with ad measurement concepts: impression tracking, viewability, click attribution, completion rates, and IAB standards

  • Comfortable at the intersection of engineering, data, and product — translating advertiser reporting requirements and billing accuracy needs into production systems

title: Software Engineer 5 – Agent Platform, AI Platform
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence powers innovation in all areas of the business, from helping members choose through personalization, to making payment processing easier. Building highly scalable and differentiated ML infrastructure is key to accelerating this innovation.


The Opportunity

Agents are one of the ways work gets done at Netflix — and the AI Platform is building the foundation they run on. The Agent Platform team owns the durable, horizontal substrate every agent at Netflix is built on, no matter which team ships it or which business it serves: the runtime agents execute in, the SDK developers build them with, the memory that lets them carry context across runs, the identity and permissioning that lets them act safely, and the tool and service interfaces they reach the rest of Netflix through.

We are a small team with outsized leverage — what we ship becomes the foundation for agents across all of Netflix. The hardest problems we work on have no vendor answer and no textbook: how a non-deterministic system earns trust at member scale and how memory and evaluation become a loop that makes agents measurably better, not just bigger.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who wants to build that foundation hands-on — to own a core primitive end-to-end and set its technical direction, in a domain that is still being invented and where the frameworks turn over in months. The defining work is judgment about what to build and what actually moves the business — expressed in code and contracts the rest of the company depends on.


You will:

  • Design, build, and operate a core agent primitive end-to-end — the runtime, the developer SDK, the memory layer, the tool and service interfaces, or the identity and permissioning substrate. You own it as a paved path other Netflix engineers ship production agents on, including the reliability and day-2 operations that non-deterministic systems running at very high — sometimes member-facing — scale demand.
  • Build the loop that lets agents improve from their own experience. Capture each run's full reasoning-and-tool-call trajectory as structured, replayable data; turn real-world outcomes into evaluation signal; make memory compound across runs; and close the feedback loop so improved behavior ships behind eval gates and safe rollout. These are the most durable problems in the space — make them first-class platform capabilities with real contracts, not afterthoughts.
  • Build the quality and safety surfaces teams can't ship agents without — the tracing, quality signals, and guardrail hooks that tell a team whether an agent is actually any good and contain non-deterministic behavior before it reaches production.
  • Aim the hard problems at business impact. A pull toward hard technical problems is the baseline here — the differentiator is aiming it at the ones that move Netflix's business, from personalization and content to payments and the member experience. Know where an agent actually changes a member or business outcome, and let that decide what the platform takes on and in what order.
  • Set technical direction and raise the bar. Make the hard architecture calls in your area, drive cross-team technical initiatives with ML scientists, product managers, and security, compute, and data partners, and define the clean interfaces a shared foundation depends on — leading through technical credibility, not authority.
  • Iterate fast with real users. Ship, learn from how agent developers actually build, and turn that into durable platform capabilities rather than one-off fixes.

If you want the distance between "a frontier idea about how agents should work" and "the substrate every agent at Netflix runs on" to be one team, this is the role.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Significant software engineering experience (typically 8+ years), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems — not just prototypes.
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating LLM agents in production — systems that plan, call tools, observe results, and iterate — beyond chat-completion apps or demos.
  • Experience evaluating agents the rigorous way: building eval suites, tracing, and quality signals, then iterating on the results to make agents measurably better.
  • Strong fundamentals in designing and operating scalable, observable, fault-tolerant distributed systems.
  • A track record of building SDKs, APIs, or libraries that other engineers build on — you think in contracts, versioning, and developer experience, not just features.
  • Working fluency with modern agent frameworks and the tool/function-calling and MCP patterns they share — deep enough to have an opinion about where they help and where they get in the way.
  • Proficiency in Python and its packaging tooling, plus one of Java, Go, C/C++, Rust, or Zig.
  • A track record of choosing what to build by business impact, not technical interest alone — you partner closely with the teams and stakeholders you serve, and can point to outcomes that moved the business, not just systems you shipped.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfort with ambiguity; able to drive both 0-to-1 and 1-to-100 work; effective across a distributed (US) team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building memory or state systems for agents — context that compounds across runs — especially at high scale.
  • Experience with the emerging class of agent concerns: agent identity and permissioning, guardrails and safety, and cost governance for LLM and agent workloads.
  • Credibility in a relevant open-source ecosystem (agent frameworks, runtimes, evaluation, or developer tooling).
  • Familiarity with our stack — Temporal, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes — and with large-scale build, release, CI/CD, and observability practices.

descriptionHtml:

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Team Overview

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world with a diverse set of content offerings and a world-class product experience that connects the right content with our members. Our team plays a crucial role in this mission: once content is ingested, we make it member-ready. We model new content types across our systems and algorithms, understand, tag, and rate every title, and give the business the platforms to organize and merchandise it. 


Role Overview

We are seeking a Product Manager to lead Content Understanding Foundations. In this role, you will define and drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for how Netflix understands its content, i.e., how we use AI to extract meaning from audiovisual content, and the tools and workflows people use to review, correct, and trust that output.


At its core, Content Understanding Foundations is about two closely connected areas:

  • Content understanding algorithms: AI models that extract key information (e.g., editorial and caution tags, maturity ratings and advisories, and timecode-level annotations) across titles, episodes, and clips, along with the taxonomy principles that enable algorithm development.
  • Content understanding workflows and platforms: a unified, scalable platform where experts review AI output, and where the teams that rely on that output can understand its quality, coverage, and impact.

Today, much of this work is still human-first. Your focus will be on moving us to AI/automation-first workflows, where models do the first pass and people focus on exceptions and quality, without compromising the accuracy and trust our members, partners, and regulators rely on. You will establish how we measure the quality and impact of our content understanding, and use it to decide what to automate, what to improve, and what to retire.


Looking ahead, you will shape what content understanding at Netflix can become. Beyond tags and ratings, you will identify new types of understanding that unlock new member experiences, for example in search, discovery, and personalization, as well as new use cases across the business.


You will partner with a cross-functional team of stunning colleagues across engineering, applied science, data science, and design, and work closely with a broad set of internal stakeholders: the content experts who review and annotate our content, the teams that consume content understanding signals, and our upstream partners on the content side.


What We Offer

As a PM at Netflix, you will:

  • Make a meaningful contribution: We're looking for experienced product leaders who are strategic and eager to roll up their sleeves.
  • Take on big responsibility: Netflix offers PMs autonomy and substantial scope.
  • Be expected to learn every day and to enjoy being curious: You will be building capabilities that don't yet exist. You will work with stunning colleagues who value collaboration and from whom you can learn.
  • Contribute to and benefit from an environment where you can grow your career: Many of our top execs started out as individual contributors.

Who Will Be Successful in This Role?

  • Visionary & strategic: Able to set a long-term vision for content understanding while executing on immediate priorities. Connects dots across domains to identify new opportunities, and brings new perspectives to current assumptions about what content understanding can enable for members and the business.
  • Deep in AI-powered content understanding: Understands how meaning is extracted from audiovisual content, including multimodal models, LLMs and vision-language models, embeddings, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop approaches. Can engage in productive debate with applied scientists on model approaches, quality bars, and tradeoffs, and knows where AI is ready to automate and where human expertise still matters.
  • Stakeholder-first mindset & partnership: Genuinely curious about what internal teams need and why. Builds trust-based relationships with both the experts who use our tools every day and the teams that consume our output, synthesizes diverse and sometimes competing needs into a coherent point of view, and creates a dynamic where partners feel heard, understand tradeoffs, and are invested in shared outcomes.
  • Tools & platform experience: Brings experience building internal tools and platforms that make expert workflows faster and more reliable, and that give stakeholders a clear view of quality and impact. Understands the unique challenge of building for internal users whose work ultimately shows up in front of members.
  • Generalist with depth: Comfortable moving between strategy, algorithms, tooling, and operations, and going deep where it matters.
  • Systems thinker: Comfortable with complex, interconnected systems and data models, and adept at designing scalable, extensible solutions that serve many use cases.
  • Sound judgment: Makes consistently strong decisions in areas of technical and business complexity, including bets that are not easily measurable in the short term. Sequences learnings thoughtfully to inform long-range strategy.
  • Communication & influence: Demonstrates clear, direct, and adaptable written and verbal communication. Synthesizes and simplifies complex topics in ways that enable broad understanding and effective decision-making, and aligns senior stakeholders across teams around a shared vision.
  • Bias toward action & growth mindset: Independently rallies cross-functional teams and drives projects forward with speed. Eager to learn, seek feedback, and continuously improve, and raises the bar on product craft across the broader Netflix product community.

Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with a proven record of prioritizing and successfully launching impactful capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience building AI/ML-powered products that extract meaning from audiovisual or other unstructured content (e.g., tagging, classification, annotation, content moderation, or ratings).
  • Experience building internal tools, workflows, or platforms for expert users (e.g., reviewers, annotators, analysts), ideally including human-in-the-loop systems.
  • Experience defining quality and impact measurement for ML-generated output, including evaluation frameworks, quality bars, and metrics that stakeholders can act on.
  • Familiarity with taxonomies, ontologies, or structured metadata, and how they shape algorithm development.
  • Strong track record of building collaborative, trust-based relationships with a broad set of internal stakeholders and engineering and applied science teams.
  • Expertise in developing vision, strategy, and roadmap for a cross-functional space, incorporating broader business context.
  • Experienced in turning clear thinking into well-crafted documents across the product lifecycle: strategy memos, PRDs, and stakeholder communications.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical content to a wide range of audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Experience with A/A and A/B testing.
  • Experience in media, entertainment, or content operations is a plus.

descriptionHtml:

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Junior Post Engineer to join our Post Engineering team in Vancouver. This role is ideal for someone with hands‑on experience in post, AV, or VFX environments who wants to deepen their technical engineering skills in a high‑end animation studio.

You’ll be a front‑line post engineering resource for our editorial suites, story and review rooms, and our screening theatre. You’ll help ensure our specialty spaces are robust, predictable, and technically sound - from day‑to‑day operations and Tier 1 support through to screenings, production reviews, and special events.

This role includes a strong focus on:

  • Troubleshooting complex specialty spaces (review rooms, theater, multi‑screen/multi‑channel environments)

  • Operating and supporting Q‑SYS–based room control and DSP

  • Understanding and maintaining SDR and HDR colour pipelines for review and screenings

This role requires occasional evening and weekend work, particularly around screenings, special events, and critical production milestones.

What You’ll Do:

Editorial, Review & Theater Support (Tier 1)

Provide Tier 1 troubleshooting and operational support for:

  • Editorial suites (Avid Media Composer)

  • Story and Review Rooms

  • Theater and other specialty screening spaces

  • Audio suites (Avid Pro Tools)

Diagnose and resolve first‑line issues related to:

  • Avid Media Composer and Avid Pro Tools

  • Autodesk RV and other VFX/animation review tools

  • Q‑SYS–controlled systems (routing, presets, room states, monitoring)

  • Playback systems, operator workstations, and peripherals

Perform basic verification of audio/video signal flow and KVM paths; identify when to escalate to more senior engineers.

Clearly document issues and escalate complex problems to the Post Engineering team and cross functionals with relevant details, logs, and reproducible steps.

Screenings, Reviews & Events

  • Set up, operate, and tear down for:

    • Internal screenings and dailies

    • Production reviews in our theater and review rooms

    • External screenings, previews, and Q&A sessions

  • Operate and support:

    • Xenon-based digital cinema projectors

    • Q‑SYS (or similar) audio/room automation systems

    • Playback, presentation, and basic routing of audio and video content

  • Partner with Production, Editorial, Facilities, and vendors to ensure events start on time and run smoothly.

Media Systems & Workflows

  • Support day‑to‑day operation of media and review systems used in animation and VFX pipelines, including:

    • Avid editorial workflows

    • Autodesk RV and other review tools

  • Assist Post Engineering team with:

    • Routine checks and basic maintenance of theaters, review rooms, and editorial systems

Operations, Documentation & Collaboration

  • Contribute to and maintain documentation of room configurations, standard operating procedures, and common troubleshooting steps (e.g., within Jira, Confluence, or similar tools)

  • Work closely within Post Engineering, Technology, and Production teams to ensure stable, predictable, and artist‑friendly environments.

What You’ll Need:

Experience & Background
