  • Hands-on experience supporting theaters, screening rooms, edit suites, or review spaces.

  • Strong familiarity with animation or VFX post-production workflows (editorial, reviews, dailies, deliveries).

Core Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of:

    • Xenon digital cinema projectors (operation, calibration  and basic troubleshooting)

    • Q‑SYS or similar room automation / DSP systems

    • Avid Media Composer and Avid Pro Tools in a shared or networked environment

    • Autodesk RV and related VFX/animation playback tools

  • Solid understanding of:

    • Audio and video signal flow (routing, patching, monitoring)

    • Basic networking concepts (IP addressing, connectivity, basic diagnostics)

    • Multiple operating systems, with emphasis on Rocky Linux; exposure to macOS/Windows is a plus

  • Comfort with other VFX/post software and willingness to learn new tools as needed.

Soft Skills

  • Strong customer service mindset and clear, concise communication with non‑technical users.

  • Detail‑oriented with the ability to follow and improve documentation and standard procedures.

  • Ability to stay composed and effective in live events and high‑pressure situations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in colour workflows and colour management, including:

    • Working with calibrated displays and digital cinema projectors

    • Understanding of colour spaces and transforms (e.g., SDR/HDR workflows, PQ, HLG, Rec.709, P3)

title: Staff/ Principal Software Engineer (L6/L7): AI Platform Model Serving
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix is on the journey to rebuild the AI/ML model serving platform and infrastructure that turns trained models into served predictions across real-time, async, and agentic workloads, at a scale few companies operate at. Supporting many production clusters, from classical to foundation models, spanning latencies from milliseconds rankers to LLM calls, and powering everything members see from homepage ranking to search, messaging, and internal AI productivity tools. 


We are re-building a new model serving platform from the ground up, designed from first principles to meet industry standards. It unifies our in-house inference infrastructure, third-party model hosting, and external LLM providers under a single serving, routing, and experimentation layer. Teams get one consistent way to deploy, route, and A/B test any model, regardless of where it runs.


Re-engineering how GPU capacity is provisioned and used. During off-peak periods, the same fleet that serves latency-critical production traffic is repurposed to run open-weight models for internal coding and developer productivity use cases.


This role sits at the center of Netflix’s GenAI and Foundation Model serving strategy, with real R&D scope on frontier AI infrastructure. You will tackle the efficiency problems that most directly drive cost per inference and capacity: disaggregated serving, intelligent routing across models and providers, speculative decoding, prompt caching, and multi-GPU inference. These are the levers that turn GPU spend into measurable business value.


You will lead the technology behind some of Netflix’s largest bets, embedding AI capabilities into member-facing products at global scale. You will also build durable, resumable execution for long-running agentic workloads. Online and asynchronous/ Near-Real-Time inference is projected to grow fast in 2028, so getting this foundation right now is what keeps costs sustainable and reliability high as demand scales.


Looking for deep expertise in distributed systems and high-performance RPC, GPU/CPU inference optimization, control planes, and experimentation infrastructure, plus fluency with modern LLM serving stacks and a track record of architecting systems that hold together under both extreme scale and rapid technology change.


Qualifications and Expectations

To succeed in this role, you will need:


  • Have a BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Applied Math, Engineering, or a related field. With relevant experience in the AI/ ML Infrastructure and distributed systems for 12+ years.
  • Influence without authority to guide architectural decisions and alignment across multi-teams through trust, data, and demonstrated expertise.
  • Shape long-term technical roadmaps (typically looking 2 to 3 years ahead) and ensure scalability, maintainability, and business alignment.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with product managers, operations, and executive stakeholders to balance technical trade-offs with business priorities.
  • Clear Communication skill to translate dense technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and produce clear documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and proposals.
  • Have experience with high-traffic distributed services and infrastructure for AI/ ML model inference, with a focus on high availability, security, and performance.
  • Have experience building scalable model-serving solutions for Foundation Models that powers generative and predictive AI applications with practical skills in reducing latency and costs.
  • Familiar with deploying AI/ ML models using platform and solutions such as NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, vLLM, or SGLang, and scaling them via Kubernetes.
  • Have experience working with public cloud infrastructure providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Have open-source contributions to projects in the AI/ML, distributed systems, or infrastructure space.
  • Hands-on experience with building AI models, and have explored optimization techniques for AI models, such as quantization, model compression, or model pruning.
  • Proficient in leveraging AI coding tools in software development.
  • Have experience working with model gateway and intelligent routing for choosing the right AI models based on context of the requests.
  • Exposure to deploying multi-adapters model serving, disaggregated prefill/decode, or large-scale KV cache management. 
  • Working with evaluation and benchmarking tools for LLMs and AI Agents.
  • Knowledge of GPU topology, NVIDIA CUDA programming, and machine learning compilers.

Key technologies & ecosystem

  • Deep Learning frameworks: Pytorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Hugging Face Transformers
  • Inference Engines and Runtimes: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI (Text Generation Inference), DeepSpeed-Inference, NVIDIA Dynamo
  • Hardware and Low-Level: CUDA, NCCL, and profiling tools like NVIDIA Nsight.

title: Counsel, Business Affairs - Korea
locations: Seoul, Korea, Republic of
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Opportunity 

Netflix is looking for an attorney who will be responsible for a wide array of development, acquisition (licensing), and production matters related to Netflix’s content programming. The successful candidate will structure, negotiate, and draft agreements to commission, develop, and produce local programming with various content partners, and should be extremely comfortable counseling internal stakeholders and making decisions that have both legal and business impacts.  

The position is based in Seoul, South Korea. 

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of agreements, including but not limited to:

    • Content license agreements across various deal structures (e.g., exclusive/non-exclusive, co-production, distribution)

    • Development and production agreements, covering talent, crew, and production service arrangements

    • Underlying IP agreements

    • Above-the-Line (ATL) agreements, including those with writers, directors, producers, and key talent

    • Music contracts, including composer, performer, music director, or producer agreements, master use and synchronization license agreements, songwriter agreements, soundtrack release and distribution agreements, record company and music publishing waivers

  • Act as a trusted business partner; focus on delivering pragmatic, business-first solutions that drive growth, moving beyond traditional, risk-averse legal management

  • Conduct a thorough legal analysis on issues arising throughout the lifecycle of content from development and production to distribution and exploitation, such as identifying risks, ensuring compliance, advising on clearance (including music clearance), and proposing practical solutions

  • Provide clear, solution-oriented legal guidance to external production partners, helping them navigate contractual obligations and regulatory requirements

  • Maintain close alignment with multiple internal cross-functional partners, including Content, Production, Marketing/PR teams, to ensure consistency and efficiency in deal execution and business operations

Qualifications 

  • Licensed attorney in good standing in at least one jurisdiction. We typically see candidates with 7+ years of experience in this role, though we welcome candidates with fewer years who have demonstrated the depth and scope needed to handle this role independently

title: Security Engineer 5 - IAM
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About The Team

Netflix’s Enterprise Identity & Access Management use cases have grown increasingly complex with our investments in Original content, Live events, Gaming, Ads, Attractions, subsidiary acquisitions, and more. The Identity Integrations and Solutions Engineering (IISE) team is a central security team that supports the Netflix workforce and our partners. We leverage standards-based Identity solutions to connect business and technical teams across the globe to the applications and tools they need to do their best work. 

About The Role

We are looking for a stunning colleague to help us design and build Identity and Access security solutions for Netflix’s global population of employees, contractors,  and external partners across all business verticals. 

Your deep IAM domain expertise will be critical and impactful in pursuit of our dual-mission: reduce risk for Netflix while meeting the speed of business for our partners. You will participate in all aspects of solution design and delivery; including implementation, partner integration, and rollout strategy. Internally, you will work closely with stakeholders across the Security and Engineering organizations in areas of federated authentication, user provisioning and deprovisioning, identity governance, compliance, and access management. Externally, you will partner with Netflix’s wide range of vendors and service providers to consult, integrate, and even improve the Identity capabilities of third-party systems.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • You are a pragmatic and hands-on security engineer with a proven track record of architecting, building and operating complex Identity Lifecycle and Access Control solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills combined with a product-focused mindset. Explaining complicated IAM concepts in simple language is absolutely necessary in this role to drive alignment with our many stakeholders.

  • You prefer collaboration and problem solving over process and prescription. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and independent decision making.

  • You have strong IAM fundamentals including experience with authentication and authorization standards and protocols  (OpenID Connect, SCIM, OAuth, SAML, LDAP)

  • You have deep domain expertise with all phases of the workforce Identity Lifecycle, starting with inception in upstream HCM platforms and continuing downstream across first and third party applications.

  • Hands-on experience working with vendor IAM solutions such as Okta Workflows, Okta Identity Engine, Auth0, or equivalent.

  • Experience with acquisition-driven identity integrations and migrations is strongly preferred, including knowledge of best practices and scalable integration patterns.

  • Experience in CI/CD with at least one modern programming language such as Java (preferred) or Python. The role requires frequent reading and occasional writing to internal codebases.

  • Experience running services on top of a Cloud computing platform, particularly AWS.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $400,000.00 - $680,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. title: Environment Modeling Supervisor - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Sydney, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:

We are seeking an Environment Modeling Supervisor to support our upcoming feature film. The Environment Modeling Supervisor works inside of NAS to lead the environment modeling team on a specific film or series, focusing on the creation of high‑quality environments, sets, and props that bring the world of the story to life. This role helps ensure that all environment assets are both artistically compelling and technically ready for Layout, Surfacing, FX, CFX, and Lighting, working within the direction and standards set by the Head of Environments and show leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Supervise the creation of 3D environments, sets, and props that align with the Production Designer’s and Art Director’s vision and the show’s visual style

  • Work closely with the Production Designer, Art Director (Environments), and Head of Environments to interpret design intent, scale, and level of detail, and ensure consistency across the world of the film

  • Lead environment modeling reviews and provide clear, specific, and constructive feedback on design fidelity, silhouette, proportion, structure, and overall quality

  • Ensure environment models meet technical requirements and pipeline standards so they integrate smoothly with Layout, Surfacing, FX, CFX, and Lighting

  • Collaborate with Technical Supervisors, TDs, and Production Technology to support and refine environment modeling tools, workflows, and asset libraries

  • Provide input to Production Management and department leadership on asset complexity and progress to support realistic planning and prioritization

  • Partner with Layout, Surfacing, FX, CFX, Characters, and Lighting to resolve design or technical issues and maintain alignment across departments

  • Mentor and support environment modelers, helping to identify training needs and contributing to performance feedback and skill development

  • Help foster a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative team culture where artists can do their best work

What You’ll Need

  • Significant experience as an Environment/Set/Prop Modeler in feature animation, VFX, or high‑end games/series, including time in a Lead or Supervisory role

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in environment and prop modeling (stylized and/or realistic), with clear understanding of design, form, scale, and composition

  • Proficiency in modeling tools such as Maya and sculpting tools such as ZBrush or Mudbox; experience with procedural or vegetation tools (e.g., Houdini, SpeedTree) is a plus

  • Strong understanding of how environments interact with Layout, Surfacing, FX, CFX, and Lighting within a production pipeline

  • Great communication and leadership skills, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback and collaborate effectively across departments

  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills

This role is based out of Sydney, Australia. Hybrid Role (Minimum of 3 days a week in the office).

  • Brainstorm inventive story beats, comedic/dramatic actions, and dialogue tweaks to elevate the story.

  • Proactively engage with and help define traditional, GenAI, and hybrid workflows to achieve creative excellence, bridging 2D and 3D ideas and integration for high-quality animation and story..

  • Receive and incorporate feedback quickly and thoughtfully, maintaining consistency with creative direction, production guidelines, and sprint timelines. Work closely with leadership to resolve issues and address notes.

  • Drive look development and visual experimentation efforts by pioneering new approaches to blend generative imagery with traditional renders and footage.

  • Build workflows, templates, and scripts as needed.

  • Ensure storyboards are delivered to the highest standard and on schedule through effective teamwork and problem-solving skills.

  • Help foster a collaborative, inclusive, curious, and exploratory team environment.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of storyboarding experience in animation, games, or digital media (feature, episodic, or high-end short‑form); experience with stylized or non‑photoreal work is a plus OR a portfolio that demonstrates extensive story experience for animated shorts, series, or features.

title: Associate, Production Finance - India
locations: Mumbai, India
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Behind every great story is a team of people enabling creators to do their best work. Our Production Finance team partners with filmmakers and production partners to bring Netflix Originals to life while ensuring financial excellence, operational rigor, and responsible stewardship of production investments.

If you're passionate about storytelling, love solving complex business problems, and thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments, we'd love to meet you.

The Opportunity

As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.

This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.

You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.

What You'll Do

Partner with Productions

  • Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.

  • Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.

  • Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes.

Drive Financial Excellence

  • Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.

  • Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.

  • Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.

  • Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.

  • Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.

Deliver Meaningful Insights

  • Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.

  • Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.

  • Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.

Strengthen Financial Operations

  • Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.

  • Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.

  • Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.

  • Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.

  • Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.

  • Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.

  • Excellent financial analysis and problem-solving skills with strong business judgment.

  • Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.

  • Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.

  • Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

Who You Are

  • You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.

  • You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

  • You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.

  • You balance analytical thinking with practical decision-making.

  • You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.

  • You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.

Why Netflix?

At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.

You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world-class stories are produced.

If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Head of Character Effects (CFX) to support our upcoming animated feature film. The Head of Character Effects works inside of NAS as the show-based leader for all character-related secondary motion, including hair, fur, feathers, cloth, and garments. They will partner closely with the Director, Production Designer, VFX Supervisor, Art Director, Head of Characters, Head of Character Animation and Technical Supervisor to ensure that character effects are both artistically compelling and technically robust.

The Head of Character Effects will oversee the CFX team during asset development, look development, and shot production. They will define the simulation approach for the show, review and give notes on all CFX work, and ensure it meets the highest quality bar while remaining efficient and stable in production. This may involve developing or supervising prototypes, guiding grooming and garment construction for simulation, solving complex technical problems, and helping to set up the CFX side of the project for success.

This position is essential in bridging the gap between creative intent and simulation-driven workflows, ensuring that character motion feels alive, expressive, and fully aligned with the film’s visual language. The Head of Character Effects builds strong relationships with creative leadership and with technical and production partners, demonstrating great diplomatic and interpersonal skills to balance artistic ambition with schedule and pipeline constraints.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and supervise Character Effects across the show, from look development to final shot delivery

  • Define the creative and technical approach for hair, fur, cloth, feathers, and other character-related simulations

  • Review CFX assets and shots, providing clear, actionable artistic and technical notes

  • Collaborate with Directors, Production Designers, Art Directors, Head of Characters, Animation, FX, and Look Development to ensure CFX supports character performance and story

  • Partner with Technical Supervisors, Production Technology, and R&D to develop and maintain robust, efficient CFX tools and workflows

  • Anticipate and identify creative and technical challenges in CFX and offer practical, innovative solutions

  • Work with Production Management on bids, schedules, and priorities to deliver high-quality work on time and within scope

  • Mentor and support CFX Supervisors, Leads, and Artists, fostering growth, clarity, and a positive team culture

  • Communicate effectively across disciplines, translating complex technical concepts into accessible language for creative partners

  • Collaborate with grace, humility, inclusion, and open-mindedness

What You’ll Need:

  • At least 10 years of experience in Character Effects/FX within film, TV, or games, including 5–7 years in leadership or supervisory roles on large-scale animated features or VFX films

  • Proven, production-level expertise in Houdini (SOPs/DOPs/POPs), with strong understanding of cloth, hair, fur, feather, and soft-body simulations; muscle/skin experience is a plus

  • Strong scripting and/or programming skills (e.g., Python, VEX) and familiarity with Linux-based workflows

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end 3D animation pipeline and how CFX interacts with Modeling, Grooming, Rigging, Surfacing, Animation, FX, Lighting, and Compositing

  • A strong eye for movement, weight, and anatomy, and the ability to give clear, constructive notes that improve performance and appeal

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and mentoring skills, with the ability to build trust and enthusiasm across a cross-site team while fostering a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive environment.

  • Comfort balancing quick turnaround needs with long-term quality and technical stability

This role is based out of Sydney, Australia. Hybrid Role (Minimum of 3 days a week in the office).

Netflix is seeking a Senior Account Manager to join our growing Netflix Ads team in Japan. This role is a critical partner to Sales and cross-functional stakeholders, responsible for managing our most strategic client and agency relationships.

The Senior Account Manager will focus on advertiser retention and growth while leading the full pre-to-post sale campaign workflow. A key part of the role is demonstrating strong problem-solving skills — engaging directly with clients, anticipating challenges, and driving long-term solutions through clear communication and strategic account planning.

This position requires balancing commercial strategy with operational excellence, ensuring Netflix Ads is seen as a trusted, solutions-oriented partner to our advertisers.

  • Serve as the first point of contact for campaign-related escalations, resolving issues in partnership with cross-functional teams before they require management intervention

If you have a passion for entertainment and a desire to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment, we would love to hear from you. Come join us and help us entertain the world!

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house world-class ad tech ecosystem to offer our members more choices in consuming their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering team is the heartbeat of our monetization engine. We are builders, not just architects. Our team is responsible for the mission-critical infrastructure that orchestrates ad decisioning, policy enforcement, and delivery across our global content ecosystem. We operate on a "context over control" philosophy, empowering you to make high-impact technical decisions that shape the future of our advertising technology. We don't just design systems; we ship production code that handles massive scale, ensuring a seamless, low-latency viewing experience for our members while delivering exceptional outcomes for advertisers.

The Core Ad Serving Platform team designs and builds scalable, modular backend frameworks and libraries that serve as the foundation of ads platform. You will focus on creating resilient systems that power a wide range of ad products and features while ensuring high availability, low latency, and maintainability as the platform evolves.

What Success Looks Like

  • Dynamic: You thrive in critically impactful environments where you maintain platform stability under high throughput.

  • Hands-on Ownership: You are a builder. You’re comfortable navigating complex distributed systems, identifying bottlenecks, and writing code to solve them—not just whiteboarding solutions. You own the full lifecycle of your services—from design and deployment to capacity modeling and incident response.

  • Contextual Decision Making: You possess the judgment to align technical tradeoffs with business goals, ensuring our ad serving infrastructure scales gracefully as we continue to grow.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect and operate backend services for core ad decisioning: Design and build scalable, modular backend frameworks for targeting, frequency management, pacing, and policy enforcement.

  • Design APIs and data models: Create clean, scalable interfaces and data schemas that enable seamless interoperability across the Ad Platform ecosystem.

  • Optimize high-throughput serving: Build services that manage ad selection and delivery consistency, ensuring low-latency performance in high-traffic, distributed environments.

  • Drive operational excellence: Implement SLO-driven development and proactive capacity planning, and own the incident response lifecycle for the core serving stack.

  • Instrument platform reliability: Develop comprehensive diagnostics, logging, and telemetry frameworks to ensure deep observability into system health and reliability.

  • Maintain ad-tech domain expertise: Utilize deep knowledge of advertising concepts (publisher policies, frequency caps, targeting) to ensure the platform meets industry standards and business requirements.

Skills & Experience We’re Seeking

  • 7+ years of experience, with at least 4+ years in the Ads domain.

  • Expertise in building and operating highly-available, distributed systems at massive scale.

  • Hands-on experience building core ad server components: decisioning logic, ad selection, pacing, ranking, scoring, and frequency capping.

  • Deep understanding of ad-tech ecosystem standards and business requirements (e.g., targeting, policy enforcement, and frequency management).

  • Proven ability to design scalable APIs and data models that support complex, multi-service ecosystems.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with cross-functional product and engineering teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience working in the CTV space and familiarity with its unique delivery constraints.

  • Expertise in high-throughput data processing systems and telemetry frameworks for large-scale production environments.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure, deployment automation, and SLO-driven development.

title: Security Software Engineer (L6), Security Protocols & Foundations
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Open Connect (OC) is a critical group within Netflix that builds and manages a content delivery network (CDN) that delivers all of Netflix’s streaming video. In addition to streaming video, we work on projects within Netflix that leverage physical infrastructure, such as our Cloud Games and Live initiatives. According to a 2023 Sandvine report, data delivered by OC accounts for approximately 15% of all downstream traffic volume across the entire internet. Most of this traffic is delivered by our edge cache servers.
 

A small team of talented software engineers develops and maintains the software that runs on OC edge appliances. Because of the critical role of these appliances for Netflix and the Internet, they have to be both efficient and secure. As we scale Live and Cloud Games, the protocols and appliances that deliver our content across the open internet need security designed and built in as foundational primitives, without compromising our industry-leading efficiency and economics.

We are looking for a Security Software Engineer to own protocol and foundational security for the OC edge appliances, with the opportunity to directly impact a critical area of the business.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build security primitives that are necessary for existing and innovative new streaming protocols for large scale content delivery.

  • Partner with business and product stakeholders to translate their goals into security requirements and technical design and implementation.

  • Develop and own a consolidated set of application security primitives used across our delivery paths, built once rather than separately per application, extending and going beyond what libraries like OpenSSL provide.

  • Optimize the crypto and transport security layers on OC appliances for performance and resource efficiency.

  • Develop primitives and mitigations for host-side DoS resilience, including kernel integration to throttle abusive traffic, partnering with adjacent teams for end-to-end protection of our infrastructure.

  • Conduct vulnerability research and mitigation for application and protocol-level vulnerabilities across the OC platform.

  • Serve as the security owner for OC's protocols and cryptographic foundations and as a liaison with partner organizations, staying ahead of the industry through engagement with key cryptography and security communities.

  • Demonstrate versatility by learning and adapting to new architectures and features as they evolve.

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Opportunity

Netflix's mission is to entertain the world by connecting members with the stories they'll love. With over 300 million members in 190+ countries, getting personalization right is central to member satisfaction. We're hiring two engineering managers to lead the teams behind two of the most important algorithms in the recommendations space. 

The first team owns homepage construction: deciding which sections appear on a member's page, in what order, and how they're arranged The second team owns title ranking: the underlying prediction of how relevant a given title is to a given member.

These are two distinct teams with two distinct engineering manager openings. 

The Two Teams

Page Construction - owns which sections appear on a member's homepage, in what order, and how the full page is composed. These comprise some of the most impactful machine learning models in the product, and one of the most mature: a highly optimized pipeline combining section retrieval (identifying which candidate sections are relevant to a member), adaptive row ordering, and re-ranking passes that account for how sections interact with one another across the page. It runs live, in the request path, for every member session so beyond the ML challenge, it demands rigorous engineering to meet strict latency requirements at Netflix's scale. The team is now developing a generative model that learns to build the ideal page end-to-end, and is expanding into new content formats such as short-form video and games.

Ranking - owns the prediction of how relevant a title is to a given member in a given context, and how that ranking is applied across our entire ecosystem of discovery and personalization touchpoints.This team’s work directly shapes how hundreds of millions of members discover content every day. As Netflix expands into new content types — vertical video, games, podcasts, and beyond — supporting these formats well is an urgent priority: each one brings interaction patterns our existing models weren't built for, and the team is building new approaches to keep pace. The team is also driving one of its core innovation bets: moving the ranking stack toward an LLM-native backbone.

Both teams report into the same organization and partner closely - Page Construction decides what sections exist and how they're arranged, and Ranking decides which titles populate them. Whichever team you join, you'll work closely with your counterpart EM on the other side of that interface.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead and grow a team of AI research scientists and AI research engineers focused on either page construction or title ranking (team assignment determined through the interview process).

  • Set the technical vision and roadmap for your team, balancing investment across mature, production-grade models and newer generative approaches.

  • Guide your team through the shift from traditional machine learning toward generative, LLM-based methods.

  • Drive infrastructure decisions in partnership with adjacent ML and platform teams - including serving infrastructure, foundation model integration, and experimentation tooling.

  • Own the quality of your team's algorithms across the entire product surface: the main homepage, kids' profiles, partner devices, short-form video, games, and new formats as they emerge.

  • Partner closely with the engineering manager leading the adjacent team (Page Construction or Ranking) to ensure the two models work together as one coherent personalization experience.

  • Work closely with Product Management to translate member experience goals into strategy and experimentation plans.

  • Hire, develop, and retain a diverse, high-caliber team, supporting existing technical leads in an environment where senior talent can do its best work.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience leading applied ML, ML engineering, or applied science teams on large-scale ranking, recommendation, or personalization models.

  • Strong technical depth in recommender systems, ranking, or slate/page-level optimization; comfortable in architecture discussions, model trade-offs, and experimentation strategy with senior engineers.

  • A track record guiding teams through major technical transitions - for example, from traditional ML to deep learning, or from deterministic models to generative, LLM-based approaches.

  • Strong product instincts: the ability to connect technical decisions to member experience outcomes and partner effectively with product management.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, able to align senior partners across engineering, science, product, and platform teams.

  • A track record building and leading diverse, high-performing technical teams in a fast-moving, high-autonomy environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years in applied ML/science or ML engineering, including 3+ years in a technical leadership or people management role.

  • Experience with applying large language models and genAI innovations recommendation and ranking problems.

  • Experience with multi-objective optimization or slate/page-level value modeling - problems where the quality of a whole set matters, not just individual items.

  • Experience managing teams operating across both mature, production-grade models and early-stage experimental work at the same time.

  • Background at a consumer-scale company with AI-driven products (streaming, social media, marketplaces, search, advertising).

  • Familiarity with the full ML production lifecycle: data pipelines, training, evaluation, serving, and experimentation.

  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, building lightweight structure without over-engineering process.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment and are a master storyteller who can turn complex business and creative challenges into compelling narratives, we invite you to join our growing communications team.

The Role

The Manager, Scripted Series Communications protects and promotes Netflix’s reputation across our scripted series portfolio, spanning drama, comedy, genre, YA, and franchise IP. This role owns the full 360-degree communications cycle—from development and greenlight through launch, renewal, and beyond—leading strategy, campaign planning, executive visibility, and issues management.

Media relations is the core of this role. You will personally pitch, secure, and shape press coverage, building narratives that connect our slate to broader cultural and industry conversations. We seek an ambitious, strategic storyteller and media relations pro who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by calculated risk. You should be a hands-on operator with established press relationships who excels at working directly with creators, talent, and production partners.

This role is based in Los Angeles and reports to the Director, Communications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Drive end-to-end communications strategy from development through launch and beyond, managing messaging, campaigns, and issues management.

  • Hands-On Media Relations: Personally pitch and secure coverage across trade, business, and entertainment media. Leverage an existing, deep network of press relationships to shape narratives from day one.

  • Slate Storytelling: Develop horizontal, multi-title narratives (e.g., genre trends, franchise milestones, industry impact) that connect individual titles to broader cultural conversations about Netflix.

  • Creative Campaigning: Craft compelling brand narratives and pitches that help titles cut through the cultural noise; identify non-traditional story angles via social, fandom, and cultural moments.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with creative executives, production, marketing, and legal teams to shape long-term strategy and provide expert counsel.

  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and manage brand and communications risks, including sensitive reactive situations (cancellations, HR issues, controversial content), with sound judgment under pressure.

  • Executive & Talent Management: Secure and coordinate executive, creator, and talent interviews, press tours, panels, and speaking opportunities.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in communications at an agency, studio, or network, ideally within entertainment or media.

  • Proven track record leading proactive and reactive communications strategy for scripted television, film, or comparable premium content.

  • Demonstrated success building multi-title, “slate” or franchise-level narratives — not just single-title campaigns — that tie to broader cultural, economic, or industry storylines.

  • Deep, established, and active relationships across trade, business, entertainment, consumer, and new, emerging media. A proven, personal track record of pitching, securing, and shaping press coverage. 

  • Skilled storyteller who can distill complex or sensitive situations into clear, compelling narratives and effective press pitches.

  • Sound judgment on brand and communications risk; steady under pressure and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence powers innovation in all areas of the business, from helping members choose the right entertainment for them through personalization, to better understanding our audience and our content slate, to optimizing our payment processing and other revenue-focused initiatives. Building highly scalable and differentiated ML infrastructure is key to accelerating this innovation.

The Opportunity

Agents are becoming a primary way software gets built and work gets done at Netflix — and the AI Platform is building the foundation they run on. The Agent Platform team owns the agent-specific layer that every agent at Netflix depends on: the runtime and execution environment, memory, identity and permissioning, discovery and registry, evaluation, and the tool/MCP interfaces agents use to act. We build the paved path agent developers across the company build on, and we operate the runtimes for the workloads the general platform can't reach — including at member scale.

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead this team. This is a small, senior, high-leverage group working at the front edge of a domain that is still being invented — where frameworks turn over in months and the durable bets are not obvious. The hardest part of this job is not the code — it is choosing what to build, and what will still matter once today's tools are gone.

You will:

  • Own the charter and technical direction. Set the platform's technical strategy and roadmap — the agent-specific foundation every agent depends on, and the selective runtimes worth operating directly — and decide where to invest ahead of demand.

  • Lead and grow a high performing team. Hire, develop, and retain excellent engineers; set a high bar; and create the conditions for a small team to have outsized impact.

  • Make sharp build, adopt, or partner calls. Decide which capabilities the platform owns and which it draws from partner teams, define the interfaces between them, and keep a small team focused on the highest-leverage layer.

  • Turn the new hard problems into primitives. The most durable problems in this space are the ones that let agents get better from their own experience: capturing each run's full reasoning-and-tool-call trajectory as structured, replayable data; turning real-world outcomes into evaluation signal; memory that compounds across runs; and a feedback loop that turns that signal into improved behavior, promoted behind eval gates and safe rollout. Make these first-class platform capabilities with real contracts — so agents built on the platform measurably improve over time, not just scale.

  • Operate as part of the AI Platform leadership team. Set direction alongside peer leaders across the AI Platform and partner orgs, represent the team in senior technical forums, and build the cross-team alignment a foundational platform depends on.

If you've built platforms and you know that the defining work is judgment — what to own, what to hand off, what to bet on while the ground is still moving — this is the role.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience leading and growing engineering teams that build and operate platform or infrastructure at scale — managing senior individual contributors and/or managers, with a track record of developing strong engineers.

  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating agentic systems in production — agent runtimes and harnesses, tool use, memory, and evaluation — with genuine technical depth, not oversight from a distance.

  • Breadth across business applications: you've built or led agents spanning a range of use cases, enterprise and internal applications (developer tooling, operations, knowledge work) or consumer-facing applications at scale.

  • A strong engineering foundation in distributed systems, cloud, and ML/AI infrastructure — deep enough to lead a senior team's hardest architectural decisions and earn its trust.

  • A track record of owning a platform's charter — setting its direction and holding its scope against pressure to do everything — and making build-versus-partner decisions on a multi-year cost horizon.

  • Cross-organizational credibility: a record of building shared accountability with senior leaders across adjacent platform, infrastructure, and security teams, and navigating ambiguous ownership boundaries.

  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfort with ambiguity; able to lead both 0-to-1 and 1-to-100 work; effective across a distributed (US) team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the emerging class of agent concerns: agent identity and permissioning, guardrails and safety, and cost governance for LLM and agent workloads.

  • Experience running a platform that other engineers consume as a product — paved paths, migrations, deprecations, and developer experience.

  • Credibility in a relevant open-source ecosystem (agent frameworks, runtimes, or developer tooling).

title: Principal Product Manager, Compute Platform - Cloud Infrastructure
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix's Infrastructure Engineering organization provides the backbone that powers Netflix's global scale and operations across business verticals. Within this organization, Cloud Infrastructure Engineering provides a secure, scalable foundation that accelerates the productivity and innovation of Netflix technology teams by abstracting infrastructure complexity behind a managed platform. Compute sits at the center of that foundation: every service, batch job, training run, inference request, and agent at Netflix ultimately runs on the compute platform we build.


Our Compute platform runs many kinds of workloads at a massive scale. That includes stateless and stateful services, batch jobs, streaming, media encoding, and a growing amount of distributed training and inference across our GPU fleet. Agentic workloads are now part of that mix. They introduce a new set of platform needs. Identity, sandboxed execution, observability, and cost accountability all need to be built in from the start.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager with broad knowledge of distributed systems and infrastructure, strong systems thinking, and the ability to work with engineers at architectural depth. You’ll lead the modernization of Netflix’s Compute Platform as AI becomes a larger part of what we build. The goal is a common platform where services, batch jobs, training, inference, and agents can run securely, reliably, and efficiently at Netflix scale. You’ll own product direction and execution across the Compute portfolio, making the tradeoffs required to evolve our infrastructure, support new workload patterns, use capacity effectively, and meet specialized needs across Studio, Ads, and Games. You’ll turn deep technical context into a coherent strategy, sound product decisions, and meaningful results across the business. You’ll have the autonomy to make those decisions and the accountability that comes with them.


What You Will Do

-Set the strategic direction for Netflix’s Compute platforms in an agent-first world. You’ll define how our platform evolves to support this future, including guiding the move from Titus to a modern Kubernetes stack and weighing migration costs against the value of a common platform. At Netflix scale, this evolution is as much a product challenge as an engineering one.

-Improve how we manage GPU capacity. You’ll own the roadmap for provisioning, scheduling across regions, and fleet utilization. The goal is to give training and inference workloads the capacity they need within seconds while using the fleet efficiently.

-Define how agents run at Netflix. You’ll lead the development of a secure, managed environment that can support millions of agents, with built-in identity, isolation, governance, observability, and cost tracking.

-Make compute easier to use by creating a seamless experience across the full compute spectrum, from VMs to functions. You’ll improve our managed offerings so teams can focus on their work rather than infrastructure details, guided by regular engagement with service owners, ML engineers, and teams building agents.

-Improve efficiency across the fleet to drive hundreds of millions of dollars of impact. You’ll work on defining systems that manage compute supply and demand to ensure efficient resource use and that compute costs grow more slowly than demand. You’ll also establish clear measures for adoption, utilization, cost per workload, and reliability.

-Partner with teams across Ads, Live, Games, and Studio to ensure our compute platform supports their most demanding workloads, from sudden traffic spikes during ad breaks and live events to latency-sensitive processing in regions with limited local infrastructure.


What We're Looking For

Strong technical product management skills are table stakes. What will set someone apart in this role is:

-More than 10 years of experience in technical product management or a similar technical role in compute infrastructure. You should be comfortable debating architecture, trade-offs, and system quality with senior engineers.


-Deep knowledge of compute infrastructure, including containers, Kubernetes, scheduling and orchestration, autoscaling, capacity management, multi-tenancy, and cloud economics.


-A strong understanding of AI infrastructure. This includes GPU provisioning, scheduling, and utilization for distributed training and inference, as well as the needs of agentic workloads such as secure execution, workload identity, isolation, and cost attribution.


-Experience leading a large replatform or migration from start to finish. You understand that sequencing, adoption, incentives, and the long tail of migration are product decisions, not cleanup work for engineering.


-The ability to earn the trust of experienced engineers and challenge their thinking in useful ways. 


You make clear decisions with incomplete information, hold direction under pressure, and change course when the evidence calls for it.


Strong leadership and communication. You can explain complex decisions to technical and executive audiences, build alignment across teams, and influence without relying on authority. You assume good intent, seek out different perspectives, give and receive direct feedback, and prioritize shared outcomes over individual ownership.

title: Machine Learning Scientist 5- Forecasting Aggregation
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

In 2022 we launched a new lower-priced, ad-supported tier, and we are building an in-house, world-class ad-tech ecosystem to give our members more choice and to offer advertisers a premium, better-than-linear-TV experience. We are looking for the founding members of this new business area for Netflix.

The Ads Forecasting team builds the predictive foundation of the Netflix ads business — the models that tell us, before a campaign ever runs, how much inventory is available and how a campaign will deliver. We forecast supply and demand across audiences, ad products, and formats, and we predict campaign outcomes such as maximum availability, delivery confidence, reach, and frequency, accounting for the ad-serving optimizations that shape delivery. Our forecasts power media planning, underwriting, budget planning, yield, and the public API.

This is a brand-new, foundational role. You will build the machine learning models that augment our simulation-based engine for predicting campaign delivery — turning a slow, rules-based simulation into fast, accurate, learnable models of how campaigns deliver against real inventory. You'll own the modeling and prototyping end-to-end and partner closely with our ML engineering team to take models to production.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, prototype, and iterate on supervised machine learning models that predict campaign delivery outcomes — delivery risk, reach, frequency, and contention — to replace the current simulation engine.

  • Model demand-side campaign outcomes while incorporating supply-side signals, so the models reason about how well available inventory matches what advertisers are trying to achieve (targeting, frequency caps, contention, pacing).

  • Design rigorous offline and online evaluation frameworks to measure model accuracy, robustness to seasonality and distribution shift, and lift over the simulation baseline.

  • Own feature engineering and contribute to the team's feature store — turning ad-serving logs, campaign attributes, and supply signals into reusable, well-documented features.

  • Prioritize explainability and interpretability: your models' outputs must be defensible to sales and media-planning stakeholders making real booking and underwriting decisions.

  • Partner with ML engineers to deploy models at scale and to monitor production model health and drift, feeding monitoring insights back into the next modeling iteration.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners across product, engineering, and sales to define objectives, constraints, and trade-offs, and to drive adoption of ML-driven forecasts.

  • Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the company.

We are looking for:

  • Advanced degree (PhD or Master's) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience building machine learning models on large-scale data.

  • Deep expertise in supervised learning (e.g. gradient-boosted trees, regression, and related methods) with a strong bias toward interpretable, explainable models.

  • Strong feature engineering skills and familiarity with feature stores and standard ML lifecycle practice (versioning, evaluation, monitoring, retraining).

  • Proven ability to prototype algorithms and validate them rigorously against production data.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and strong SQL.

  • Working knowledge of ad-serving and campaign concepts — how campaigns are delivered and what creates delivery risk: targeting, frequency caps, contention, bidding, pacing, budget planning, and the core campaign objects/attributes; and the metrics that matter (reach, frequency, impressions, clicks, outcomes). You should understand both the supply side (ad-serving rules and inventory behavior) and the demand side (campaign attributes and advertiser goals). Ads experience is strongly preferred.

  • Ability to work independently, drive your own projects, and make compelling cases for prioritization.

  • Ability to communicate technical and statistical concepts clearly to audiences at many levels.

  • Embodies the Netflix values while bringing a new perspective to continue improving our culture.

Nice to have:

  • Experience at a DSP, SSP, or publisher-side ad platform where predicting campaign outcomes at scale is a core science problem.

  • Familiarity with our ML stack (Metaflow) or comparable large-scale ML tooling.

  • Experience partnering with ML engineers to ship and monitor production ML systems.

  • Experience creating data products, dashboards, or explainability tooling for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience applying GenAI to boost developer/research productivity.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


Netflix is investing heavily in GenAI tooling to drive workforce productivity - across both general-purpose use cases (e.g., coding assistants, enterprise productivity tools used broadly across the company) and domain-specific use cases tailored to individual functions (finance, legal, marketing, etc.) and workflows. This role sits on the Finance & Strategy (F&S) team responsible for making sense of that investment: building the ROI framework that ties GenAI spend to real productivity gains, supporting the measurement infrastructure and reporting that gives leaders visibility into adoption and impact, and supporting commercial strategy and negotiations with technology vendors.
 

As a Senior Manager on this team, you'll operate at the intersection of finance, data science, product, and vendor strategy - translating fast-moving, often incomplete data into a clear narrative and set of recommendations for senior leadership. You'll support the analytical work behind vendor negotiations as our technology strategy evolves.
 

This role will be based in our Los Gatos office, report to the Director of F&S, and will lead a team of two associates.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Support the longer term strategy including evaluation of the internal ecosystem and continuously evolving industry landscape of open source and open weight models and harnesses

  • Own the ROI and measurement narrative for GenAI enterprise and workforce tooling - translating adoption, engagement, and cost data into a clear story for senior stakeholders

  • Develop a shared analytical framework for evaluating both general-purpose use cases (tools with broad, company-wide adoption) and domain-specific use cases (workflows tailored to a particular function or team), ensuring each is measured and valued appropriately

  • Develop and maintain a phased measurement framework that builds confidence in productivity gains over time

  • Drive the build-out and evolution of internal dashboards and reporting that serve as a source of truth for GenAI adoption, engagement, and cost across use cases and functions, partnering with data science, engineering, and finance teams

  • Support vendor negotiation strategy through scenario modeling (e.g., commitment levels, discount structures, multi-vendor cost tradeoffs) for major technology vendors, partnering with legal, procurement, and product teams

  • Help refine financial models for technology tooling spend, stress-testing assumptions around usage growth, pricing, and adoption across both general and domain-specific tools

  • Partner with functional leaders across the company to help them interpret their spend and productivity data, and inform decisions on where to invest

  • Manage and develop a team of two, ensuring rigorous, well-communicated analysis across the team's workstreams
     

Qualifications:

  • A strong track record of critical thinking, performing comprehensive analyses independently, and communicating recommendations clearly and concisely to senior stakeholders

  • 8-10 years of experience in a highly analytical environment (e.g., management consulting, corporate strategy, or a similarly analytical role within a media or tech company); prior people-management experience preferred

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity — building models and frameworks from incomplete or fast-changing data

  • Expert working knowledge of Excel and the ability to quickly learn internal tools; working knowledge of visualization/dashboard tools (e.g., Tableau)

  • Experience with vendor negotiation, procurement, or commercial deal analysis is a strong plus

  • Solid understanding of product and technology concepts, with experience partnering with product, engineering, and data science teams

  • Bachelor's degree with an emphasis on quantitative coursework (finance, economics, mathematics, engineering/computer science, or related fields)

  • Bonus: familiarity with GenAI/LLM tooling, token-based pricing models, and current GenAI tooling landscape such as open source / open weight and frontier models and harnesses

title: Software Engineer (L6), Platform Security
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

At Netflix, we want to entertain the world and are constantly innovating on how entertainment is imagined, created and delivered to a global audience. We currently stream content in more than 30 languages in 190 countries, topping over 250 million paid subscribers and are expanding into new forms of entertainment such as gaming.

Open Connect (OC) is a critical group within Netflix that builds and manages a content delivery network (CDN) that delivers all of Netflix’s streaming video. In addition to streaming video, we work on projects within Netflix that leverage physical infrastructure, such as our Cloud Games and Live initiatives. According to a 2023 Sandvine report, data delivered by OC accounts for approximately 15% of all downstream traffic volume across the entire internet. Most of this traffic is delivered by our edge cache servers.

A small team of talented software engineers develops and maintains the operating system and platform that run the content caches. These appliances run a heterogeneous, deeply integrated stack, including Linux, FreeBSD, firmware, BMC, FPGAs, BIOS/UEFI, and containers. Because of the important role these caches serve, it is critical that they be both efficient and secure from the hardware up.

We are looking for a Security Software Engineer to architect and implement system-level security for the OC edge and gaming appliances, serving as the in-house home for hardware and low-level OS security assurance, with the opportunity to directly impact a critical area of the business.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and evolve the security architecture of the full compute stack, from hardware interfaces (FPGA, BIOS/UEFI, BMC) through dual operating systems (FreeBSD and Linux).

  • Implement security enhancements using a variety of methods such as kernel and user-space development, configuration changes, or leveraging hardware-based security features such as TPMs and hardware offload.

  • Drive platform integrity work including measured/secure boot for appliances and improved BMC access controls and auditability.

  • Analyze and triage new system-level security bugs,  including hardware/GPU and OS isolation issues and provide appliance security expertise during incident response.

  • Partner with stakeholders in different organizations to build secure architecture for binary ingestion and execution..

  • Develop automated systems and low-level tooling to perform vulnerability research and reduce manual security overhead in build, test, and release workflows.

  • Act as a security liaison between OC and other organizations, and stay plugged into the right external groups (silicon/firmware vendors, OS communities, disclosure partners).

  • Demonstrate versatility by learning and adapting to new architectures and features as they evolve.

Qualifications:

  • Proven track record of architecting and implementing security features that meaningfully improve system security.

  • Deep expertise in low-level systems and hardware security across a heterogeneous stack (kernels, firmware, BMC, BIOS/UEFI, FPGA).

  • Experience using operating system execution environments such as containers or virtual machines to enhance security.

  • Success at partnering with others to improve the security posture through cross-functional changes.

  • Experience using AI agents to automate security research.

You will be successful in this role if you:

  • Have the ability to define and self-manage cross-functional projects fueled by ambiguous questions.

  • Able to partner with business and product stakeholders to translate their goals into security requirements and technical design and implementation.

  • Are a self-starter, curious and not afraid to ask when in doubt.

  • Are a quick learner and excited about learning new technologies.

  • Advocate thoughtful collaboration, take pride in your work and enjoy taking full ownership of projects from conception to production.

Nice to have:

  • Experience conducting security research, with published materials to show for it.

  • Experience conducting penetration tests which found meaningful opportunities for improvement and identified security gaps.

  • Kernel development experience.

  • Experience successfully using TPMs/HSMs, trusted execution environments, and other hardware features.

  • Experience with measured/secure boot and hardware roots of trust.

  • Experience working on highly distributed systems and fuzzing complex systems.

  • Experience securing FreeBSD, Linux; familiarity with GPU/virtualization isolation.

  • Experience with C, Golang, Python.

Algo Core is a horizontal team within AI for Member Systems (AIMS) that owns reward modeling, utility estimation, and multi-objective optimization as shared capabilities used across Netflix’s recommendation, personalization, and promotion systems. We’re looking for a Research Engineer to serve as technical lead for this surface area — driving the roadmap for how Netflix combines member value and business value into a single, tunable framework (using auction-based and constrained-optimization techniques) for deciding what gets promoted where across the member experience.
