title: Program Manager, Human Evaluations (Recommendations)
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Job Description

Great recommendations are how members find something worth their time. We are looking for an experienced Human Evaluations Program Manager to help us measure and improve the quality of recommendations across the Netflix homepage and discovery experience. You will work alongside Product Management and ML teams to build the human evaluation programs that tell us whether recommendations are working for members, and where they are not.

About the Role

Netflix is building toward more relevant, more varied, and more trustworthy recommendations, and thoughtful, high-quality evaluation is essential to making sure we are moving in the right direction. Join a team creating the frameworks, tools, and workflows that ensure human judgment is applied with consistency, clarity, and care, whether we are evaluating relevance, repetition, diversity, or whether a recommendation simply makes sense to the member.

You will not only shape how human evaluations of our recommendations are designed, but also own the day-to-day execution. From scoping and planning to vendor management, rater onboarding, and calibration, you will be accountable for driving delivery from start to finish. Just as critically, you will act as a thought partner to Product Management, helping translate recommendation strategy into evaluation designs and building a shared language around recommendation quality across teams.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will partner across product, research, data science, UX, and engineering to develop rubrics, frameworks, and workflows that enable rigorous, scalable human evaluation of recommendations. Beyond shaping the "what" and "how," you will also lead the "when" and "done." You will keep evaluation projects on track, ensuring consistent execution, timely delivery, efficient use of vendor capacity, and high rater alignment. If you are excited to bring structure to ambiguity and influence what members see when they open Netflix, while being accountable for tangible delivery, this is your chance to create meaningful impact from day one.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of structure and flexibility. You know how to create evaluation frameworks that are rigorous and scalable, and you are also a driver who gets them out the door. You are skilled at translating product strategy into evaluation workflows, defining milestones, managing vendors, and delivering consistent results in a dynamic environment. You can steer teams across functions, keep timelines on track, and ensure rater quality without micromanaging. You are curious about how personalization works and can build credibility with PMs, data scientists, and ML engineers. You have working fluency in film and TV content and can quickly scan a set of titles to tell whether they belong together. You thrive in spaces where there is no roadmap, and you take pride in making things real, not just possible.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end execution of human evaluation and data operations initiatives, from intake and scoping to delivery
  • Partner with Product Management to translate recommendation strategy and roadmap priorities into evaluation designs, success metrics, and timelines
  • Manage human annotation vendors, including capacity planning, SLAs, quality performance, and escalations
  • Drive operational efficiency across evaluation programs, including cost per task, throughput, turnaround time, and speed to IRR
  • Develop clear, scalable guidelines and scoring rubrics to ensure consistent rater judgment, including for subjective, taste-based questions
  • Oversee rater onboarding, calibration, and QA workflows
  • Pilot and refine evaluation tasks to improve clarity, inter-rater reliability, and feedback quality
  • Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks and blockers
  • Act as the connective tissue across product, ML, data science, and vendor partners to ensure alignment and effective execution of evaluations at scale

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience working in human evaluations, data collection, labeling, or annotation operations in ML environments
  • Track record of implementing process improvements or quality control systems for data collection needs
  • Prior experience managing human annotation vendors, raters, or data labeling teams, including vendor performance and cost management
  • Experience improving operational efficiency of annotation programs (throughput, turnaround, cost)
  • Strong understanding of evaluation design, including guidelines, rubrics, and scoring protocols
  • Working fluency in film and TV content, including genres, formats, and talent
  • Proven ability in end-to-end management of complex, cross-functional programs, demonstrating strong Program Management skills and clear accountability for successful delivery
  • Experience with human labeling platforms
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to synthesize feedback into clear recommendations and process improvements
  • Familiarity with how rater subjectivity and bias affect taste-based judgments, and how to account for them in evaluation design
  • Strong organizational skills and executional focus; ability to track details while seeing the bigger picture

Nice To Have

  • Experience with personalization, recommender systems, search, or ranking evaluation
  • Familiarity with how offline human evaluation complements online experimentation (A/B tests) and engagement metrics
  • Experience evaluating at the list or page level, not only the individual item level
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and Data Scientists on metric definition

title: Staff Software Engineer 6, Device Capabilities – Partner Enablement Applications
locations: Warsaw, Poland
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

A lot of those memberships come to life on TV. Before any TV, set-top box or streaming stick can show the Netflix app, someone has to make sure it actually works, and works well. That's where we come in.


We're part of Client and Partner Technologies (CPT), the org that makes Netflix shine on partner devices. Our organization, Enablement Applications, builds the tooling that TV makers, chipset vendors and ODMs use to bring Netflix to their devices. 


Meet the DeCap team

We own how new TV devices get certified, upgraded and scaled on NRDP (Netflix Ready Device Platform), for partners like LG, Samsung, Realtek and MediaTek and for teams across Netflix. Today that journey is spread across many legacy tools. We're turning it into one smooth experience and making device data Netflix can rely on. On the way we're automating the trickiest certification workflows, building the device data platform, and modernizing the older systems underneath it all. 


The team consists of 14 engineers, 12 are based in Warsaw, and 2 in Taiwan close to our partners. Our stakeholders are spread across the US, Brazil, Europe and Asia.


What you'll do

You'll be DeCap's technical leader. We're looking for someone who already operates at Staff level, and will bring the experience in the team.

  • Lead with a product mindset. Get to know our partners, users and business well enough to spot the opportunities that matter. Be a true partner to the Product, Design and Engineering manager: shape the roadmap together, make the tough trade-offs, and connect business and technical strategy into one plan. Validate ideas quickly through prototypes and experiments, working closely with users, Product and Design.
  • Shape our AI vision. Assess where we are today, identify where agentic AI can bring the most value in our product and in how we plan, build, test and operate, and drive adoption step by step, together with the team. Establish what works as shared best practices and scale them across the whole team.
  • Own your decisions. Take ownership without waiting for direction, identify what matters most and drive it forward. Make clear, well-reasoned decisions under ambiguity, seek input from the right people without waiting for consensus, own the outcome, and course-correct quickly when new information comes up.
  • Set the technical strategy. Turn a complex, legacy-heavy landscape into a clear technical vision with concrete steps. Evolve it step by step and deliver consistently, with each iteration bringing clear, well-reasoned value to the business or to the team's operations and efficiency. Bring deep expertise in domain data modelling, schema design, API contracts and clear domain boundaries with other teams.
  • Mentor and raise the bar. Be a natural multiplier who grows the engineers around you. Help engineers become stronger technical owners through design reviews, pairing and hands-on guidance. Share knowledge generously through clear docs and tech talks. Set and model high engineering standards, and build a culture where engineers challenge each other's ideas and learn from them.

We are looking for candidates who

  • Have already led big, multi-team, multi-quarter efforts in a complex domain, bringing strong engineers to agreement.
  • Think in systems. You're strong at domain modelling, schema design and long-lived API contracts, and you've untangled a legacy architecture without stopping the train.
  • Are a strong backend engineer on the JVM (Java or Kotlin, Spring Boot), GraphQL, gRPC and with the distributed systems, and comfortable enough across the stack to make good end-to-end calls.
  • Get curious about the "why". You dig into the domain, the users and the business, and spot connections.
  • Don't wait to be told what to do. You find what matters, get the right input, decide, and adjust quickly when you learn something new.
  • Use AI every day and have built or shipped something AI or agentic yourself. Also have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.
  • Make the people around you better and set a bar for the team.
  • Enjoy collaboration with people across the US, Europe and Asia, and like seeing your team in our Warsaw office a few days a week.

Bonus if you have experience with

  • Data platforms: analysing complex data relationships, finding patterns and simplifying the underlying models.
  • Building test frameworks, automation tools, CI/CD or developer platforms used by other engineers.
  • Driving technical standards or initiatives that reached beyond a single team.
  • If you have experience and passion for devices: TVs, set-top boxes, chipsets - you'll feel great on our team.

Why DeCap?

Your work shapes how Netflix ships to every TV in the world. You'll own the stack end to end, from backend and data to UI, with deep product context and plenty of challenges. In the team, we have lunch together, laugh a lot, celebrate the wins, help each other through the hard parts, and give each other honest feedback.

This role will focus on building measurement products for customers that utilize various experimentation and incrementality methodologies so they can isolate the causal impact Netflix’s ad campaigns have on their media objectives. These customers include advertisers and agencies, as well as third party partners such as measurement or other ad tech vendors.

This PM will:

  • Partner with engineering, user experience and data science teams to launch experimentation and incrementality measurement products that meet the needs of advertisers, agencies, third-party measurement vendors, and other ad tech providers

  • Prioritize the product roadmap, managing near-term product delivery while formulating a long-term product strategy to provide the most relevant and innovative measurement to Netflix’s advertisers

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in sales, solutions engineering, measurement analysts, ad operations, marketing, strategy, policy, and legal to bring products to market and increase adoption

  • Be an expert on the methodologies of our growing experimentation and incrementality measurement suite, including Conversion Lift, Brand Lift, A/B Testing, Multi-armed bandit algorithms, Search Lift and Geo Lift

  • Strong experimental design & causal inference knowledge: randomization, power analysis, sample size determination, MDE, holdout methodology design, statistical significance, confidence intervals

  • Delivered a roadmap and executed on ads experimentation and incrementality measurement products

  • Has experience collaborating closely with advertisers, agencies, measurement partners, and publisher sales and measurement analyst teams

We are looking for a stunning Senior Analytics Engineer to join the team. In this role, you will partner with product managers, business teams, and other Data Science & Engineering colleagues to design metrics, develop analytic tools, and perform analyses that power content media operations at scale. Your analytical insights will help steer global media production strategy, identify fruitful ways to innovate content creation, and measure the impact of innovation bets – driving scale economies and even better creative storytelling across our diverse content slate.


As a Senior Analytics Engineer in this space, you will:

  • Be a strategic thought partner for Content & Business Product PMs, Content Operations teams, and AI Strategy & Innovation leaders, developing and executing new measurement frameworks that quantify how GenAI-powered and other media creation innovations drive improvements in operational efficiency and creative flexibility
  • Drive the direction of your work, developing solutions that span from scrappy code and prototype tools to high-visibility dashboards and analyses for Business and Product & Tech leadership 
  • Establish and maintain strong partnerships with a variety of business, product, and data-oriented stakeholders, working directly with them to introduce and influence data-informed ways of working
  • Collaborate with other Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers to source and model data from the content production workflow, strengthen our foundational data models, and identify ways to integrate insights that improve creative decision-making throughout the content creation workflow

About you

  • 8+ years of demonstrated experience with data wrangling, data analysis, metric visualization, and data storytelling to both technical and non-technical product and business stakeholders
  • An expert in the standard tech stack (i.e., SQL, Python) and intuitive dashboard/visualization design using common data visualization tools (i.e., Plotly, Streamlit)
  • Eager to dive into new spaces, defining measurement from the ground up for new technology - an exceptionally curious self-starter energized by ambiguity and able to thrive with minimal oversight and process
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills coupled with strong business acumen
  • You independently connect the dots across business problems
  • You are known for developing and deepening strong relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders. You have experience partnering closely with executive leadership, with a proven track record of influencing strategic decisions through data
  • Netflix culture resonates with you

title: Sr. Sales Partner (Nordics)
locations: Stockholm, Sweden
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

 As our business grows, we’re bringing the ads plan to even more members around the world. Starting in 2027, Netflix’s ads plan will expand to several new countries, including Ireland, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, the Netherlands and Belgium, giving members more plan options and advertisers more opportunities to reach our audience. We are looking for team members who will be instrumental in shaping this quickly evolving business area for Netflix, including a Senior Sales Partner in Sweden to help shape our sales strategy for Netflix in the Nordics. 

As the Senior Sales Partner in Sweden, you will be responsible for helping lead the development and execution of the programmatic sales strategy for the Nordics. 

The role will involve developing business with senior stakeholders at major agency holding groups and building key client relationships with C-level, VP, and Director contacts within those portfolios. You will be tasked with jointly driving Netflix Advertising opportunities with key Agency partners and Client leaders as well as internal teams (Account Management, among others).  

You will be accountable for delivering revenue targets by leveraging Netflix's unique audience insights and premium content offerings, working closely with our Measurement Leads to develop the best-in-class measurement solutions to meet our Clients’ needs. The role will also be a focal point for driving the necessary internal developments to ensure our success. Proven expertise in effectively working with cross-functional collaboration with Go-to-Market (GTM) and commercial teams will be crucial.

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the programmatic advertising ecosystem, an established network of relationships, and a track record of building new market relationships and delivering meaningful revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive strategic agency partnerships to achieve revenue targets and exceed client expectations for the Nordics market.

  • Build, maintain and drive strong relationships with major Agency Holding groups and related Agencies to secure ad partnerships, drive agency deal making and revenue growth.

  • Help develop sales strategies and sales plans for the assigned Account portfolio and develop long-term relationships with key senior Clients.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful delivery of programmatic-driven advertising — “always on” — campaigns.

  • Leverage Netflix's unique audience insights and premium content offerings to drive revenue growth.

  • Monitor market trends, and competitor activity and identify opportunities for innovation.

We’re Looking for:

  • At least 10 years of experience in advertising or media (including sales) with a proven track record of delivering revenue growth, ideally within the Nordics, preferably within the Danish market.

  • Proficiency in a Nordic language, preferably Danish, and English to a business level 

  • Experience in digital advertising sales including programmatic (specifically PMP driven sales) is a must.

  • Deep understanding of the Media Agencies/Holding Companies and an established network of relationships at the senior level within them.

  • Entrepreneurial approach, with a track record of independently identifying opportunities, driving initiatives, and taking ownership of business outcomes.

  • Strong knowledge of marketing and communication objectives and pillars

  • Ability to move easily from strategic thinking to operational tasks

  • Open to the challenge of starting a new business, comfortable with risk, uncertainty and ambiguity.

| Production Innovation

Our Production Innovation team drives industry innovation, sets technical standards, and provides direct production support across Netflix's global slate. We support creative teams, crews, post facilities, and internal partners - from capture through delivery - ensuring our workflows balance creative ambition with technical excellence. Beyond support, we actively explore emerging opportunities in AI, imaging/sound, and production technology, always grounded in real-world filmmaking practice.

| Role Overview

We are seeking a Director, Production Innovation to build and lead the team responsible for identifying, piloting, and scaling emerging production technology across APAC - including generative AI, on-set tools, and VFX/imaging workflow innovation. This leader sets the innovation roadmap, manages a team of technology managers (including the GenLab and GenTech), and is the primary point of contact with Product, Legal, and Content Operations to turn field pilots into org-wide guidance and standards. You bring a strong point of view on where technology can genuinely improve creative and production outcomes, the judgment to say no to hype, and the leadership skill to build a team that filmmakers and production partners trust.

| Key Responsibilities

  • Set and own the Production Innovation roadmap and prioritization across APAC, balancing AI, imaging, sound, and emerging technology opportunities against production impact.

  • Lead and grow the team, including direct management of the GenLab, GenTech, Production Technology, and other innovation roles - setting goals, coaching, and developing talent.

  • Partner with production and content leadership, directors, producers, and external creative leads to identify where new technology can meaningfully improve creative quality, speed, or cost.

  • Own the pilot-to-standard pipeline: run structured pilots, evaluate outcomes against traditional methods, and convert what works into scalable guidance, training, and vendor recommendations.

  • Represent the APAC Production with COI, Product, and legal, ensuring new workflows meet copyright, IP, and data security standards before they scale.

  • Build and maintain relationships across the vendor, studio, and talent ecosystem, spanning both generative and traditional production technologies.

  • Report progress, risk, and resourcing needs to senior leadership, and make the call on where to invest, pause, or kill a given pilot.

  • Champion field feedback from production teams into product and process improvements.

| Qualifications

Required:

  • 15+ years of experience in film/series/gaming/VFX production, including prior people leadership.

  • Demonstrated track record leading teams through the adoption of new production technology (AI or otherwise) - not solely an individual-contributor background.

  • Strong grasp of end-to-end production and post (from development and previs through VFX turnover, conform/online, and delivery), and where technology intersects with each stage.

  • Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools as well as core production tools (Unreal Engine, Adobe Premiere), but not limited to.

  • Excellent executive communication skills; able to translate technical and creative tradeoffs for senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners.

  • Experience managing cross-functional partners (Product, Legal, Content Operations) and external vendor ecosystems.

Preferred:

  • Degree in design, film, technology, or a related field.

  • Experience building a team or function from the ground up.

  • Regional experience across APAC production markets.

  • Familiarity with copyright, IP, and data security considerations in AI-driven workflows.

  • Track record establishing vendor and freelance talent relationships in emerging production technology.

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Title and Launch Management (TLM) team is responsible for building and innovating the technology foundations that enable the ingest, setup, launch, and global distribution of all types of entertainment on Netflix—including series, movies, games, ads, live events, trailers, and more. TLM acts as the bridge between the title creation lifecycle and the consumer experience, ensuring that launching titles on Netflix is efficient, flexible, accurate, and scalable. Our team’s goal is to make launching titles as seamless as possible, supporting both operational and creative needs across the company.

The TLM Data Science and Engineering team drives automation and operational excellence in how we launch content. The team owns the data foundations, measurement workflows, reporting, and observability tooling, as well as AI/agentic solutions that make title launches faster, more automated, and less error‑prone from ingest through to being live and healthy on service. We develop systems that identify and classify issues,  automate resolution across a broad set of teams and systems, apply reasoning to identify risk, and increasingly, automate launch decisions.

What you will do

  • Oversee a diverse portfolio of end-to-end initiatives that advance Netflix’s title launch strategy and support our rapidly growing content slate.

  • Lead the team in developing rigorous, scalable evaluation pipelines and safety guardrails to monitor launch speed, content and format diversity, technical spec compliance, and risk across our global catalog; analyze production failures and drive systematic improvements to model and workflow reliability.

  • Guide the team in designing feedback loops and data infrastructure that continuously bring high-quality real-user data into evaluation and training pipelines to improve performance over time.

  • Coach, hire and develop a team of machine learning scientists, analytics engineers, and data engineers, fostering an agile, high-quality development culture grounded in robust software engineering practices.

  • Partner closely with Product Management, Launch Operations, Partner Integration Managers, and multiple Engineering teams to identify opportunities, shape strategy, define roadmaps, drive execution, and deliver well-structured rollout plans.

  • Cultivate durable partnerships across product, engineering, and operations; communicate complex ideas clearly to various audiences; connect the dots across teams; and influence priorities beyond your immediate domain to jointly deliver outcomes.

  • Foster a culture of ownership and timely, reliable delivery against the roadmap while acting as a trusted technical advisor who balances business goals with strong engineering practices and continuous improvement.

  • Create an environment where everyone feels empowered, accepted, and respected, and where diverse perspectives are actively encouraged and valued.

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years of direct management experience shipping production-grade AI/ML software with measurable business impact, building and managing high-performing, inclusive teams, attracting top talent, fostering accountability, and ensuring all voices inform decisions.

  • Proficiency in software engineering fundamentals and LLMs, RAG, and agentic architectures

  • Strong track record of designing and implementing evaluation pipelines for AI/ML products. Experience building safety guardrails to manage business risk and feedback loops for continuous improvement of models

  • Familiarity with ML evaluation methodologies (e.g., offline metrics, online experiments, human evaluation) and integrating them into continuous improvement processes.

  • Experience introducing automation into an established operational workflow earning operator trust, designing the human-in-the-loop handoff, and managing the change with the teams whose work is being automated.

  • Cultivate open communication, empowering team members to give feedback and recognize achievements and growth areas.

  • Strong product mindset; can translate high-level goals into clear team priorities and plans.

  • Skilled at prioritizing and aligning team efforts with business objectives, able to adjust direction based on impact and new information.

  • Effective collaborator who builds productive cross‑functional partnerships with product and engineering.

  • Uses data, feedback, and small experiments to reduce ambiguity and make sound decisions.

  • Communicates clearly with their team, stakeholders, and global partners.

Nice to have

  • Experience in the media technology domain (e.g. content processing, digital asset workflows, creative tools)

  • Technical proficiency with hands-on experience across the AI/ML lifecycle—ranging from traditional frameworks and MLOps platforms (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Metaflow) to modern LLM orchestration, agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, DSPy, Agent SDK), and vector databases.

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


The Role


The Content Promotion & Distribution team is responsible for designing the suite of products that power a show’s journey from ingestion to streaming.  We build products to help Netflix and our partners plan, ingest, decorate, launch, and promote the best content to our members at a global scale. From artwork to collections, synopses to ratings, the team shapes much of what members see and feel, powering a nuanced promotion and discovery engine that leaves every member feeling that Netflix was crafted just for them. 


We leverage vast data sets and cutting-edge AI technology to improve operational workflows, scale our catalog capabilities, and distribute at speed. We design products that bring insights and intelligence to creatives’ fingertips, enhancing their ability to make the best possible content and consumer member experiences. We own the global catalog, foundational elements that take raw media and decorate it with metadata, artwork, trailers, synopses, subs, dubs - our technology fuels one of the world’s most powerful entertainment platforms, ensuring that great stories can come from anywhere and be loved everywhere. 


The Product Manager for Scaled Content Systems will partner with Engineering, Operations, and Design to build and scale the platforms, services, and tools powering the content lifecycle—while resisting the temptation to treat every new deal as a bespoke one-off. This is a pivotal moment for the business. We are reimagining the media lifecycle from ingest to play and moving from high-touch workflows to AI-powered, automated workflows, with exceptions that require human oversight. You will play a key role in shaping this evolution. Just as importantly, you will be a close product partner to the domain teams who run these workflows, turning their hardest problems into a durable product strategy. 

We have launched the first suite of products, but we are far from done. This is a high-leverage role with direct impact on the speed, quality, and cost with which content reaches members around the world.


In This Role You Will:

  • Set the strategy: define and drive the product vision for programmatic, scaled ingestion by investing in solutions that reduce manual effort, enable differentiated distribution workflows, and accelerate time-to-launch across a range of content types. 
  • Own the products that make delivering media to Netflix effortless: unified direct delivery via APIs, web portals, and standards-based feeds; spec-agnostic ingestion; partner onboarding and permissioning.
  • Lead the path to automated publishing: work with domain PMs to simplify the path between ingestion and launch — automation as the default launch path, an extensible catalog architecture that lets new content bets evolve safely, and reliable fulfillment across the platforms and systems the business depends on.
  • Partner with key cross-functional teams: act as the primary product partner to deal with partnership teams; translate deal terms into a prioritized backlog to invest in foundational capabilities. Work with partner domains to streamline asset workflows and launches.
  • Communicate with clarity: use crisp written and verbal communication to provide context to stakeholders ranging from individual engineers to senior leadership, and to uncover new areas of opportunity.

Your Background Includes:

  • 10+ years of product management experience for b2b or b2c focused products
  • A track record of shipping complex technical or platform products ideally in content supply chain, media processing, ingestion/distribution pipelines, workflow orchestration, developer/partner platforms, or large-scale operational systems.
  • Strong systems thinking and technical acumen: comfortable reasoning about pipelines, APIs, data models, automation, and the trade-offs between speed, quality, cost, and risk. You don't need to code, but you should work deeply with engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with operational teams and translate operational realities into product strategy and roadmap.
  • Data-driven analysis and decision-making, with excellent judgment and prioritization in ambiguous, high-scale environments.
  • Experience building automation- or ML/AI-powered products that reduce manual effort at scale is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating across engineers, designers, data scientists, and business partners in a highly cross-functional, matrixed organization.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, including the ability to present technical content to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in media, entertainment, or streaming is a strong plus.

What We Offer:

  • Meaningful impact. The systems you own are foundational to how hundreds of millions of members experience Netflix — and to how efficiently the business operates.
  • Responsibility. Netflix offers true transparency and autonomy. Our culture is unique and is key to how we innovate.
  • Stunning colleagues. You'll work with high-performing peers across product, engineering, and operations who value collaboration and from whom you can learn.

The Role

Behind every title a member streams is a complex content supply chain. Title Launch Management (TLM) is the team that helps design the systems and workflows that bring content, metadata, and rights into Netflix, validate and process them, and orchestrate their path all the way to launch on service. As Netflix expands into new content types and deal structures, this is the team that enables the business to move faster across a growing diversity of partners, formats, and volumes.

We are looking for a strong product leader to serve as Group Product Manager for the TLM Product. You will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap across a portfolio spanning content ingestion pipelines, content distribution and delivery, and the internal platform and tooling that our operations teams rely on every day. Your charter is anchored in three principles: make delivering to Netflix the easiest part of a partner's day, simplify the path between ingestion and publish, and manage risk instead of titles and assets. 

Your team of Product Managers partners with Engineering, Operations, and Design to build and scale the platforms, services, and tools that move content through the business — while resisting the temptation to treat every new deal as a bespoke one-off. Just as importantly, you will be a close product partner to the operational teams who run these workflows, turning their hardest problems into a durable product strategy. This is a high-leverage role with direct impact on the speed, quality, and cost with which content reaches members around the world.

In this role, you will:

  • Set the strategy: define and drive the multi-quarter product vision for TLM, connecting ingestion, distribution, and platform investments to measurable reductions in manual intervention and turnaround time across content archetypes.

  • Own the products that make delivering to Netflix effortless: unified direct delivery via APIs, web portals, and standards-based feeds; spec-agnostic ingestion; partner onboarding and permissioning; metadata capture; and automated asset evaluation and QC.

  • Lead distribution & the path to publish: own the orchestration that simplifies the path between ingestion and launch — automation as the default launch path, an extensible catalog architecture that lets new content bets evolve safely, and reliable fulfillment to the platforms and systems the business depends on.

  • Partner with operations and key cross-functional team: act as the primary product partner to operational teams; translate operational pain points into a prioritized backlog and pair operational KPIs (turnaround time, launch readiness, issues per launch, manual steps reduced) with product investment. Work with partner domains to streamline asset workflows and launches.

  • Lead and grow a team: hire, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers; set clear goals, raise the bar on product craft, and create the conditions for your PMs to do the best work of their careers.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment: partner across Rights, Encoding Technologies, Localization, Content Foundations, Member Product, and Operations to sequence dependencies, drive effective debate, and land crisp decisions.

  • Communicate with clarity: use top-notch written and verbal communication to provide context to stakeholders ranging from individual engineers to senior leadership, and to uncover new areas of opportunity.

Your Background Includes:

  • 10+ years of product management experience for b2b focused products

  • A track record shipping complex technical or platform products ideally in content supply chain, media processing, ingestion/distribution pipelines, workflow orchestration, developer/partner platforms, or large-scale operational systems.

  • Strong systems thinking and technical acumen: comfort reasoning about pipelines, APIs, data models, automation, and the trade-offs between speed, quality, cost, and risk. You don't need to code, but you should work deeply with engineering.

  • Demonstrated ability to partner with operational teams and translate operational realities into product strategy and roadmap.

  • Data-driven analysis and decision-making, with excellent judgment and prioritization in ambiguous, high-scale environments.

  • Experience building automation- or ML/AI-powered products that reduce manual effort at scale is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated experience collaborating across engineers, designers, data scientists, and business partners in a highly cross-functional, matrixed organization.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, including the ability to present technical content to non-technical audiences.

  • People leadership with experience developing talent, giving candid feedback, and elevating the craft of the PMs around them.

  • Experience in media, entertainment, or streaming is a strong plus.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful impact. The systems you own are foundational to how hundreds of millions of members experience Netflix — and to how efficiently the business operates.

  • Responsibility. Netflix offers true transparency and autonomy. Our culture is unique and is key to how we innovate.

  • Stunning colleagues. You'll work with high-performing peers across product, engineering, and operations who value collaboration and from whom you can learn.

  • This role is open to remote working model on the West Coast. Must be willing to travel to LA or Los Gatos consistently and be located on the West Coast region of the United States.

Department: Tax Operations

Reports to: Senior Manager, Tax Operations - US Indirect Tax 

The Role


Netflix's US Indirect Tax ("ITX") team manages transaction taxes collected from customers and remitted to state and local governments — including sales, use, amusement, communication services, and admissions taxes — as well as property tax, business license tax, and certain gross receipts taxes.

We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented US Indirect Tax Senior Analyst to own compliance, audit, analytical, and research work across multiple tax types. The ideal candidate has extensive compliance and audit experience and is a self-starter with strong organizational, communication, and process improvement skills.  This is a hands-on role for someone who can successfully execute multiple priorities in parallel, is highly detail-oriented in calculations and writing, and identifies and implements process improvements. 


Responsibilities

  • Manage sales and use tax audits from notice through resolution, including data gathering, workpaper preparation, exposure analysis, and correspondence with state and local auditors.
  • Prepare and review sales/use, gross receipts, business license, and other transaction taxes compliance filings across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Perform Month End accounting reviews, including preparing journal entries for tax reclassification and completing account reconciliations.
  • Gather and review information for Unclaimed Property Compliance, including coordinating data deliverables from AP, Payroll, and Production Finance.
  • Assist in personal and real property tax compliance, including valuation review and coordination with outside property tax consultants (e.g., appeal filings and support).
  • Support personal and real property tax audits, including responding to information requests and evaluating assessment notices.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across audit and compliance workflows — including automation opportunities — to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.
  • Research and analyze technical indirect tax issues (e.g., nexus, taxability, sourcing) and summarize conclusions for the team and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and outside advisors on process improvement projects, audit strategy, business support, and compliance matters.
  • Maintain clear, audit-ready documentation and workpapers to support internal review, SOX testing, and external audit requests.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, is required.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in state and local/indirect tax, including sales/use tax audit and compliance work.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience working with large transactional data sets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage competing audit and compliance deadlines and an array of competing priorities.
  • A track record of identifying and driving process improvement in indirect tax operations.

title: Character Modeler - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Vancouver, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:

Are you interested in working on Netflix Animation Studios’ next animated feature with our highly talented team of artists? We are looking for Character Modeling Artists who love building appealing stylised characters from strong proportions and clean forms to production-ready topology and UVs. Experience with Marvelous Designer is a plus. This role is focused on creating complete production-ready character models for our upcoming projects. 

What You’ll Do:

  • Interpret 2D designs and translate them into 3D space while maintaining the original artistic intent. 

  • Produce complex or stylised character models to a high standard with a strong understanding of appeal, silhouette, proportion, shape and scale.

  • Produce accurate UVs for models for use in downstream departments. 

  • Produce highly optimised meshes with clean production-ready topology that can be rendered and displayed efficiently for downstream departments such as Rigging, Layout and Lighting.

  • Assume responsibility for ensuring assigned work is produced to the appropriate standard quality within the scheduled timeframe and deadline. 

  • Maintain good communication with the Leadership team.

What You’ll Need:

  • 3+ years’ experience modelling within a VFX or Animated Feature pipeline 

  • Proficiency with Maya and ZBrush 

  • Experience with Marvelous Designer 

  • Strong understanding of character appeal, silhouette, proportion, and shape language

  • Solid understanding of proper edge flow and polygon density 

  • Solid understanding of the topology for static and deforming objects 

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to abstract and interpret design down to its fundamentals 

  • Strong organizational and time management skills 

What you’ll need to include on your application: 

Turntables, with wireframes, of character and creature models 

This role is based in Vancouver, British Columbia. Hybrid Role (Minimum of 3 days a week in the office).

title: Manager, Consumer Products - Japan
locations: Tokyo, Japan
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

We are looking to build a Consumer Products (CP) team to help grow member joy and engagement around key titles by developing new ways for our members and fans to interact with Netflix.

We are pursuing consumer products because we believe it will drive meaningful show awareness/buzz with more tangible, curated ways to interact with our most popular content and ultimately, drive long-term revenue. Ideally, our products connect members to our content, and each other, by bringing their favorite stories to real life. 

This role requires someone to take on the responsibility of creating and executing Netflix consumer products licensing and title/IP strategy for Japan, based on the Netflix originals and licensed content slate. This role will report to the Director of Consumer Products, Japan, and will be based in Tokyo, Japan.

Responsibilities

  • Own licensing strategy for all CP categories in Japan, while collaborating with the cross-regional CP teams on global partnerships.

  • Develop title and category strategy in partnership with Content and go-to-market plans by title (consumer, trade, and retail marketing) with Partners, achieving a balance between driving consumer demand (a proxy for fan joy) and delivering meaningful revenue. 

  • Lead all Japan-related CP efforts and communications internally across Netflix and proactively drive ex-Japan business opportunities for Japan content in partnership with global and regional stakeholders.

  • Be an internal and external champion of the opportunity and vision with regards to our licensing strategy and push for innovation in partner selection, product development, line planning, business models, strategic partnerships,  etc.

  • Develop and implement an activation strategy for cross-channel/category growth in Japan (including e-commerce).

  • Build relationships across the creative collaborator community and be our pulse of product trend culture in Japan. 

  • Manage and build agencies' relationships in Japan.

  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional teams.

What we are looking for:

  • Demonstrated,12+ years of experience in building and owning the end-to-end licensing and/or retail function at a reputable brand (entertainment studio, retailer, gaming, agency). Cross-functional, brand partnership/strategy or general management experience is also welcome.

  • Experience creating and driving end-to-end strategy to build up new businesses from scratch.

  • Ability to work with and innovate in new sales channels and business models. 

  • Robust knowledge of the licensing landscape with a strong network in the Japanese licensing & retail landscape.

  • Experience and knowledge of Anime and Japanese content rights is a plus.

  • Experience and knowledge of Softline; apparel/fashion and promotion tie-up is a plus.

  • Experience in different key categories, including softlines and hardlines, is a plus.

The Screening Specialist owns end-to-end execution of physical and virtual screenings across APAC, acting as the technical and vendor-management expert who ensures every screening meets Netflix's quality bar, on time and on brand. This is a hands-on, in-market role requiring strong cross-functional relationship skills and hands-on project management, supported by technical screening expertise.

  • Own end-to-end execution of physical and virtual screenings, including DCP/KDM ingest, subtitle and audio configuration, and onsite or remote technical support.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Publicity, Events, Post Production, and Awards on timing, asset readiness, and market-specific requirements (e.g. classification, versioning).

  • Build and manage vendor relationships across APAC, ensuring reliance on vendors; while helping diversify and strengthen the local vendor bench in each country.

  • Serve as the primary screening project point of contact, navigating language, quality, delivery and stakeholder complexity independently.

Requirements - Must Have

  • Strong project and time management, including composure under reactive, short-notice timelines.

  • Comfortable operating independently in-market; will often be the only Screenings presence in India day to day.

  • Cross-functional collaboration skills: this role sits at the intersection of Publicity, Events, and Post Production and needs to build trust with all three.

  • Stakeholder & Reputation Management: SME support for cross-functional enquiries; filmmaker/executive alignment on sensitive quality conversations.

Requirements - Preferred

  • Hands-on technical experience in DCI (Digital Cinema Initiatives) and AV: DCP, QC, tech check, and KDM technical understanding, plus real-time pass/fail judgment on site.

  • On-Site Execution: technical producing, day-of-event communication management, on-site vendor accountability.

  • Ability to read and enforce precise digital cinema equipment calibration standards.

  • Business acumen and a "quality gatekeeper" mindset, treating technical execution as a strategic contribution to campaign and awards outcomes, not just delivery.

  • Experience building or managing vendor relationships from scratch in a market, especially valuable given India's current vendor concentration risk.

  • Familiarity with festival or awards-season logistics.

  • Regional Operations: proven ability to manage multi-country logistics independently and adapt to local venue/market conditions.

What Success Looks Like

Screenings run smoothly and on-brand across all APAC markets; vendor relationships are proactively managed and diversified; and cross-functional partners see Screenings as a trusted, strategic partner, not just a technical service.

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Context / Summary: 

We are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable (AP) Operations Lead to support our Accounts Payable function. The AP Operations Lead will support our overall workflows and processes with a focus on operational efficiency, streamlined communication flow, and process improvements through exploration of new tools (i.e. AI technology) and automation workflows.  The right candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, excellent communication skills and a comprehensive understanding of accounts payments systems and processes.

Specifics of Role: 

The primary responsibilities of the AP Operations Lead role will be: 

Process Improvement

  • Continually evaluate current accounts payable processes and systems to identify opportunities for automation and increased efficiency

  • Drive improvements of Service Level Agreements (SLAs)/(Key Performance Indicators(KPIs) through continuous assessment of current processes

  • Design, propose and partner with AP or Finance Procurement Operations (FPO) team members to implement process changes achieving operational efficiencies as a best in class AP team.

  • Drive projects to evaluate AI and other tools to improve processes; support ongoing projects as needed

  • Gather AP requirements and partner with AP Business Analyst and FinTech to drive forward looking planning of AP system and tools 

  • Build or improve dashboards for real-time visibility into AP operations

Build Partnerships

  • Build trust as the subject matter expert on the Accounts Payable workflows, anticipating supplier and internal stakeholder needs to drive effective outcomes.

  • Serve as the point of contact (POC) for M&A process changes and escalations, partnering cross-functionally to evaluate, design and implement optimal processes. Document and communicate new processes as appropriate. 

  • Serve as a liaison between invoice processing and resolution specialists, BPs, and vendors (if necessary) to identify and drive resolution for recurring bottlenecks and operational challenges (e.g. recurring instances of invoices not flowing through OCR or regular payment overrides on invoices)

  • Partner with the AP Business Analyst to identify opportunities for improvement and develop the key criteria or data elements to track in order to build insightful metrics

  • Build presentations tailored to internal or external business partners and stakeholders in order to educate on AP processes, expectations, SLAs, etc.

  • Own communication on key initiatives or changes to suppliers

Month-End Close, Audit & Other

  • Own preparation and review of key AP reports, including aging reports, accruals and other metrics as appropriate. 

  • Own month-end close process, including communications to notify internal stakeholders of processing and payment timelines and management of the month-end close AP calendar

  • Support audits and coordinate with AP team, AP leaders and Internal Audit on documentation requests, process walkthrough, documentation reviews, and other tasks as appropriate

  • Provide back-up to Payment processing specialist (or other functions depending on business critical needs)

  • Own the AskAP DL, determine and manage response SLAs and serve as a POC for vendor and internal stakeholder communication

Skills and Competencies: 

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in accounts payable end-to end process, including invoice processing & review, payments, risk management and process improvement

  • Strong understanding of accounts payable principles, practices and regulations on a global scale and within region of focus

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Passionate about building strong partnerships with colleagues and working together toward a common goal 

  • Strong understanding of SOX compliance rules and regulations

  • Organized, with exceptional attention to detail and adherence to timelines

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, ability to create memos and adjust level of detail based on the audience

  • Deep curiosity and passion for operational processes, automation and process improvement

  • Ability to partner with technical teams and identify potential bottlenecks

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $120,000.00 - $200,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

title: Workplace Manager (DC)
locations: Washington DC, District of Columbia, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Opportunity:

As part of the Global Enterprise Operations (EO) team, we are seeking a Workplace Manager to lead the team for one of our corporate offices in Washington DC. As a Workplace Manager, you are the Informed Captain of your site. You don't just manage a building; you are accountable for overall Workplace outcomes and the end-to-end employee experience. You operate as a strategic peer to local business leaders. You are the "Center of the Hub," integrating functional expertise from Workplace Leadership and the wider Enterprise Operations (EO) ecosystem into a seamless workplace experience. Your success is measured by the health of your site's sentiment, the strength of your stakeholder relationships, and your ability to govern world-class vendor performance.

This role exists to replace traditional hands-on building oversight with an elevated business leader who integrates the full operational ecosystem. This role ensures local workspace environments dynamically adapt to evolving business strategies, protect financial run-rates, and keep employee sentiment consistently high.

The role:

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Operate as the primary Workplace point of contact for local leadership. Understand their business strategy and connect business intel with proactively and fiscally responsibly adapting the environment to support their team's productivity. Develop and manage a strong communication strategy on all levels to ensure cohesive stakeholder engagement, sharing any process change, service enhancement, or workplace-related impact.

  • Strategic Site Ownership: Own the site's operational budget and long-term roadmap. You make the high-level trade-offs between "Foundations of Excellence" (basics) and "Differentiators" (culture-enhancing activations).

  • Vendor Governance: Instead of managing tasks, you govern outcomes. You hold our strategic vendor partners accountable to ambitious SLAs, ensuring they operate with proactivity and Netflix-quality standards.

  • Strong Enterprise Operations Relationships: Lead the integrated workplace approach by effectively partnering with EO functional partners to ensure a unified one team front to the business and employees. You will collaborate and align with cross-functional partners such as AV, Ntech Ops, Corporate Events, Internal Comms, Security Operations, and Systems to ensure we constantly provide a frictionless, safe, and secure workplace and respond to incidents that will occur 24/7.

  • Budget Ownership: You own your site budget, meticulously managing associated prioritization and trade-offs.

  • Measurable Performance & Metrics: Track and drive key performance metrics, including employee sentiment scores, vendor SLA compliance benchmarks, and operational efficiency targets.

  • Office Expansion & Move: within the first 6 months: Step into an existing office build project, and subsequent move  in partnership with Program Delivery and other cross functional teams.

  • Event Execution: Partner with local business leadership to curate and support business driven events, for both internal and external guests

What We're Looking For: 

  • The Holistic Mindset: You are a business leader first and a workplace expert second. You can pivot from a financial budget review to a high-stakes business discussion with a VP.

  • Workplace Excellence: Your commitment to excellence begins with a focus on consistently delivering the fundamentals at the highest standard.

  • Accountability: You thrive as an Informed Captain. You use the 70% Global Standard as a foundation and own your 30% Local Nuance, acting decisively on local problems while proactively surfacing decisions that affect other markets.

Qualifications:

  • 5-7  years of workplace experience, with an emphasis on corporate hospitality, hotel management, and event execution.

  • Strong focus on senior stakeholder engagement and ability to build relationships at all levels.

  • Comfortable collaborating with diverse team members, including architects, building engineers, property management, project managers, and senior leadership.

  • High tolerance for change, and the capacity to problem-solve and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated experience in crisis management, emergency preparedness, and 24/7 workplace incident response.

  • Passionate about creating a great place for employees & visitors.

  • Excellent communication and organizational leadership skills.

  • Positive team-oriented, hands-on, adaptive, and client-focused attitude.

  • Proficiency in GSuite (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Slides), Slack, Zendesk (or other ticketing system), visitor management systems, space utilization tools, and security/badge access platforms.

  • Respect, understanding, and enthusiasm for the Netflix Culture.

To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $160,000.00 - $250,000.00.

title: Environment Modeling Lead - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Vancouver, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:

The Environment Modeling Lead is responsible for leading a team of environment modeling artists whilst working closely with the Supervisor to realize their vision, ensuring the standard and quality of work produced is consistently high.
 

What You’ll Do:

Creative Responsibilities

  • Ensure a high level of communication is maintained with the Supervisor and production management particularly where situations arise that may compromise the quality or scheduled delivery of material. This may include overseeing and reporting on particular aspects of a project and identifying and implementing solutions as problems arise.

  • Interpret 2D designs and translate them into 3D space by utilizing software such as Maya, ZBrush, or Houdini, all while maintaining the original artistic intent.

  • Assume responsibility for ensuring assigned work is produced to appropriate standard quality within the scheduled timeframe and deadline. 

  • Produce highly optimized meshes that can be rendered and displayed efficiently for downstream departments.

  • Produce accurate UVs for models for use in downstream departments.

  • Produce complex models to a high standard with a thorough understanding of shape, scale and form.

  • Work within/produce topology/wireframe.

  • Produce accurate UVs for models for use in downstream departments.

  • Produce highly optimized meshes that can be rendered and displayed efficiently for downstream departments such as Rigging, Layout and Lighting.

  • Regularly distribute and share knowledge to support the ongoing development of innovative tools and/or techniques for Modelling.

  • Interact with tracking systems and production staff.

Lead Duties

  • Leads a team under guidance from the Head of Environment, Environment Modeling Supervisor and production team.

  • Provide day‑to‑day leadership and work with Production and Artist Management to develop the skills and abilities of all artists in the team.

  • Mentor less‑experienced artists, providing both creative and technical guidance.

  • Understands the overall project brief and goals and communicates them clearly to each team member.

  • Delegates work responsibly to ensure the successful completion of shots across team members of all skill levels.

  • Drive team reviews and offer constructive, creative and technical feedback on work in progress.

  • Perform daily one‑on‑one rounds with artists to track progress and support problem‑solving.

  • Communicates production information to both the artists group and Production Management.

  • Participates in production pipeline problem-solving.

  • Documents new techniques and distributes updates to peers, crew and Production Management.

  • Prioritise and break down a project into organized parts.

  • Support open communication between your department, R&D and all other departments.

  • Work with the Environment Modeling Supervisor and production team to prepare bids and pitches as required.

  • Participate in the recruiting and interview process for new employees as required.

  • Assist Production Management in preparation of final show reports as required.

 This role is based in Vancouver, British Columbia. Hybrid Role (Minimum of 3 days a week in the office).

title: Production Manager - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Vancouver, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Production Manager to support our unannounced CG animated feature film.


What You’ll Do:

  • Oversee day-to-day and week-to-week production progress, maintaining visibility into the timely and efficient completion of the film.
  • Help ensure milestones and quotas are met, and provide schedule course-corrections and workflow optimizations as project needs evolve.
  • Establish and maintain departmental best practices and consistency across the show and across locations.
  • Partner closely with the Associate Producer, Producer, and VFX Supervisor to track film complexity, assess production needs, and support changing priorities.
  • Oversee the management of production calendars and support planning around key creative and production needs.
  • Ensure production data, materials, and metrics are accurately tracked and maintained, including through Flow Production Tracker, in order to identify risks and flag problem areas.
  • Troubleshoot schedule, workflow, and delivery challenges to support the timely completion of sequences.
  • Support day-to-day staff planning, including workload, overtime, and vacation management.
  • Work with Department Leaders, Artist Management, and Talent Development & Training to identify show-specific training needs and support implementation.
  • Lead with inclusivity, collaboration, and accountability, helping to create an environment where team members can do their best work.
  • Support the development of team members through clear expectations, feedback, and partnership with Production leadership and Artist Management.
  • Foster strong communication and collaboration across teams, departments, and locations, and provide regular updates to Production and Studio leadership on team progress, health, and priorities.
  • Partner closely with peers and studio teams to support an inclusive, innovative, and collaborative production environment.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Production Supervisor or in a similar production management role on feature films.
  • Strong knowledge of CG pipelines, workflows, and production management across CG departments.
  • Strong understanding of pre-production workflows, including storyboarding, editorial, and visual development.
  • Experience recruiting, training, and supervising production management staff.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to assess production challenges and make thoughtful decisions that support creative goals, schedule, and budget.
  • Ability to navigate competing priorities, shifting needs, and challenging situations with sound judgment.
  • Experience working cross-functionally and across locations in a collaborative production environment.

title: Sales Partner (Japan)
locations: Tokyo, Japan
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

As a Sales Partner for Netflix Ads in Japan, you will play a critical role in shaping and advancing our agency-driven revenue strategy in one of the world’s most sophisticated and dynamic advertising markets.

You will be the primary strategic interface between Netflix and our Agency partners—responsible for elevating day-to-day collaboration, optimizing operational workflows, and strengthening long-term commercial relationships that unlock sustained revenue growth.
You will work closely with senior sales partners and account managers, lots of cross functional teams and the broader sales ecosystem within our Agencies and Media Reps. Your mandate includes driving transparent communication on sales performance, deepening agency team understanding of Netflix Ads products, and jointly developing scalable processes that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our go-to-market approach.
The ideal candidate brings a sophisticated understanding of Japan’s agency landscape, exceptional relationship-building capabilities, and a proven ability to negotiate complex, multi-year commercial agreements. You will operate as both a strategic advisor and a trusted partner—shaping how agencies position Netflix Ads to their advertisers and ensuring our solutions deliver meaningful business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Agency & Media Rep Partnership Leadership

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day communication with Agency Holding Groups and Media Reps, ensuring transparency, responsiveness, and operational excellence.

  • Continuously assess sales performance, pipeline health, and revenue pacing with agency partners; identify gaps, risks, and acceleration opportunities through structured business reviews.

  • Build deep, trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders across agencies and Media Reps, including leadership in account management, planning, trading, and digital transformation.
     

Sales Acceleration & Product Evangelism

  • Drive the adoption and understanding of Netflix Ads platform capabilities within agency sales teams, ensuring they are equipped to position Netflix effectively to advertisers.

  • Develop and implement frameworks that streamline workflows and improve execution quality across briefing, planning, trafficking, measurement, and reporting processes.

  • Advocate for Netflix’s value proposition by leveraging audience insights, measurement assets, and premium content alignment to unlock new investment opportunities.
     

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with internal teams—including Sales/Account Management, Marketing Partnerships, Ads Marketing, Measurement, Product—to ensure flawless campaign delivery and exceptional client experience.

  • Provide market and partner feedback to global and regional leadership to continuously improve our product, operations, and go-to-market strategy.

  • Monitor evolving market dynamics, regulatory changes, and competitive activity to identify emerging opportunities and risks.

What We’re Looking For

  • Approximately 8+ years of experience in advertising sales, agency management, or media partnership roles within Japan’s advertising ecosystem.

  • Deep understanding of Agency structures, Media Rep business models, and advertiser decision-making processes in Japan.

  • Proven track record of building and scaling strategic relationships with agency leadership and executing long-term commercial negotiations.

  • Ability to synthesize data, identify insights, and translate them into actionable strategies, revenue plans, and operational improvements.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing stakeholders from day-to-day practitioners to C-suite executives.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate autonomously, make decisions quickly, and execute with entrepreneurial speed.

  • Fluency in Japanese and English will be a strong plus.

  • Passion for entertainment, technology, and the evolution of Japan’s advertising landscape.

  • Alignment with Netflix’s culture of freedom and responsibility

If you are inspired by the opportunity to shape the future of advertising in Japan and thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment, we would love to hear from you. Come join us as we build the next chapter of Netflix Ads and help us entertain the world.

title: Senior Manager, Business Development - Rest of Asia (Taiwan & Hong Kong Operators / China CE Partnerships)
locations: Taipei City, Taiwan
Singapore, Singapore
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

In building and scaling our business across the Rest of Asia, we've established partnerships with leading mobile, broadband, and PayTV operators in Taiwan and Hong Kong (e.g. CHT Group, Taiwan Mobile, PCCW/CSL), as well as with the largest Mainland China consumer electronics manufacturers (e.g. Hisense, TCL, Xiaomi, Oppo) that ship smart TVs and mobile devices across the region and globally.

These partnerships help deliver Netflix in a consumer-friendly way - from bundling Netflix into a mobile or broadband plan, to prominent, durable placement on smart TVs and mobile devices - and have been essential to accelerating our global growth.

Chinese CE OEMs in particular are now among the largest and fastest-growing players in the global TV ecosystem, making them ever more strategic partners for Netflix.

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Business Development to grow our commercial partnerships with Taiwan/Hong Kong operators and Mainland China CE/mobile partners - building the strategic roadmap for these relationships, support structuring and commercial alignments in deals, and working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful launch and ongoing performance of these partnerships.

The role will report to the Director, Business Development - Rest of Asia, and will be based in Taipei or Singapore.

Responsibilities:

●You will forge and manage commercial partnerships with mobile, broadband, and PayTV operators in Taiwan and Hong Kong, building new bundles and promotions and deepening existing relationships to streamline Netflix membership and viewing in an efficient manner.

●You will lead commercial relationships with Mainland China consumer electronics and mobile manufacturers, and provide support in structuring and commercial alignments in device placement, promotional, and distribution agreements that maximize discovery, reach, and viewing for current and prospective members.

●You will develop and execute the partnership strategy and roadmap for this territory, identifying new bundling, distribution, and promotional opportunities, and prioritizing them based on business impact.

●You will own the deal lifecycle end-to-end - from business case development and support closing out commercial alignments to be reflected through contracting and ongoing account management - and will track partner performance against agreed goals.

●You will work closely with colleagues in Partner Engagement, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Finance to translate commercial agreements into successful technical integrations and go-to-market execution.

●You will analyze market data and competitive dynamics to identify trends and opportunities, and create compelling market and business analyses for internal leadership and partner-facing conversations.

●You will represent Netflix externally with senior partner stakeholders, and internally as part of the Rest of Asia Business Development and Partnerships team.

The ideal candidate:

● Minimum 12 years of experience in Business Development, partnerships, or commercial roles with a technology, telecom, consumer electronics, or media company

●Experience partnering with telecom operators, PayTV/ISPs, consumer electronics manufacturers, or adjacent industries, ideally in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and/or Mainland China

●Proven track record in structuring, negotiating, and closing commercial partnership agreements

●Deep understanding of the streaming video landscape and consumer behavior in Greater China markets

●Ability to work effectively with cross-functional leaders across Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Partner Engineering

●Experience drafting, negotiating, and closing term sheets and contracts

●Strong analytical and business-case skills; able to translate market data into strategy and clear recommendations

●Strong self-organization and prioritization abilities; comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy

●Fluent proficiency in Mandarin and English; Cantonese a plus
