title: Creative Merchandiser - Product, India
locations: Mumbai, India
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Team

The Product Merchandising team connects members to Netflix's world of entertainment by blending intuitive merchandising and market expertise to position, promote, and present content so members find it easy and enjoyable to choose what they'll love. We're blending global scale with deep local expertise, and we're looking for people who can bring both. 

The Role:

As a Creative Merchandiser, you shape the merchandising experience for Netflix members in your markets - across creative, editorial, and catalog dimensions. You are a platform-first impact driver: someone who shapes how the Netflix experience looks, reads, and feels for members in India across every surface, every content format, and every moment. 

What You'll Do:

Shape the Local Member Experience:


  • Lead distribution and promotion strategy for local title launches - from positioning and merchandising strategy through to post-launch performance.
  • Drive the local merchandising calendar - planning activations around title launches, cultural moments, seasonal trends, and member lifecycle milestones throughout the year.
  • Propose, develop and execute catalog activations (rows, hubs, custom promotions) that drive content discovery and reflect what resonates culturally with consumers in your market.
  • Develop messaging campaigns - push notifications, emails - that connect members to content they'll love, timed to the moments and titles that matter locally.
  • Editorialise catalog content beyond new launches to support member engagement, surfacing library titles and hidden gems at the right point in the member journey. Partner with cross functional stakeholders to drive business impact at the local level through this work.
  • Connect the dots between platform logic, consumer insights, and content strategy to drive strong merchandising activations and learning agendas. 
  • Apply deep awareness of local trends, social and cultural zeitgeist, and platform behavior to shape what gets surfaced, when, and how - in close partnership with Marketing and Comms.
  • Advocate for your market's needs in regional and global conversations, sharing context that cross-functional partners cannot access without you.
  • Work closely with Content, Marketing, Product teams, and external agency partners to proactively share context, surface trade-offs, and align on priorities to deliver a cohesive member experience.
  • Operate within global governance frameworks and playbooks, ensuring local activations complement the global calendar.
  • Act as the local intelligence layer to surface on-the-ground market insights and trends, and contribute to playbooks and standards that can be scaled across markets in partnership with local Consumer Insights and Content Strategy.

Creative & Editorial:

  • Briefing, curating and reviewing copy, image and video assets required for title/ catalog promotion on Product. Partner with local Marcomms teams on assets for priority titles, using external agencies where additional assets may be required. 
  • Ensure Product assets adhere to Netflix's standards for quality, consistency, and authenticity.
  • Operate within the global Merchandising Playbook while driving locally resonant decisions. 
  • Optimise consumer messaging (email, push, in-app notifications) that feels genuinely individual -tailored to member behavior and lifestyle signals.

Turn Data into insights to drive better experiences:


  • Partner with regional Performance Analyst and Technical Merchandising to monitor and report on activations at the local level. Ensure hypotheses created at the local level are reflected in data gathered post launch. 
  • Contribute to A/B testing and experimentation, using data, dashboards, analytics tools alongside qualitative market insight to continuously improve the member experience.
  • Think in business outcomes, not just creative outputs: track and communicate the impact of merchandising decisions on member engagement, viewing behavior, and platform health metrics to your peers and cross-functional partners.
  • Write clear, well-reasoned strategic briefs that articulate the business goal behind your activation decisions.
  • Fluency in business metrics and translating them to merchandising strategy. You understand the India  business inside out, think member-first, and know how to bridge both to achieve ambitious business impact. 
  • Work at pace: move from concept to live activation quickly while maintaining quality and intentionality.

What We're Looking For:

  • A proven ability to engage customers via digital promotional and/or merchandising tactics, driving product engagement in an authentic and culturally relevant manner. 
  • Deep cultural fluency across various regions in India and curiosity to learn about new ones. You understand what resonates, what's trending, and what members in your region respond to.
  • A strong track record of using data to make decisions - you're comfortable reading consumer insight studies, dashboards, spotting patterns, and translating insights into action.
  • Experience writing strategic briefs: you can define a problem clearly, build hypotheses, stress-test your own assumptions before making a recommendation with conviction, and bring stakeholders along.
  • Operational excellence: you're organised and accurate under high-volume, fast-moving conditions.
  • Think in systems: you instinctively connect content, members, product behavior, and market context into a coherent picture, and you know which questions to ask to fill in the gaps before forming a view.
  • A collaborative approach: you work well across functions, time zones, and seniority levels, and you know when to push back and when to align.
  • Genuinely love entertainment: you are an avid consumer of content across film, series, and beyond, and you bring real passion and taste to the work.
  • Native or full professional fluency in Hindi, Tamil/Telugu and English; mastery of English editorial and cultural standards.

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


Who are we?

Netflix is the world's leading streaming entertainment service with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, documentaries, feature films, and mobile games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can watch as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, on any internet-connected screen. It’s no secret that we want to entertain the world. To do that, we build teams with a mix of experience and fresh perspective. Emerging talent plays a big part in that, bringing new ideas that push us to keep growing. 


If you have a passion for solving challenging problems, we want to hear from you. Maybe you love learning how to build scalable, robust systems. Maybe you thrive working with the latest technologies in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve and ideas move quickly. And maybe the idea of making a global impact on software that over 300 million people use and love gets you fired up. If that sounds like you, we want to see your application!



Who are you?
- You’re a current, enrolled student pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or Statistics, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and Spring/Summer 2028. Minored in a technical field, or majoring in something non-technical while teaching yourself to code? We still want you to apply! 

- You’ve studied coursework or have relevant experience with data structures, algorithms, and debugging. Bonus points if you’ve completed at least one of these courses: Distributed Systems, Web Development, Mobile Development, Network or Application Security, Machine Learning, or AI.

- You’re eager to leverage AI to amplify your work. You use it to explore ideas, move faster, and sharpen your thinking, and you validate outputs before you trust them.

- You love exploring new solutions, and you’re willing to break things along the way to learn.

- You make confident decisions that are well thought out, and you’re willing to share your ideas and perspectives.

- You can work independently, and you know that asking a teammate for a fresh perspective is a strength, not a weakness.

- You do your best work alongside others and enjoy building as a team. You’re curious about how different people see a problem, and you let those ideas shape what you create.

- You’re a clear, concise communicator who tells a good story and tailors it to your audience.

- You’re passionate about Netflix’s mission to Entertain the World, and you believe you can thrive in our culture.


What could you learn to do?

- Build applications that solve complex business problems elegantly

- Create tools that are intuitive, engaging, and surface business insights for our partners

- Write high-quality, performant, industry-standard code

- Integrate scalable system design and architectural best practices into the development lifecycle

- Use AI tools to move faster on scoped engineering work, like understanding unfamiliar code, brainstorming approaches, drafting tests, and improving documentation

Netflix is a unique place to work and we live by our values, so it's worth learning more about our culture.


Internships are paid and are a minimum of 12 weeks, with a choice of a few fixed start dates in May or June 2027 to accommodate varying school calendars. Our summer internships will be located in our Los Gatos, CA office, or in our Los Angeles, CA office, depending on the team.

title: Senior Manager, Communications - Japan
locations: Tokyo, Japan
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Opportunity


At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode — pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom, and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition, and cutting-edge technology. 


Netflix's Communications team tells and protects the Netflix story — everything from our titles and talent to our products, partnerships, policy positions, culture, and executive voice. The team builds understanding and goodwill with both external and internal audiences, using earned media, executive storytelling, and internal channels to build engagement.


It's an amazing time to join the Netflix team in Japan as we continue to transform entertainment and bring Japan's stories to audiences around the world. Come be a part of what's next.

About the Role


We're looking for a Senior Manager to lead two distinct, high-visibility pillars of the Japan Communications team: Content Communications and Advertising Communications.

  • Content Communications: Own the communications strategy for a meaningful slice of Netflix's content storytelling in Japan — building narratives that connect Japanese titles, talent, and moments to audiences locally and globally. This spans both bringing Japanese stories to the world, like anime, and live programming here in Japan, across sports and music. The specific mix may evolve with the business. You'll partner with global and regional Comms, Publicity, and Content teams to build one coherent Japan-to-world narrative.
  • Ads Communications: Serve as the communications lead for Netflix's advertising business in Japan, translating our ad-tier and advertiser partnerships into a compelling business narrative for trade, business, and marketing media, and supporting leadership spokespeople in one of the world's largest advertising markets.

Like most content and business communications roles at this level, this one includes its share of issues management alongside the proactive storytelling work — you'll want good instincts for when something needs a fast, thoughtful response, and the judgment to know when to escalate versus handle it yourself.


Across both areas, you'll move comfortably between reactive press management and proactive, business-building storytelling, and partner seamlessly with Japan, APAC, and Global stakeholders across Content, Marketing, Publicity, Policy, Legal, and the business teams you support.


At the Senior Manager level, you'll own execution of strategy for this area rather than simply carry out someone else's plan — leading complex or high-profile campaigns often spanning multiple titles or initiatives, and holding your own in a room with senior executives, reporters, and key external partners. You'll be trusted to manage issues and escalations autonomously, with the judgment to know when (and how) to bring in Director-level support, and — where the role includes people management — to hire, onboard, and develop the Coordinators, Specialists, and Managers on your team.


Responsibilities


Content Communications

  • Lead Japan's communications strategy across key content areas and moments — currently including live programming (sports, music, and other real-time events) and anime titles/franchises with global reach — partnering with Global and regional Comms, Publicity, and Content teams to build one coherent Japan-to-world narrative.
  • Represent Japan Comms at relevant industry and fan-facing moments as the slate evolves.
  • Proactively execute communication strategies and narratives that reinforce Netflix's content positioning in Japan and globally.
  • Manage relationships with entertainment, trade, and general news media covering this part of Netflix's slate.
  • Help the team anticipate and navigate content-related issues as they arise, looping in Publicity, Legal, and Policy as needed.

Ads Communications

  • Develop and drive the communications narrative for Netflix's advertising business in Japan, in partnership with the Ads sales and business teams.
  • Build and maintain relationships with advertising, marketing, and business trade press; support briefings, announcements, and thought-leadership moments (e.g., partner announcements, industry events).
  • Position Netflix as a credible, growing player in Japan's advertising industry, balancing business storytelling with member-experience considerations.

Cross-Functional & Leadership

  • Lead high-profile or complex campaigns — often spanning multiple titles or initiatives — across the content and ads portfolios.
  • Maintain and deepen relationships with senior stakeholders, including executives, reporters, and key external partners.
  • Manage issues and escalations with good judgment on when and how to involve leadership.
  • Anticipate challenges, manage conflict, and help the team navigate ambiguity.
  • Apply AI tools to improve campaign efficiency and output quality, and help team members build the same fluency
  • Monitor the Japanese and relevant international media landscape for emerging narratives, risks, and opportunities.

Experience & Skills


  • Extensive communications experience (typically 15+ years) spanning entertainment, media, technology, or advertising, including agency or in-house experience in Japan — with a track record leading (not just supporting) high-profile or complex campaigns, and the presence to hold your own in a room of executives.
  • Solid experience managing communications issues as they come up, with sound judgment on when a situation needs to escalate and when it doesn't.
  • Direct experience with high-profile content communications spanning complex genres and formats, including work with an international dimension and significant fan or media visibility.
  • Some familiarity with advertising, marketing, or business communications, or a clear ability to get up to speed quickly in a new commercial domain.
  • Deep understanding of Japan's media landscape — business, trade, and entertainment press — along with familiarity with the international/English-language media relevant to global content storytelling.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Japanese and English (business-level fluency in both required).
  • A collaborative, low-ego style, with the ability to build trust across content, marketing, legal, policy, and business stakeholders in Japan, APAC, and globally.
  • A calm, level-headed operator who can stay clear-thinking under pressure when needed, without that being the sole focus of the role.
  • Comfort using AI tools to support day-to-day communications work, with an interest in helping others on the team build the same fluency.
  • Experience managing and developing team members is a plus.

title: Solutions Engineer 5 - Content Promotion & Distribution
locations: Los Gatos, California, United States of America
Los Angeles, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


You will join Content Promotion and Distribution, the team responsible for driving global content ingestion across Netflix. Our platform authenticates incoming submissions, orchestrates metadata, video, artwork, and availability across downstream services, and ensures partner deliverables are validated and conformed for seamless streaming to our members.


About the Team

Behind every title a member streams is a complex content supply chain. We focus on the front door to that supply chain. Content partners deliver metadata, artwork, and media to Netflix through it, and it validates and processes that content on its way to launch. As Netflix expands into new content types and deal structures, we make delivering to Netflix the easiest part of a partner's day.


Solutions Engineers accelerate partner integrations, help partners launch with confidence, and keep them running smoothly at scale. You'll sit between Engineering and the partner-facing Operations and Support teams. You'll work hands-on with partners, and you'll fix the friction you find so the next partner doesn't hit it.


This is one of the first Solutions Engineer roles for our team. You'll help define how the function works.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate prospective partners for technical fit, lead early deep dives, and establish clear integration roadmaps prior to onboarding.
  • Guide partners through onboarding and content delivery, untangling schema mismatches or hierarchy errors, crafting lightweight custom solutions when standard tools fall short, and shipping targeted improvements to unblock launches.
  • Develop targeted scripting, internal tools, and operational documentation to streamline remediation and enhance platform observability.
  • Educate internal stakeholders and external teams on platform capabilities, while refining integration guides and scalable workflows.
  • Act as the primary technical escalation point post-launch, tuning observability infrastructure and supporting partner-specific tools.
  • Identify recurring friction points and ship small, high-leverage improvements that reduce manual steps and issues per launch, using light scripting and automation to resolve issues at scale and build custom solutions that reduce the need for bespoke engineering work.
  • Bring well-evidenced defects and roadmap needs to core engineering with a clear ask, and represent partners' technical needs in product and engineering discussions, so new deals don't become bespoke one-offs.

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience integrating or supporting external partners on REST APIs. You're fluent with curl, Postman, or similar, and comfortable debugging JSON payloads and request/response flows.
  • Strong, structured troubleshooting skills. You can reason through a workflow end-to-end, use logs, dashboards, and traces to isolate a fault, and escalate with evidence and a concrete next step.
  • Working proficiency in Python or Java, and SQL. You can write scripts and queries, and read and debug an existing codebase well enough to make small, integration-specific changes.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences. You can turn ambiguous partner requests into concrete technical plans and keep stakeholders informed during incidents.
  • Comfort doing manual, human-in-the-loop work to unblock a partner. You recognize when a workaround is needed and tell engineers what to automate.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to speed up troubleshooting, documentation, and support, with real examples of results.
  • Curiosity, ownership, and empathy for partners. You care more about a partner's successful launch than about which tool got them there.
  • Experience with workflow or pipeline systems, or with media or metadata ingestion, is a plus. Experience in media, entertainment, or streaming is a plus.
  • Plus: Familiarity with digital image specs, media file formats and delivery workflows.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful impact. The systems you support are foundational to how content reaches members around the world.
  • Responsibility. Netflix offers true transparency and autonomy. Our culture is unique and is key to how we innovate.
  • Stunning colleagues. You'll work with high-performing peers across engineering, product and operations who value collaboration.

locations: Canada - Remote
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We're looking for a highly-skilled Senior Gameplay Programmer to join an in-house strategic incubation game development team focused on shaping the gameplay foundation of Netflix Games. This role is central to our efforts regarding the cloud streaming platform, the Netflix Game Controller (NGC), and other potential platforms. You will be responsible for implementing and refining gameplay systems across a diverse portfolio of game prototypes. These prototypes will cover a wide spectrum of genres available in the Netflix portfolio.


The right candidate will possess industry-leading craft expertise, meticulous attention to detail, and a proactive curiosity. This role requires a Senior Gameplay Programmer comfortable working across diverse game genres, from children's titles to AAA Action Adventures games, as well as working with a unique input device (the NGC). You will contribute to every stage of development, from initial vision to creating playable prototypes.


A key expectation is the ability to move seamlessly between gameplay sensibility and hands-on engineering. This includes partnering with designers to shape systems and directly building them yourself using technical fluency in Unreal Engine 5, leveraging a combination of C++ and Blueprints as well as using Gen AI. You must possess the engineering rigor to architect reliable, maintainable systems and the prototyping speed to find the fun fast.


THE TEAM

Our mission is to empower small teams of exceptional developers to build breakout hits, leveraging innovative gameplay married with beloved IPs and served with minimal friction within the Netflix ecosystem. We seek new teammates who care deeply about the experiences they create and the people they make them with, who bias towards hands-on action and are energized by the learning that comes with bold experimentation at an agile pace. As a part of Netflix, we strive to hire the best and value integrity, excellence, respect, inclusion, and collaboration.

RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Build Across Genres: Contribute to a rotating slate of projects spanning many different genres, adapting your engineering approach to fit the genre, audience, and platform at hand.

  • Drive Feature Areas End-to-End: Own multiple complex gameplay features from prototype to polished implementation, producing well-engineered, reliable, and maintainable code.

  • Prototype in UE5: Translate design intent into functional, playable systems and mechanics using Unreal Engine 5 with a combination of C++, Blueprints, Gen AI, and custom tools to validate gameplay hypotheses and find the fun fast.

  • Optimize & Debug: Profile, optimize, and debug both code and content across projects as needed to keep prototypes performant on TV via the cloud streaming platform and other targets.

  • Collaboration Catalyst: Partner closely with designers, artists, producers, and other engineers to integrate and improve features, ensuring cohesion between design intent and execution. Participate in code reviews and create documentation and functional tests for the features you build.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Proven experience prototyping and shipping two or more titles as a Gameplay Programmer/Engineer across varied genres, with a focus on excellent player experience.
  • Excellent technical knowledge in C++, optimization, math, and debugging, with extensive hands-on experience in Unreal Engine 5 and strong Blueprint implementation skills.
  • Strong gameplay and design sensibilities, able to partner with designers to shape systems and articulate the core elements that contribute to the "feel" and success of each genre.
  • Demonstrates ability to develop complex features and systems end-to-end, and to produce reliable, maintainable code under fast iterative timelines.
  • Thrives in a fast-moving, prototype-first environment where scope and direction evolve quickly, demonstrating exceptional adaptability to change.
  • Strong communicator who can translate complex technical ideas for other disciplines and communicates actively about the status of their tasks.

title: Publicity Manager - India
locations: Mumbai, India
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. When you watch an Indian blockbuster cross over to global audiences, do you find yourself dissecting how it got there — which story landed, which journalist broke it first, which moment made it cultural? When a campaign wraps, do you reflect on what you'd do differently? Do you read entertainment news not just as a fan but as a student of how stories travel? If so, we may have just the opportunity for you to join the Originals publicity team.

The Role:

Netflix is looking for a Publicity Manager to lead South title campaigns — Tamil, Telugu, and beyond. You will also end up working on a mix of other local and global titles. You'll own earned media strategy and execution for a slate of originals, working closely with filmmakers, talent, and a cross-functional team across content, marketing, and communications.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the strategy and book the travel. You'll pitch a cover story and manage a talent handler on set. You will guide a team member and be willing to roll up your sleeves to do the work.

What you'll do:

  • Build and execute publicity campaigns for South originals from production through launch and beyond — announcements, junkets, press moments, and post-launch coverage
  • Work with partners to develop media strategy across broadcast, print, digital, and social — with a sharp instinct for what makes a story travel regionally and nationally
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for filmmakers, talent, and production partners throughout the campaign lifecycle
  • Pitch and secure media opportunities; cultivate journalists, critics, and influencers 
  • Integrate with marketing, social, content, awards, and festival teams to build campaigns that are greater than the sum of their parts
  • Manage agencies, vendors, and budgets; give leadership clear visibility into process and priorities
  • Stay ahead of shifts in the entertainment and cultural landscape — what audiences care about, what media is chasing, what's breaking next

What we're looking for:

  • Campaign thinker, not just executor. You have a point of view on how a campaign should be built — and you can articulate what you're trying to do and why. You think about earned media not in press releases but through narratives.
  • Deep regional expertise. You understand South Indian cinema, television, and the cultural currents that shape them. You know what makes a Tamil film travel differently from a Telugu one, and you know the media landscape intimately — who covers what, and why.
  • Exceptional media relationships. You have strong existing relationships with key journalists, editors, and influencers across key markets in the South, and a track record of securing meaningful coverage — not just volume, but the right story in the right outlet at the right moment.
  • You consume entertainment and culture voraciously — not just as a consumer but as an analyst. You notice what's breaking through and why.
  • Integrated mindset. You think across channels — earned, social, talent, experiential — and can connect the dots between a press strategy, a talent moment, and a marketing beat.
  • Strong communicator. Clear, direct, and effective with everyone from a journalist to a filmmaker to a Netflix executive. Fluent in English, Hindi, and can speak Tamil and/or Telugu. Candidates who have worked in the Tamil or Telugu entertainment industry are especially encouraged to apply. 

Qualifications:

You will report to the Sr. Tax Manager, LATAM in Mexico City and will work closely with cross-functional partners across Finance, Legal, and tax teams all around the world. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and in a fast paced environment, moves comfortably between jurisdictions, and brings the flexibility to shift priorities as regulatory and business landscapes change. 


Responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities will be providing regional tax advisory and production tax/incentives support. Your day-to-day activities will include:


  • Stay current on legislative and regulatory changes across all covered jurisdictions; proactively assess their impact and advise tax leadership and stakeholders accordingly.
  • Provide tax advisory support on cross-border transactions, double taxation treaty application, business expansions, VAT refunds, production related tax questions and other regional tax matters.
  • Own the application, compliance, monetization, and reporting processes to claim Production Incentives in the region, including quarter-end close reporting.
  • Provide advisory support on the LATAM Production Incentives to local, cross-regional and cross-functional teams. 
  • Support the Sr. Manager in building and maintaining relationships with tax authorities and film commissions related to Production Tax and Incentives matters. This includes working very closely with our government relations teams and supporting public policy efforts related to Production Incentives.
  • Coordinate and drive tax audits across the region— tax authority and/or any government inquiries—owning the end-to-end audit lifecycle from initial response through resolution, navigating cross-functional alignment and collaboration.
  • Support the Sr. Manager on ad-hoc projects such as creation of new legal entities, new business initiatives, tax program applications, VAT refunds and electronic invoicing/requirements changes.
  • Support the LATAM Tax team on tax compliance, month end close, and day-to-day activities as needed.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting and/or Law.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in tax compliance, with proven multi-country expertise across LATAM (Mexico required; Colombia, Argentina, Perú and extraterritorial/digital service taxes strongly preferred).
  • In-depth knowledge of direct and indirect tax regulations in Mexico and LATAM countries; familiarity with country-specific platforms (e.g., SAT, DIAN, AFIP, SUNAT) is desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing tax audits—statutory, tax authority, and government inquiries—from planning through resolution in at least two LATAM jurisdictions.
  • Experience with Production Tax and Incentives is highly desirable.
  • Highly proficient in spreadsheets and memo writing; knowledge of Workday, Blackline, Google suite and electronic invoicing systems is a plus.

  • Hands-on mentality with a problem-solving approach; passionate about helping drive the business forward.

title: Final Layout Supervisor - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Vancouver, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:

The Final Layout Supervisor is a leadership position within the Layout Department. The role involves collaborating closely with the Head of Cinematography, Layout (HOCL) to ensure the team’s work aligns with the film’s creative vision and production requirements, guiding the team to achieve high‑quality outputs that are technically efficient and optimized for subsequent stages of production. The Final Layout Supervisor helps maintain quality and accessibility through the pipeline, ensuring feedback is understood and being addressed in a timely manner.


What You’ll Do:

  • Guide the Final Layout process, which includes set dressing, shot finaling, shot conform and post‑animation camera work such as focus adjustments, performance‑driven camera animation, ambient camera noise/shake, and provide feedback in these areas to align final layout output with the creative vision of department heads and filmmakers
  • Own and maintain the final layout breakdown list, ensuring that it is accurate and that naming conventions are consistent and pipeline‑compliant
  • Ensure that all Final Layout outputs meet high standards of quality by reviewing and providing feedback on the team’s work and QC‑ing the output from the Final Layout team
  • Collaborate with team members to address creative or technical challenges in final layout, ensuring solutions align with the film’s goals and support downstream departments
  • Work closely with the Head of Cinematography, Layout, filmmakers, and other departments to ensure alignment and cohesion across all stages of the filmmaking process
  • Effectively communicate work statuses and deadlines to Production and the HOCL, flagging risks early and collaborating on mitigation strategies
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration within the Final Layout team and with other departments, ensuring that the department’s work supports overall production objectives
  • Mentor and support team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment that encourages excellence and continuous improvement
  • Provide guidance and support to artists, helping them develop their skills and achieve their full potential, and communicate if performance expectations are not being met
  • Identify opportunities to optimize workflows and processes within final layout to enhance efficiency and consistency
  • Ensure that processes and decisions within final layout are well documented, providing clarity and consistency across the department
  • Contribute to strategic planning discussions for the Layout Department, aligning with studio goals and future directions

What You’ll Need:

  • Significant experience in layout, final layout, previs, or closely related roles in feature animation, VFX, or high‑end series, including prior leadership or lead experience
  • A strong reel demonstrating excellence in camera work, set dressing, staging, composition, and sequence continuity
  • Strong understanding of cinematography and how camera, staging, and editing support visual storytelling in animation
  • Proficiency with layout and camera tools such as Maya (experience with Houdini, Unreal, or other previs/layout tools is a plus)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide concise and honest constructive feedback and to listen and be open to feedback in return
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment, supporting cross‑departmental relationships and goals
  • Strong organizational and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to manage complex sequences and competing priorities
  • A mindset of ownership, openness to new workflows and toolsets, and the desire to continuously improve and help inspire those around you

This role is based in Vancouver, British Columbia. Hybrid Role (Minimum requirement of 3 days a week in the office).

The Team

We build flexible technology that makes it effortless for our partners to bring any asset to members and fans across every surface where Netflix content appears, from the Netflix app to marketing channels and beyond.


The Role

As Product Manager, Asset Ordering & Copy Fulfillment, you will own two connected domains. In Asset Planning & Ordering, you will build the systems that let teams like Marketing and Product Merchandising request the assets they need through a single, shared surface, covering all on and off service experiences, whether that means creating a net-new asset or adapting an existing one. In Copy, you will help teams ingest, create, manage, and deliver the words that describe and market Netflix content (synopses, taglines, callouts) at ROI-justified volume and high technical and creative quality.


Together, these domains are the front door and the output of the asset lifecycle: how teams ask for what they need, and how the words get made and delivered. You will work closely with the other CRAFT domain PMs, including Promotional Video, Artwork, and Scaled Asset Foundations, to move toward a single, modern, AI-powered ecosystem for ordering, briefing, fulfilling, and tracking. You will partner daily with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Operations, and creative and marketing teams around the world.

  • Own workstreams end to end, from framing the problem through launch, measurement, and the next iteration.
  • Route work to the right fulfillment path, automated or human, and right-size quality investment to the content type and strategic bet.
  • Shape how AI-powered capabilities create, adapt, and localize copy, with human oversight where it matters.
  • Partner with operations and regional teams to understand how work really gets done, and build tools they can run themselves without adding unplanned load.
  • Partner with cross-functional partners to prototype and test early with real users, define success metrics before launch, and work with Data Science to measure impact on speed, cost, and quality.

title: Marketing Specialist, Consumer Products - Korea (FTC)
locations: Seoul, Korea, Republic of
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Role

We are looking to grow our Consumer Products team to help amplify member joy and strengthen brand affinity around the Netflix brand and our beloved titles. We do this by developing creative and relevant ways for our members and fans to interact with Netflix off-screen. Consumer products drive meaningful show awareness and buzz with product stories that allow fans to express their love for our brand and titles, while also generating meaningful revenue. Ideally, our products connect members to our content, and to each other, by bringing their favorite stories to life.


This role will support the development and execution of Netflix’s Consumer Products marketing for Korea. The Marketing Specialist will shape integrated campaigns and go-to-market plans across multiple categories, working closely with licensees, retailers, agencies, and cross-functional Netflix teams to bring compelling product stories and fan experiences to life. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, has a strong understanding of Korean consumers and culture, and knows how to turn local insights into creative marketing opportunities. They will stay closely aligned with regional and global Consumer Products teams while ensuring that our local marketing initiatives feel relevant and impactful in Korea. This role will report to the Senior Manager of Consumer Products, Korea and will be based in Seoul.

This is a 12 month Fixed Term Contract


Responsibilities

  • Marketing Planning: Support the development and execution of Consumer Products marketing plans in Korea across priority titles, product categories, and partnerships.
  • Campaign Development: Create culturally relevant campaign ideas and product stories that bring Netflix titles to life and deepen fan engagement.
  • Integrated Go-to-Market: Coordinate campaigns across digital, social, influencer, e-commerce, retail, PR, and experiential channels.
  • Partner Collaboration: Work closely with licensees, retailers, agencies, and other partners to develop and execute impactful marketing programs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal teams, including Marketing, Social, PR, Creative, Licensing, Product Development, and regional and global Consumer Products teams.
  • Campaign Operations: Manage campaign timelines, creative assets, approvals, and deliverables to ensure smooth and timely execution.
  • Content & Influencer Marketing: Identify relevant platforms, creators, influencers, and media opportunities that can extend campaign reach and drive product awareness and engagement.
  • Marketing Materials: Develop campaign briefs, partner toolkits, presentations, and other materials needed to support product launches and activations.
  • Brand Stewardship: Ensure that partner marketing materials and activations align with Netflix’s brand and creative guidelines.
  • Consumer & Cultural Insights: Monitor Korean consumer behavior, fandom, cultural trends, and emerging marketing practices, translating relevant insights into actionable ideas.
  • Performance Measurement: Track campaign results against agreed objectives and support reporting, post-campaign analysis, and recommendations for future programs.
  • Agency & Budget Management: Coordinate with agencies and external vendors while managing project scopes, production timelines, and budget tracking.
  • Project Management: Manage multiple projects and shifting priorities effectively in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment.
  • Strategic Partner Leadership: Lead partners on their marketing strategy and creative development, guiding them to execute high-impact campaigns that elevate both the brand and Netflix titles.
  • Retail Strategy & Planning: Work closely with the Retail Manager to build comprehensive strategies and promotional plans that maximize brand visibility and commercial impact in the retail space.
  • Agile Creative Production: Resourcefully source and manage external creative talent, freelancers, and agencies to quickly address dynamic production needs, such as video editing and campaign asset development.

What we are looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in consumer marketing, consumer products, entertainment, licensing, brand partnerships, or an agency environment, with a track record of executing impactful marketing campaigns.
  • Experience developing and executing integrated campaigns across digital, social, influencer, e-commerce, retail, PR, and experiential channels.
  • A strong understanding of digital platforms, social media, creators, and emerging content formats, with the ability to identify effective ways to engage fans and drive product awareness.
  • A strong understanding of Korean consumers, fandom, and cultural trends, with the ability to translate insights into locally relevant marketing ideas.
  • The ability to turn entertainment IP and products into clear, compelling stories that create conversation and strengthen fan connection.
  • Experience working with licensees, retailers, agencies, creators, or other external partners to deliver marketing programs from concept through execution.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage timelines, creative assets, approvals, budgets, and campaign deliverables.
  • The ability to define campaign objectives, evaluate performance, and translate results and learnings into actionable recommendations.
  • The ability to build strong working relationships and navigate local, regional, and global teams in a highly collaborative, matrixed organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns, launches, and priorities simultaneously in a fast-moving environment.
  • A proactive, curious, and adaptable approach, with the confidence to take ownership, solve problems, and respond quickly to change.
  • A genuine passion for entertainment, storytelling, products, and fan culture, with an instinct for creating experiences that amplify fan joy.
  • Fluency in Korean and strong business proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to both local partners and global stakeholders.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
  • Experience working with globally recognized brands, major entertainment IP, consumer products, or culturally relevant brand collaborations is a plus.

title: Analytics Engineer 5 - Ads Identity & Signals
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

In 2022 we launched a new lower-priced, ad-supported tier, and we are building an in-house, world-class ad-tech ecosystem to give our members more choice and to offer advertisers a premium, better-than-linear-TV experience. We are looking for the founding members of this new business area for Netflix.

The Identity & Signals team builds the identity foundation of the Netflix ads business — the graph and matching systems that let us recognize the same person or household across signals, devices, and partner data sources, and that determine which signals we can responsibly and accurately use for targeting, measurement, and reporting. We build and maintain the identity graph, run and evaluate entity-matching and resolution pipelines, and manage relationships with identity providers so that advertisers and internal teams can trust the signals underneath every campaign.

This is a foundational role on a small, high-leverage team. You will build the analytics and data infrastructure that powers identity matching and graph construction — designing the tables, pipelines, and metrics that let the team and its stakeholders understand match quality, coverage, and drift over time. You'll work end-to-end: from raw signal ingestion, through matching logic and graph construction, to the dashboards and data products that make identity health visible and actionable across the company.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and maintain the data models and pipelines that support identity graph construction, entity matching, and identity resolution across first-party and third-party signals.
  • Partner with data engineering and software engineering to productionize matching logic, ensuring pipelines are scalable, well-tested, and monitored for data quality and drift.
  • Build metrics, dashboards, and analytics that quantify match rate, match quality, coverage, and graph stability, and that surface anomalies before they affect downstream campaigns.
  • Work closely with data science to evaluate and improve matching algorithms, providing the clean, well-documented data and features needed to test and iterate on models.
  • Manage and evaluate the analytics relationship with external identity providers (e.g., Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp), including onboarding new sources, validating match performance, and monitoring ongoing data quality.
  • Translate identity graph and matching concepts — nodes, edges, match confidence, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching — into clear, actionable insights for product, sales, and other non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to define identity requirements, evaluate trade-offs (accuracy vs. coverage vs. privacy), and prioritize roadmap work.
  • Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the company.

We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role working with large-scale data.
  • Experience working with graph data structures and graph-based data models (e.g., property graphs, graph databases, or graph analytics on top of relational/columnar stores).
  • Familiarity with entity matching / identity resolution concepts — deterministic and probabilistic matching, fuzzy matching, blocking/candidate generation, and match quality evaluation.
  • Knowledge of, or direct experience working with, identity providers such as Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp, or similar data/identity partners.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Experience designing data models, metrics, and dashboards that make complex technical systems understandable to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely across data engineering, software engineering, data science, and product teams.
  • Ability to work independently, drive your own projects, and make compelling cases for prioritization.
  • Embodies the Netflix values while bringing a new perspective to continue improving our culture.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with ad-tech identity concepts — cross-device identity, household graphs, cookie/ID deprecation, or media measurement.
  • Experience with graph databases or graph-processing frameworks (e.g., Neo4j, Neptune, GraphFrames, or similar).
  • Familiarity with our ML/data stack (Metaflow) or comparable large-scale data tooling.
  • Experience working with privacy-sensitive data and an understanding of relevant data governance and privacy considerations for identity data.
  • Experience applying GenAI to boost developer/analytics productivity.

title: Game Director, SPIN
locations: Canada - Remote
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Game/Gameplay Director to own Design across our SPIN Team's (Strategic Prototyping & Incubation) slate of projects. Reporting to the Executive Producer, you will oversee mechanical design as part of a leadership team; from hands-on to high level. You will direct the design team and will be the final point of accountability for the design quality of all of SPIN’s projects.


The right candidate must be willing to operate at both ends of two spectrums: from high-level direction to hands-on UE5 implementation, and from pre-production prototyping to final-quality, shippable product. You must be capable of operating across these spectrums across a wide-ranging portfolio of products. 


We're looking for deep expertise in Action-Adventure, 3C’s, Systemic, and Open/Semi-Open World design with a Narrative and Realization focus. However, a candidate must also be prepared and comfortable with design across a wide variety of genres, from Narrative to Sports as an example. Touch-based UX on the Netflix Controller (NGC) is a major part of our work that any Game/Gameplay Director must be comfortable with.


A key expectation is the ability to hold a normalized high bar for craft and attention to detail across multiple games in various stages of development simultaneously, while applying your team accordingly to manage quality and focus. It is critical that you are an avid gamer across various platforms, playing and forming opinions on new releases while staying updated on emerging trends as they appear.


THE TEAM


SPIN (Strategic Prototype & Incubation) is Netflix's in-house team dedicated to prototyping and incubating new game experiences across a wide range of genres. We empower small teams of exceptional developers to build breakout experiences, bias towards hands-on action, and are energized by the learning that comes from bold experimentation at an agile pace. As part of Netflix, we strive to hire the best and value integrity, excellence, respect, inclusion, and collaboration.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Oversee the Full Portfolio: Hold accountability for the design quality of all the projects running in parallel, and act as the final point of escalation when design issues arise
  • Develop Design Vision: Champion and continuously iterate on the core design vision for each project in collaboration with project leadership
  • Go Hands-On: Work directly in Unreal Engine 5 to prototype, tune, or adjust gameplay features and systems when a project requires direct design input
  • Cross-Genre Design Direction: Guide design across a wide variety of genres, adapting your approach to fit the genre, and audience
  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner closely with other discipline directors to align vision, scope, and process across all projects
  • Build and Maintain Design Standards: Establish consistent design documentation, review processes, and quality bars across SPIN's portfolio of projects
  • Own Design Leadership: Manage, mentor, and set direction for all designers across SPIN projects, providing clear, consistent creative and managerial feedback that elevates their work

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • At least 15 years of experience in the games industry, including at least 5 years in a Game Director role
  • Has shipped at least one title as Game Director
  • Deep expertise in action-adventure
  • Demonstrated ability to work across a wide variety of genres beyond action-adventure
  • Hands-on proficiency in Unreal Engine 5, with the ability to directly implement or tune gameplay features when needed
  • Proven experience managing multiple projects and design teams in parallel
  • Strong track record of delivering clear, consistent creative and managerial feedback that elevates the work of others
  • Comfortable operating at both a high strategic level and a low, detailed implementation level depending on project needs
  • Thrives in a fast-moving, prototype-first environment where scope and direction can evolve quickly
  • Strong communicator who can translate complex design ideas for engineers, artists, and stakeholders alike

  • Resume
  • Portfolio examples are welcomed

This is a remote position based in Toronto or Montreal. However, candidates must be willing to travel for work-related events around the world.

locations: Vancouver, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:


We are seeking a Digital Producer to support our upcoming CG Animated Feature Film. 


The Digital Producer is responsible for the overall progress of the picture production from story through to delivery, including appropriate resourcing, financial tracking and internal reporting, studio reporting, production milestones and strategy, and associated marketing. 


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead high-level planning, scheduling, and overall project definitions across teams and locations.
  • Create and define overall project milestones and ensure these are communicated to relevant team members
  • Inspire, mentor, teach, and manage production management teams and large creative groups with proactive communication and diplomacy.
  • Together with the HOP and AM, mentor, coach and develop the production management team, ensuring they have the knowledge and capabilities to carry out their roles. 
  • Plan, monitor, and manage the production of assets and shots to ensure timely delivery within budget and schedule parameters.
  • Partner with Producers, VFX Supervisors, and HODs on turnover bidding, technique assessments, and creative methodology.
  • Track, report, and manage ongoing resourcing requirements and publish weekly progress updates to Producer and HOP.
  • Prepare and distribute crew plans, schedules, and resource requests in coordination with Artist Management and Technology.
  • Collaborate with key leadership to resolve schedule challenges, conflicting priorities, or significant production issues.
  • Ensure all projects are properly logged into tracking/asset management systems and follow studio best practices.
  • Provide oversight to the management of the production team, ensuring all tasks and processes are understood and executed correctly and that the team is supported
  • Provide constructive feedback to Artist Management on crew performance and identify training needs with HOP.
  • Participate in casting, resourcing, and recruiting efforts for project needs.
  • Schedule and chair regular pre-production and production meetings across department leadership and support groups.
  • Collaborate with grace, humility, inclusion, and open-mindedness
  • Oversee workflows and production communication that help integrate the three physical locations working on one film.
  • At all times share knowledge, foster and support a respectful knowledge sharing culture. 


What You’ll Need:


  • Exceptional attention to detail and communication skills 
  • Comprehensive knowledge of end-to-end (E2E) digital and animation pipelines and production principles (e.g., 'Rough to Fine', 'Fix on Fail').
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, bidding, forecasting, and budget management skills.

Los Angeles, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


Netflix's advertising business – spanning the ad-supported plan, ad sales, programmatic and data partnerships, and measurement – is scaling quickly, and privacy and data protection risk is scaling with it. We are looking for a Director to lead privacy legal support for Netflix's global advertising business: advising Ads, Product, and Measurement teams on data collection, targeting, and partner data flows; embedding privacy-by-design into new ad products and partnerships; and helping the business grow revenue responsibly and in compliance with an increasingly complex U.S. and global privacy landscape, in addition to being a great team player and supporting the team across other privacy and data security areas as they arise.

This role will ideally be based in our Los Angeles or Los Gatos, California office. We will also consider candidates based in New York.


Key Responsibilities

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of combined law firm and in-house experience, with meaningful in-house time at a technology, media, or ad tech company advising on advertising and marketing issues.  
  • Substantive depth in global privacy and advertising law – CCPA/CPRA and other state privacy statutes, COPPA, VPPA, TCPA – and working familiarity with EU GDPR, Canadian privacy law (PIPEDA), and other global laws.
  • Direct experience advising an advertising, ad tech, or martech business: programmatic/DSP-SSP ecosystems, data clean rooms, identifier and cookie-deprecation strategy, and measurement/attribution partnerships.
  • Comfort partnering with engineering teams on technical privacy controls for ads data – consent management, data separation, pseudonymization.

  • Experience negotiating privacy and data protection terms in ad tech and measurement commercial agreements.

Partner Operations is obsessed with making direct delivery simpler for new content partners and the Netflix teams who receive and launch their titles day-to-day. You will balance the partner experience with the work required of Netflix teams and vendors, and make the important decisions and handoffs clear.


In this role, you will:

  • Clarify deal goals, asset and localization needs, timing, partner contacts and open questions with Business Development, Regional Merchandising and Content teams as deals move into delivery planning.
  • Assess the partner’s ability to meet our specs. Compare their needs with Netflix’s current system and operational capabilities; identify what is missing, what may need to be built and the effort required from integration through stable operations.

  • Turn partner context and deal nuance into clear technical and operational requirements for Product and Engineering. Frame the problem, define the workflow and write user stories where useful, making timing, constraints and trade-offs clear. Work with PACT and Solution Engineering on configuration and integration questions.
  • Prepare partners to meet spec, coordinate tests and work through first deliveries. Answer delivery and spec questions clearly, bring in technical specialists when needed and remove early blockers.
  • Keep partners, vendors and internal teams aligned on decisions, risks, owners and next steps. Communicate early and on time, and anticipate what each team will need before it becomes a problem.
  • Hand off the partner profile, setup and open risks to the Launch Ops project manager once delivery is reliable.

Requirements:

  • Substantial experience independently leading complex partner onboarding, post-production, content operations, or product launches. This is an L5 role for someone who has taken ambiguous, multi-team work from planning through launch and stable operations.
  • Proven project or technical program management experience, with strong judgment on priorities, dependencies, risk and when to escalate.
  • Excellent partner management. You build trust, set expectations, navigate difficult conversations and stay several steps ahead of partners and internal teams.
  • Clear, timely written and verbal communication. You can explain technical and operational issues in plain language and turn them into decisions, owners and next steps. 
  • Strong experience coordinating Product, Engineering, Operations, business teams and external vendors toward a common launch outcome.

title: Matte Painting Supervisor - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Vancouver, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:


We are seeking a Matte Painting Supervisor to support our upcoming feature film. The Matte Painting Supervisor works inside of NAS to lead the matte painting team on a specific film, partnering with show leadership to build engaging digital environments that tell our story. The team will create skies, background environments, set extensions, embellishments of CG renders, and full one‑off locations that integrate seamlessly into the final film.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead a team of Matte Painters, casting work appropriately with an eye on schedule and providing daily creative and technical feedback.
  • Collaborate with the VFX Supervisor, Head of Environments, Production Designer, Art Director, and other show leadership to establish the visual style and quality standards for matte painting and environment projections.
  • Supervise the creation of high-quality matte paintings and digital environments that align with the film’s art direction and integrate seamlessly with CG renders and compositing.
  • Create or refine selected matte paintings and environment projections as needed—particularly complex, hero, or reference‑setting work—to help establish the quality bar, style, and technical approach for the team.
  • Help define DMP workflows and toolsets in collaboration with Environment, Layout, Lighting, Compositing, Technical Supervisor, and pipeline teams.
  • Work closely with Production and Environment leadership to plan and track DMP work, providing input on complexity, timelines, and priorities.
  • Review work in context, giving clear, constructive feedback to ensure visual and technical excellence, consistency, and strong storytelling.
  • Evaluate the skills of existing show artists, contribute to artist development, and participate in recruiting and onboarding new talent.
  • Help document DMP workflows, processes, and technology, and stay current with industry trends and emerging tools.

What You’ll Need:

  • Extensive experience in digital matte painting or environment creation for feature animation, VFX, or high‑end series, including time in a Lead or Supervisory role.
  • A strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality matte painting and environment work with integrated 2D, 2.5D, and CG elements.
  • Proficiency with Photoshop and Nuke, plus working knowledge of 3D tools (e.g., Maya, Houdini, Blender) and modern rendering workflows.
  • Strong understanding of perspective, parallax, lighting, atmosphere, and color theory.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and organizational skills, with the ability to manage complex projects and team needs simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a collaborative, team‑oriented mindset.
  • Experience developing and maintaining workflows in coordination with pipeline and technical teams.

This role is based in Vancouver, British Columbia. Hybrid Role (Minimum of 3 days a week in the office).

Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary:


We are seeking a Production Coordinator to support our upcoming CG animated feature film. This role will report to our Production Manager and act as a liaison with the leads and artists by supporting and tracking their work on a day-to-day basis. You will be responsible for  tracking progress, facilitating daily workflows and deliverables, and maintaining a department floor schedule.


What You’ll Do:


  • Work with the Production Supervisor and Production Manager to assess assignment timelines based on the individual artists on the team
  • Build and maintain daily floor schedules in collaboration with the Production Supervisor, Craft Supervisor, and HoD, assigning tasks to artists and ensuring they have the necessary support, information, and materials required to achieve targets
  • Track department workflows, asset statuses, and task progress against the schedule, provide timely ETC reports, and clearly communicate any variances to the production team
  • Coordinate and prepare for reviews with the Craft Supervisor, organise content and agendas, take clear notes, and follow up with artists to ensure direction is understood
  • Work toward agreed targets and priorities, providing weekly summary reports on team progress, achievements, and challenges
  • Escalate scheduling, wellbeing, technical, or creative concerns that could impact the team or upcoming targets
  • Ensure cross-department requests are clearly communicated and liaise with other Production Coordinators regarding issues affecting your team
  • Support global collaboration with clear, consistent, and effective communication ensuring teams remain aligned and work effectively together.
  • Review and approve artist timesheets weekly, ensuring accuracy
  • Train other coordinators and assistants as needed, while building strong working relationships with artists to foster a positive and supportive team environment

What You’ll Need:


  • 2+ years of production experience on [CG,2D, stop motion] feature films or related productions preferred
  • Experience working within a production team at an Animation, VFX, or Games studio, with animated feature or series experience strongly preferred
  • Strong working knowledge of asset and shot tracking systems, preferably ShotGrid / Autodesk Flow Production Tracking
  • Solid understanding of a CG-based pipeline, from Assets through to Lighting and Compositing, with awareness of the dependencies and outputs at each stage
  • Experience managing schedules, tracking progress, creating reports, and coordinating across departments to support artists and supervisors
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative and positive approach
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to problem-solve in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Able to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team

Location:

This role is based out of Sydney, Australia. Hybrid Role (Minimum requirement of 3 days a week in the office).

title: Manager, Partnerships Packaging & Solutions, EMEA
locations: London, United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About The Team


The Brand Partnerships team collaborates with external partners and internal cross-functional teams to create compelling campaigns, activations, sponsorships, and innovative partnership solutions. As part of our overall marketing efforts, we partner with admired consumer brands to promote our titles and fuel fandom with creative marketing campaigns that drive outsized conversation, creating more ways for brands and fans to connect with the content and IP that they love. Since the launch of Netflix Ads in late 2022, we have continued to innovate our partnership offering, developing new inter-sectional solutions for brands to get closer to, and integrate with our culture defining content and IP whilst continuing to provide a best-in-class experience to our members and ad tier subscribers.

Examples of the work created by this group can be found here


About The Role


We are looking for a Partnerships Packaging & Solutions Manager, working in a pan-regional capacity to lead our IP/content focused packaging approach for partnership and sponsorship solutions in EMEA.


Working  as part of the Sponsorship & Solutions team within the Brand Partnerships EMEA function, you will identify, define and shape the right packaging solution for every scenario- from turnkey executions in a single market, to multi-title/mult-market genre/thematic led sponsorships through to custom solutions for our biggest, most conversational series, films and Live titles.


You will connect cross-functional partners across Ads, Marketing, Content, Legal, Product, and regional teams to assess market/advertiser demand, identify growth opportunities, and evolve packaging strategy, actively contributing towards the commercial and creative growth objectives of Partnerships and Ads within the region. 


You will work at both strategic and executional levels, setting direction for our go-to-market approach while also contributing at a detailed level when needed- as well as providing consultative guidance to our Brand Creative Studio team of strategists, creatives, producers and social experts, to support the development of creative solutions that leverage the Netflix Ads and product ecosystem in the most effective way.


This role requires deep experience and understanding of the sponsorships, media, brand partnerships  and entertainment landscape as well as how to scale new packaging solutions around content/IP offerings. 


Key areas of focus include:


  • Building strategic packaging solutions  across EMEA that are regionally resonant and locally relevant for brands and advertisers
  • As part of the Sponsorship & Solutions team, active contribution to the development of sales collateral and go-to-market approach of Sponsorship opportunities including Single/multi-title Sponsorships, Live events and future product/packaging innovation
  • Cross-functional collaboration with global, regional and local  stakeholders 
  • Leading and delivering internally facing presentations, training and education on our partnerships packaging proposition  

Key Responsibilities 


  • Lead and develop the strategic partnership/sponsorship packaging offering in EMEA across Netflix IP - both proactively and in response to partner briefs
  • Become an expert in our ecosystem of ad formats to best package effective solutions around key cultural and high-impact advertiser moments.
  • Partner with key cross-functional stakeholders and teams across Ads, marketing, legal, pricing and packaging and measurement teams to deliver tailored go-to-market strategies 
  • Develop go-to-market sales materials for sponsorship opportunities across single and multi-title packages, events, social, and new offerings
  • Align with Commercialisation and Ads Pricing to establish regional and local package tiers 
  • Define workflows and processes with internal cross-functional partners 
  • Collaborate with Ads, Marketing & Product teams to develop and unlock new capabilities and partnership innovation
  • Development of memos, in English, that articulate clear go-to-market strategies and initiative to drive the expansion of Partnerships in EMEA
  • Work closely with Legal, Ad Policy, Product and commercialisation/market activation teams to build scalable practices that grow partnerships revenue and protect member experience

Key Requirements:


  • 10 years or more in linear and/or streaming partnerships/sponsorships management, commercialisation and/or media agency partnerships
  • Proven expertise within the EMEA market, with an understanding of the unique characteristics and opportunities of this region and key markets (UK, France, Germany, Spain, Italy)
  • Deep knowledge and understanding of both the traditional linear and evolving streaming/digital video space and media industries  
  • Demonstrable experience with pricing & packaging sponsorships and/or brand partnerships across linear, on-demand streaming, social, experiential and Live channels 
  • High performing cross-functional capabilities across marketing, sales, product, legal, measurement, policy and more
  • Strong project management skills and attention to detail
  • Understanding of “content-driven” sensitivities related to brand association and endorsement
  • Ability to partner and support Ads teams through the sales cycle process and Creative teams in the development of innovative partnerships solutions
  • Strong project management, planning, and organizational skills, including the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and to deliver work under tight timelines

Attributes 


  • Able to develop strategic approaches, stay organized, communicate effectively, and adapt to changing priorities and timelines
  • Can organise, clarify and communicate complex ideas quickly, succinctly and accurately 
  • High initiative and autonomy, with the ability to proactively identify gaps, solve problems, and drive work forward.
  • Capable of working independently as well as part of a broader team.
  • Highly detail oriented and with a working knowledge of systems such as Salesforce & Airtable
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, including synthesizing and structuring data and insights to tell compelling narratives
  • Able to present ideas clearly and communicate effectively with cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders across the EMEA Partnerships and Ads organisation
  • Dedication to creative excellence to ensure we connect advertisers to our content through meaningful and authentic storytelling
  • A track record of building out content/partnership offerings across streaming platforms, social, digital and experiential touchpoints.  
  • Able to evaluate new information and exercise sound judgement in ambiguous situations.
  • Adaptable, goal-oriented, motivated to succeed, and welcomes new challenges
  • Can flourish in our unique company culture
