title: Strategic Marketing Planning Manager - Spain, Italy, Turkey
locations: Madrid, Spain
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Team


The EMEA Country Planning team is a Marketing Planning team that is embedded in the markets and acts as a strategic partner to country teams, connecting local priorities to regional and global direction. This is a marketing role within EMEA Marketing. Each marketing planner owns a portfolio of markets and builds a deep understanding of their business, slate, audiences and challenges, while holding a regional view across markets. Markets own their marketing strategies and decisions; the team brings the evidence, cross-market perspective and structured thinking that make those decisions stronger. With full visibility across both branded and unbranded title slates, the team also plays a pivotal role in planning the export of local titles and bringing global insights back to markets.


The Opportunity
The Country Marketing Planning Manager for Spain, Italy, and Turkey is a strategic partner to country marketing leadership teams. The role combines market, audience, slate and performance intelligence to help markets decide where to focus, what to prioritize and what to stop doing. You will lead integrated marketing planning across marketing levers, run regular Marketing Strategy Check-ins with each market in partnership with Finance & Media, and orchestrate export campaigns for Spain's globally exporting slate. You will also bring local learning into regional thinking, champion the country perspective within the global marketing organization, and help build the AI-enabled tools and frameworks that make this work scalable across EMEA.


This is a permanent  FTE role reporting into the Director, EMEA Country Planning. The position will be based in Madrid.  

Key Responsibilities 


Market Context & Strategic Partnership

  • Be a consistent strategic partner to the Spain, Italy and Turkey marketing teams, adding a regional view to their local expertise.
  • Bring together signals across slate, campaigns, audiences and performance to explain what is happening in each market, why it is happening and what to do about it.
  • Advise on market-specific challenges and opportunities, ensuring strategies are tailored to the unique dynamics of each country.

Strategy & Prioritization

  • Help markets make sharper choices on audiences, opportunities, and the slate, including where to go big and what to deprioritize. Markets keep ownership of their strategy.
  • Support annual prioritization and turn the resulting choices into one integrated plan for the year.
  • Run Marketing Strategy Check-ins two to three times a year, assessing what is working, what has changed and what to adjust, incorporating campaign learnings.

Integrated Planning

  • Lead the Integrated Marketing Planning Group in each market, bringing Media, Title Marketing, Publicity and Social together to plan across marketing levers including Always On, Reactive, Performance Marketing, and Audience Led Initiatives. 
  • Plan marketing levers as one portfolio rather than campaign by campaign, and make deliberate trade-offs across it.

Export Campaign Planning

  • Lead export marketing planning for titles with a global audience, with a particular focus on Spain's exporting slate, identifying them early and using long-lead analysis of where each title can resonate.
  • Align the home market and supporting markets on one title strategy, positioning and timeline, so the campaign stays consistent wherever it runs.
  • Provide home territory teams with clear visibility into global support plans, timelines, and country nuances, and bring regional input into creative and activation ideas.
  • Monitor early performance signals to flag reactive opportunities, and manage the handover of day-to-day launch and reactive support to Ops so execution stays tied to the strategy.

Regional Intelligence & Connectivity

  • Spot patterns, opportunities and risks across marketing teams, surfacing opportunities to scale initiatives or learnings.
  • Bring market evidence into regional marketing strategy and leadership conversations, and represent Spain, Italy and Turkey in regional and global forums.
  • Make strong local work and learning visible and reusable across EMEA, and facilitate communication among local, regional and global stakeholders.

Audience, AI & Innovation

  • Contribute to marketing audience measurement and discoverability work, including testing new approaches such as synthetic audiences and understanding how GenAI is changing the way people discover titles.
  • Rethink how marketing analysis and planning are done with AI, and help build shared tools, frameworks and processes that can be reused across markets.

Candidate Profile

  • Brings significant experience in strategic marketing planning, business strategy or consulting, marketing strategy, product, chief of staff or marketing partnership roles, ideally within a brand, consulting firm, or international media/entertainment environment. Experience working across Spanish and broader EMEA markets is highly valued.
  • Understands the marketing campaign lifecycle, from strategy and planning through execution and performance analysis, and brings an audience-led approach to strategy.
  • Demonstrates strong analytical judgment and a proven ability to synthesize data from multiple sources into a clear point of view that informs strategic decisions. Fluent with data and analytics tools, with a talent for translating complex information into compelling narratives for diverse audiences. Uses AI tools actively to accelerate analysis, challenge assumptions, and improve the quality of strategic work.
  • Adept at building trusted partnerships across functions and geographies, with a track record of influencing stakeholders and aligning teams around shared objectives. Experienced in navigating matrixed organizations and managing relationships at all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Proactively identifies opportunities to optimize workflows, processes, and tools to drive efficiency and scalability, and enjoys building reusable frameworks that scale across markets. Brings a solutions-oriented mindset and is comfortable implementing innovative approaches to complex challenges.
  • Confident communicator with strong presentation skills, able to distill and share insights, business updates, and strategic recommendations with clarity and impact. Comfortable facilitating discussions and representing the region in global forums.
  • Possesses a global mindset and experience working with diverse, geographically dispersed teams. Demonstrates cultural sensitivity and the ability to champion the Spanish, Italian, and Turkish perspectives within a global organization.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Thrives in ambiguity, demonstrating resilience, adaptability, and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Fluent Spanish and English are required for this position. Italian and/or Turkish is a plus. 
  • Eager to contribute to and grow within Netflix’s unique culture, embracing curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning.

title: Manager, Finance & Strategy - Economist
locations: London, United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix derives a significant competitive advantage from the highly analytical approach it takes to managing all aspects of the business. The Finance & Strategy team leverages internal and external data to develop best-in-class metrics, tools, analysis, insights and reporting for many business functions. This team supports deal negotiation and strategy, guides prioritisation efforts, and communicates the financial impact of key decisions across the company, partnering closely with the senior leadership of Netflix, who depend heavily on the insights we provide to inform business decisions.


As one of the largest media and entertainment companies in the world, Netflix is a significant contributor to the global creative economy. Our investments support businesses, create new jobs, spur additional economic activity, and open the door to new creative opportunities. As our investments grow, we are looking to improve our ability to measure this impact and better share the story of Netflix’s contribution to local economies. This role will advance Netflix’s measuring of this impact at scale from a financial and economic data perspective, working closely with Finance, Global Affairs, and Communications executives around the world to tell our story in a consistent and comprehensive manner.


Primary Responsibilities: 

  • Collaborate with global and regional Finance, Global Affairs, and Comms teams to source internal data, optimise economic impact modelling, and communicate Netflix’s contributions both internally and externally
  • Produce rigorous economic analysis across a wide spectrum of topics relevant to the digital media and entertainment sector, including Netflix’s own productions
  • Design and evolve internal tools and processes to scale economic impact analyses globally
  • Understand Netflix’s business deeply and adapt to market-specific positioning, while maintaining awareness of regulatory developments and providing context around company financial reporting
  • Develop a roadmap for economic research spanning key policy issues and serving Global Affairs and Comms teams globally
  • Regularly communicate and present analyses and reports in an easy-to-understand format to senior business leaders
  • Coordinate and build partnerships with a wide variety of internal stakeholders to build, strengthen and scale our economic contribution measurements

Qualifications:

Netflix maintains a flat organisational structure, which means that employees are often asked to perform tasks with a range of difficulties. The ideal candidate will be prepared to regularly take on a mix of routine tasks and high-impact work, including presenting to senior executives in the company.


A successful candidate possesses:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in analytical roles (management or economic consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, or an equivalent role), with at least 3 years of background in economics and/or statistics (can include experience with a regulator, economic consultancy, or other related fields) 
  • Ability to prioritise and organise work effectively in a fast‑paced, less structured environment, with high attention to detail when working with complex financial and economic data.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and ability to independently identify questions, structure analyses, and follow through on work with minimal oversight
  • Familiarity with econometrics principles and software, with the ability to manipulate large data sets and build advanced models
  • Superb financial modelling and framework development skills with extensive experience conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis, and an ability to sort through complex data to crystallise business implications
  • Robust analytical skills complemented by effective communication skills (written and verbal), in order to articulate complex problems clearly and concisely to executives/senior management
  • Comfort working on ambiguous, cross-functional projects and driving clarity with stakeholders
  • Interest in the entertainment industry (film, television, music)

title: Manager, Casting - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Burbank, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

The Netflix Animation Studios Casting team is looking for a seasoned and creatively driven Manager, Casting for our original animated feature films. In this role, you will support the Casting Director on an assigned set of titles, working closely with filmmakers and production teams to discover, track, and coordinate the voice talent that brings our characters to life. 


As the Manager, Casting you will also be responsible for fielding auditions and submissions, building relationships with agents, managers, and actors, and mentoring members of the Casting team. In collaboration with the VP, Casting you will also help shape casting ideas across the slate.


About The Team:

The Animated Film Casting team partners closely with filmmakers and production to identify the voices that bring our characters to life. Across the slate, the team sources and auditions talent, curates reels and shortlists, and manages relationships with agents, managers, and actors. They help guide each project’s casting process from early exploration through final selections, ensuring timelines stay on track while honoring the creative vision of the filmmakers.


What You'll Do:

  • Casting Support & Coordination
  • Title Support: Support the Casting Director on an assigned set of feature animation  titles, working alongside filmmakers, producers, and production management to keep casting moving from character breakdown through final booking.
  • Creative Input: Bring thoughtful, character-driven casting ideas across multiple titles, and present options with clear rationale to Directors and Producers.
  • Shortlists & Reels: Review self-tape submissions and put forth selects for Casting Director input. Source audio clips from existing performances, interviews, and reels that best show an actor's range and character fit, edit them into polished casting reels tailored to specific roles and titles, and compile shortlists in a clear, professional format.
  • Production Partnership: Communicate casting updates clearly to production, production management, and other internal teams, and keep casting timelines and deal statuses current.

Talent & Industry Relationships

  • Agent & Talent Relations: Serve as the primary point of contact for agencies, managers, and independent actors on auditions, callbacks, availability, and session bookings. Manage talent relations with professionalism, discretion, and sensitivity.
  • Deals & Clearances: Track start paperwork, credits, and deal statuses, and flag SAG-AFTRA considerations and clearances so they are handled accurately and on time.
  • Talent Discovery: Track emerging and established performers across animation, live action, stage, and international markets, and share knowledge of diverse talent pools to broaden casting options.

Team Captain

  • Auditions & Recording Sessions: Oversee audition materials (breakdowns, sides, reference clips) and coordinate session logistics with production and internal partners, including script distribution, NDAs, studio bookings, remote recording, travel, and hospitality.
  • Records & Mentorship: Oversee casting grids, talent databases, casting notes, and session reports, and mentor associates and coordinators in their casting and creative judgment.

What You'll Need:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in casting, talent representation, or production in film, television, animation, or games, including experience leading projects or people. Voice casting and animation production pipeline experience preferred.
  • Industry Acumen: An established network among talent agencies, management companies, and casting offices, with a track record of sourcing talent and a high comfort level working with filmmakers and senior executives.
  • Business & Deal Acumen: Working knowledge of SAG-AFTRA considerations, start paperwork, and talent representation, with strong organizational discipline. Familiarity with casting software or databases preferred.
  • Creative Judgment & Passion: A strong ear for performance, tone, and character authenticity, and a demonstrated passion for storytelling, character, and performance, especially in animation.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a professional and diplomatic approach with agents, talent, and internal teams, and the ability to present casting options clearly to directors and producers.
  • Judgment & Autonomy: Sound independent judgment and calm, solutions-oriented problem-solving. Sets priorities, manages multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders at once, pivots quickly as schedules shift, and handles confidential information with discretion.
  • Inclusivity: A commitment to inclusive, representative casting and respectful engagement with talent from diverse backgrounds.
  • Tools: Core: Adobe Audition or Pro Tools (or similar), Adobe Premiere (or similar), Adobe Acrobat, Final Draft, Google Workspace, Microsoft Word, Slack, and SAG clearance. Frequent: Audio Hijack, Photoshop and Illustrator, Zoom. Bonus: Dropbox, Lala.AI.

This role is based in the US.

title: Sr Tax Analyst, LATAM
locations: Mexico City, Mexico
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services with over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

As Netflix continues our global expansion, we look for the best and brightest talent to play a key role in our growth. That's where you come in!


We are seeking a Senior Tax Analyst with strong technical tax knowledge and hands-on experience in tax compliance and tax accounting to support our LATAM operations (excluding Brazil), based out of our Mexico City office. This role is the backbone of our regional tax compliance and reporting cycle. It owns the accuracy and timeliness of filings, the income tax provision and the related reporting to our global tax team.


You will combine hands-on execution of direct and indirect tax compliance with the preparation of the Income Tax Provision under US GAAP, including reporting through GAM (Global Access Module). You will work closely with Accounting, Treasury, FP&A, the Global Tax Reporting team, external advisors and tax authorities.


You will report to the Sr. Tax Manager, LATAM in Mexico City. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, technically strong, comfortable with large data sets and tight deadlines, and always looking for ways to make the process more efficient.


Responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities will be executing and owning the recurring tax compliance and tax reporting processes for the LATAM region. Your day-to-day activities will include:


  • Prepare and review monthly, annual and informative direct and indirect tax filings: provisional income tax payments, VAT returns, withholding taxes, DIOT/informative returns, electronic accounting, ISSIF and other annual ancillary obligations and annual tax returns..
  • Coordinate deadlines and deliverables with third-party service providers, being responsible for filing and paying the tax returns on time, while also being resourceful on providing service providers the information needed to file. 
  • Prepare the quarterly and annual Income Tax Provision under US GAAP (ASC 740): current and deferred tax calculations, effective tax rate analysis, tax account rollforwards and return-to-provision true-ups.
  • Prepare, load and review provision packages in GAM (Global Access Module). Make sure data is complete, consistent and delivered on time to the Global Tax Reporting team.
  • Own tax month-end and quarter-end close activities: tax journal entries in Workday, balance sheet account reconciliations in Blackline, and flux analysis of tax accounts.
  • Reconcile tax and accounting data (book-to-tax differences, CFDI vs. ledger, intercompany balances) and document the support for positions taken.
  • Support tax and statutory audits and authority requests by gathering information, preparing reconciliations and working papers, and coordinating with external advisors.
  • Support transfer pricing compliance, including intercompany data for local files, related-party informative returns and year-end adjustments.
  • Maintain the regional tax compliance calendar and the related SOX controls and process documentation.
  • Identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities, including GenAI tools, to reduce manual work and strengthen controls.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent; CPA or Master's in Tax is a plus.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in tax compliance and tax accounting, ideally in Big 4 and/or a multinational company. Mexico is required; LATAM exposure is a plus.
  • Strong technical knowledge of Mexican direct and indirect taxes (Income Tax, VAT, withholding taxes, CFDI requirements) and familiarity with SAT/other government platforms.
  • Proven hands-on experience preparing the Income Tax Provision under US GAAP (ASC 740), including deferred taxes and return-to-provision.
  • Experience with GAM (Global Access Module) or similar tax provision/reporting tools (e.g., OneSource Tax Provision, Longview, CorpTax) is highly desirable.
  • Highly proficient in spreadsheets and large data sets; experience with Workday, Blackline and Google suite is a plus.
  • Strong accounting background; able to read financial statements and trace tax impacts end-to-end.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines across entities at the same time.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills; able to explain technical tax matters in plain terms to non-tax partners.
  • Hands-on, ownership mentality with a continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Fluent in Spanish and English (written and spoken).

descriptionHtml:

title: Merchandiser (CEE), Product Merchandising
locations: Warsaw, Poland
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Product Merchandising team connects members to Netflix's world of entertainment by blending intuitive merchandising and market expertise to position, promote, and present content so members find it easy and enjoyable to choose what they'll love. 


The Product Merchandising Team CEE positions our local award-winning, industry-leading content for distribution on the Netflix service through our work on individual titles as well as the broader catalogue in our markets. 


The Role

Product Merchandising blends intuitive merchandising strategy and deep local expertise to position, promote, and present content — making it easy and enjoyable for every Netflix member to choose what they'll love. We're blending global scale with deep local expertise, and we're looking for people who can bring both. 


As a Merchandiser, you shape the merchandising experience for Netflix members in your markets — across creative, editorial, and catalogue dimensions. You are a platform-first impact driver: someone who shapes how the Netflix experience looks, reads, and feels for members across Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) across every surface, every content format, and every moment. This role is based in Warsaw, with Poland being our priority market. Experience from other markets across CEE is a big plus. 


What You'll Do


Shape the Local Member Experience 

  • Drive the local CEE merchandising calendar — planning activations around title launches, cultural moments, seasonal trends, and member lifecycle milestones throughout the year.
  • Lead distribution and promotion strategy for local title launches — from positioning and merchandising strategy through to post-launch performance.
  • Propose, develop, and execute catalog activations (rows, hubs, custom promotions) that drive content discovery and reflect what resonates culturally with consumers in your market.
  • Develop messaging campaigns — push notifications, emails — that connect members to content they'll love, timed to the moments and titles that matter locally.
  • Editorialize catalog content beyond new launches to support member engagement, surfacing library titles and hidden gems at the right point in the member journey. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to drive business impact at the local level through this work.
  • Connect the dots between platform logic, consumer insights, and content strategy to drive strong merchandising activations and learning agendas. 
  • Apply deep awareness of local trends, social and cultural zeitgeist, and platform behavior to shape what gets surfaced, when, and how — in close partnership with Marketing and Comms.
  • Advocate for your market's needs in regional and global conversations, sharing context that cross-functional partners cannot access without you.
  • Work closely with Content, Marketing, Product teams, and external agency partners to proactively share context, surface trade-offs, and align on priorities to deliver a cohesive member experience.
  • Operate within global governance frameworks and playbooks, ensuring local activations complement the global calendar.
  • Act as the local intelligence layer to surface on-the-ground market insights and trends, and contribute to playbooks and standards that can be scaled across markets in partnership with local Consumer Insights and Content Strategy.

Creative & Editorial 

  • Partner with local Marketing teams on Product Title Creative Assets for priority titles, using external agencies where additional assets may be required. Briefing and reviewing imagery, copy, and promotional materials. 
  • Ensure Product Assets across image, AV, and copy adhere to Netflix's standards for quality, consistency, and local authenticity.
  • Operate within the global Merchandising Playbook while driving locally resonant decisions. 
  • Use AV where needed to deepen member engagement across the title lifecycle and provide clear, actionable feedback to ensure output meets positioning, creative guidelines, and timelines.
  • Partner with internal Creative Services and Design teams to ensure assets perform across all devices, with particular mastery of mobile as a primary discovery canvas in CEE.
  • Optimize consumer messaging (email, push, in-app notifications) that feels genuinely individual — tailored to member behavior and lifestyle signals, not generic promotional copy.

Turn Data into insights to drive better experiences

  • Partner with regional Performance Analysts and Technical Merchandising to monitor and report on activations at the local level. Ensure hypotheses created at the local level are reflected in data gathered post-launch. 
  • Contribute to A/B testing and experimentation, using data, dashboards, analytics tools, alongside qualitative market insight to continuously improve the member experience.
  • Think in business outcomes, not just creative outputs: track and communicate the impact of merchandising decisions on member engagement, viewing behavior, and platform health metrics to your peers and cross-functional partners.
  • Write clear, well-reasoned strategic briefs that articulate the why behind your activation decisions and earn alignment from partners and leadership.
  • Fluency in business metrics and translating them to merchandising strategy. You understand the CEE business inside out, think member-first, and know how to bridge both to achieve ambitious business impact. 

What We're Looking For

  • A proven ability to engage customers via digital promotional and/or merchandising tactics, driving product engagement in an authentic and culturally relevant manner. 
  • Deep cultural fluency in Poland (other CEE markets are a plus!) and curiosity to learn about new ones. You understand what resonates, what's trending, and what members in Poland & key CEE markets respond to.
  • A strong track record of using data to make decisions — you're comfortable reading consumer insight studies, dashboards, spotting patterns, and translating insights into action.
  • Experience writing strategic briefs: you can define a problem clearly, build hypotheses, stress-test your own assumptions before making a recommendation with conviction, and bring stakeholders along.
  • Think in systems: you instinctively connect content, members, product behavior, and market context into a coherent picture, and you know which questions to ask to fill in the gaps before forming a view.
  • A collaborative approach: you work well across functions, time zones, and seniority levels, and you know when to push back and when to align.
  • Genuinely love entertainment: you are an avid consumer of content across film, series, and beyond, and you bring real passion and taste to the work.
  • Native or full professional fluency in Polish and English; mastery of Polish editorial and cultural standards.  
  • Work experience/ language knowledge from other markets across CEE, e.g., Romanian, Czech, Hungarian, is a big plus.

title: Customer Service Analytics & Insights Analyst
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


Summary

The CS Analytics & Insights Analyst combines two areas of work within Customer Service (CS). The first is demand forecasting judgment: interpreting the output of the CS demand forecast, applying informed overlays for events the model cannot yet see, explaining variances, and providing the final demand outlook used for staffing decisions. The second is CS Insights: using contact-driver analysis, customer-experience data and conversation analysis to explain why customers contact CS and where the opportunities are.


The two areas reinforce each other. Contact-driver insights improve the forecast, and forecast variances point to the questions insights work should investigate. This is an analytical and operational role; forecasting tools and statistical models are maintained by partner teams. This role focuses on data and insight generated through Customer Service, and works alongside enterprise consumer-insights teams rather than in place of them.


Responsibilities


Forecasting judgment

  • Interpret the CS demand forecast: review model output, identify where human judgment or overrides are warranted, and document the rationale.
  • Build overlays and scenarios for known upcoming events (product launches, pricing and policy changes, live events, outages, marketing activity, market-specific anomalies) and quantify likely demand ranges.
  • Perform forecast variance and root-cause analysis to understand not only how far the forecast missed but why, and identify systematic bias by market, channel, contact driver, horizon or event type.
  • Share learnings with the teams that maintain the forecasting tools, and translate operational context into clear requirements for improvement.
  • Maintain the forecasting calendar, assumptions, event inputs and forecast-accuracy measures.
  • Provide the final demand outlook to Workforce Management and Capacity Planning partners, including assumptions about GenAI deflection and contact mix.
  • Identify repeatable preparation, validation and QA work that can be automated.

CS Insights

  • Conduct CS contact-driver and customer-experience analysis to explain demand shifts, emerging friction points and the effect of product, pricing and policy changes on CS contacts.
  • Support launch tracking and post-launch evaluation, and deliver recurring insights through templates and reports.
  • Work with CS vendor partners to execute routine research tasks, provide clear instructions, and review outputs for quality.
  • Contribute quantitative analysis, and over time qualitative and mixed-methods work, to research projects scoped with the CS Analytics & Insights Lead.

title: Senior Creative Technologist, Games GenAI
locations: Remote, United States
Los Angeles, California, United States of America
Los Gatos, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We’re seeking a seasoned Sr Creative Technologist, with sharp, proven design and creative instincts for what makes a game fun. Someone who can turn ideas into prototyped experiences, holding a clear point of view on visual style, voice and tone, sound, and overall execution. The ideal candidate is someone who treats generative AI as an instrument for creative exploration, not a shortcut - in service of finding the ideas that are genuinely good.


About the Role

Generative AI is opening up new creative possibilities for games, and the craft that matters most is knowing which of those possibilities are genuinely good, and shaping the promising ones into something that's truly fun to play. As Sr Creative Technologist, Games GenAI, you'll use GenAI tools to explore game concepts, levels, and moments — then bring that same creative direction to life across visual style, voice/tone, sound, and overall execution so what emerges feels intentional and true to the vision.


You'll work across three kinds of projects: early-stage prototypes and proofs of concept with external partners that push the frontier of what's possible; in-production titles; and internal experiments where you'll do a mix of hands-on building and creative guidance for engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

Build and iterate on playable game prototypes using GenAI-accelerated workflows (agentic coding tools, generative image/video/audio, level and narrative prototyping tools) to explore whether a concept, mechanic, or moment truly comes alive — trying many directions in service of finding the right one.

Design and prototype pipelines connecting generative AI APIs to DCC tools and engine-side systems (Unreal Python API, Editor Utility Widgets, Unity).

Bring hands-on creative guidance to prototypes and in-flight projects: visual style and mood, voice and narrative tone, sound and music direction, and overall game feel/execution, translating a fuzzy creative intent ("make it feel like this") into concrete direction a team can build against.

Translate creative direction into technical game design: requirements, systems, and documentation precise enough that engineering can build against them.

Partner with the broader Games GenAI team to identify which GenAI tools and pipelines are worth building out, informed by what actually improves creative quality and the team's ability to iterate, not just what's technically possible.

Work directly with external development partners and internal project leads to give clear, opinionated creative feedback during early prototyping and proof-of-concept phases, grounded in the capabilities and gaps of GenAI.

Run workshops, demos, and office hours to help other teams get better at using GenAI tools for creative exploration.

Stay current on new GenAI creative tools (narrative/dialogue generation, procedural level design, voice and audio synthesis, image/video style transfer) and assess them primarily through a creative-quality lens.


Qualifications

Strong track record as a game director, lead designer, or similarly senior creative role, with shipped game(s) where you owned or heavily shaped creative direction (visual style, narrative voice, sound, or overall execution).

Hands-on comfort building rapid prototypes — using agentic coding tools, engine scripting, or no-code/low-code tools

Hands-on experience building with GenAI models and technologies to create new game experiences — to prototype mechanics, content, or systems that wouldn't have been possible otherwise.

Experience directing across multiple creative disciplines at once (visual, narrative, audio) and synthesizing them into a coherent creative vision, under time pressure and with imperfect tools.

It’s an amazing time to join Netflix as we continue shaping the future of global entertainment, bringing new stories to millions of people worldwide. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) and Fire Life Safety (FLS) inspections and risk assessments, and for providing support as an EHS subject matter expert to assist in maintaining EHS programs and delivering training. A successful candidate will be an expert in their field, will be passionate, self-motivated, proactive, quick-thinking, flexible, able to pivot when necessary, thorough, and able to handle multiple and diverse responsibilities with a strong emphasis on organization and an unwavering attention to detail at all times.   • Conduct regular Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) and Fire Life Safety (FLS) inspections, actively participate in internal and external EHS audits, and support the timely closeout of identified corrective actions.

descriptionHtml:

Experience & Skills

  • At least 6-8 Years of experience in media research at Streaming, TV, or digital media companies.

descriptionHtml:

Measurement Science & Analytics (MSA) is responsible for how we measure content performance. What you will do

・ Make sure each metric has a clear owner and is well maintained. Team members own individual metrics; you support them and get involved when a decision needs it.

・ Develop a view on how our measurement should change over time, and shape it with business leaders in Content, Finance, and Product.

・ Help partners work out what to measure when new questions come up, and how much rigor the answer needs.

Within CPD, Promotional Assets & Creative Technology (PACT) builds the technology that promotes content on and off the service.

The team is a mix of UI and backend engineers. They work across Java and Spring Boot services, React and TypeScript frontends, GraphQL, and Netflix's managed data and workflow platforms. Our users include internal creative, marketing, and localization partners as well as external vendors and agencies, and our systems feed the artwork members see every day.


The role

You will lead an established team of software engineers who own a broad portfolio of artwork products, growing its people and shaping its direction.


What you will do

  • Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, and develop UI and backend engineers. Set a high bar and build a culture of ownership, open feedback, and inclusion.

  • Partner broadly. Work with product, design, and peer engineering managers, and with creative, marketing, and localization stakeholders, as well as external vendors and agencies. Influence direction, communicate complex ideas clearly, and prioritize beyond the edges of your own domain.

title: Product Manager, Ads Creative

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Our ad-supported tier has become one of the fastest-growing parts of the business. Advertisers are drawn to our premium, minimally disruptive ad experience that reaches deeply engaged, hard-to-reach audiences at scale, with a growing product suite built for the next generation of advertising.


Our Team

The Ads Platform team builds the advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world class content delivery ecosystem. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drives great outcomes for advertisers.


Our team is new and yet faced with the ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that's rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that differentiate Netflix from other ad-supported streaming services.


We are looking for a Product Manager in the advertising space who is excited to join us on this journey.


About the Role

Assets are a critical part of how creative gets built at Netflix. We're making a significant investment in helping advertisers bring high-quality assets to our platform, from driving asset comprehension and holding a consistent quality bar to building the tools that help buyers meet that bar, whether by using what they already have, adapting something they've run before, or tailoring what they provide to our needs.


This product manager will own the asset experience end to end, making it fast, clear, and low-friction for any advertiser, through any channel, to go from a submitted asset to a fully formed creative that's ready to run.


This PM will:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for creative assets across the advertiser journey, from submission through readiness for use in a creative
  • Define and evolve the quality standards and requirements for assets, and make them clear and consistent for advertisers, partners, and internal teams
  • Build tools that help buyers create, adapt, and improve assets to meet our quality bar, applying automation and generative AI where they unlock the most value
  • Make asset issues easy to understand and resolve, with clear diagnostics and workflows that keep advertisers in control of their creative
  • Define success metrics for your product area, using data and feedback to guide prioritization and continuous improvement
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, ad operations, creative production, policy, and legal to deliver products that drive measurable advertiser and business outcomes

We're seeking a candidate who has

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience launching and scaling platform, tooling, or workflow products, ideally in media, content pipelines, or creative production
  • Experience defining quality standards or requirements that multiple teams and external users depend on
  • Experience building products that use automation, machine learning, or generative AI, with an understanding of their quality and trust considerations
  • A track record of designing self-service experiences for external users that reduce friction and complexity
  • Strategic judgment to own a clear, prioritized roadmap that ladders into the broader demand and ad business strategy, balancing foundational work with high-visibility impact
  • Strong communication skills and a bias for clarity, impact, and simplicity, with the ability to engage stakeholders and build trust
  • Proven ability to partner with engineering, design, data science and operations teams to drive alignment and deliver results
  • Strong leadership qualities: curious, tenacious, proactive, data-driven and customer-centric
  • Ads or creative production experience is a strong plus but not required

title: Technical Director Performance
locations: Sydney, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

The Opportunity:


The Performance Technical Director is responsible for supporting creative and visual objectives through pipeline troubleshooting, user support, technical direction, and tool development. The TD exhibits relevant technical understanding of processes, technology, and tools within the layout and animation craft group/s. The TD will participate in the development of artist workflows and tools used for large-scale animation features, and can easily debug problematic workflow steps to support global studio productions in that area. The TD will collaborate closely with their craft group, the Solutions Engineering and R&D teams to enable high-quality technical outcomes and a standardized approach.


What You’ll Do: 


  • Understand the visual requirements for productions and suggest new technologies, or design procedures, techniques, and tools that will enable these to be met.
  • Provide technical expertise and guidance for technology within the relevant production craft groups.
  • Participate in or lead the direction, evolution & maintenance of technology within layout and animation.
  • Design, develop, and write well-maintainable and consistently high-quality code.
  • Track, debug and resolve workflow issues in partnership with Lead TDs, Technical Supervisors, Associate Technical Supervisors, Solutions Engineers and R&D.
  • Work closely with other TD’s on your team to contribute to the technical success of key development initiatives.
  • Ensure that technology, tools, and procedures support the creative process.
  • Help provide solutions to visual problems through existing tools or by leading the implementation of new tools.
  • Partner on troubleshooting & optimization of tools, software, and workflows.
  • Actively participate in QA, technical testing, and validation of new technology, tool releases, or pipeline changes, such that artist workflow is not impacted.
  • Understand the processes of adjoining departments, provide input where required to maximise pipeline efficiency and quality.
  • Actively participate in brainstorming and problem-solving, contributing technical expertise and insight, to create and maintain technology within the canonical production pipeline.
  • Support the organisation’s overall technical goals as required.
  • Be aware of the deadlines for development initiatives and actively engage in keeping these on track.
  • Continuously monitor the scope of development initiatives and help to ensure scope adjustments have additional estimates, etc.
  • Prioritise and break down technical projects into organised parts.
  • Provide technical guidance to other TDs and TAs, where appropriate, with day-to-day issues and escalation through the right channels when necessary.
  • Create synergies between different work groups to promote efficiency and optimization and to generate innovative ideas and approaches to how we do things

What You’ll Need:


  • 5+ years of pipeline TD experience in large-scale animated features, animated TV series, the gaming industry, and/or VFX feature films.
  • Professional experience as a TD, ideally as part of a collaborative team environment.
  • Experience using and troubleshooting in Maya and/or other similar software in the animation domain.
  • Proficiency in Python as well as PyQt or another GUI toolkit.
  • Knowledge of concepts like data flow, data dependencies, metadata, publishing, and retrieval.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to artists of varying technical levels. 
  • Familiarity with USD and its general concepts.
  • Ability to code review and troubleshoot problems as they arise.
  • Knowledge of Flow Production Tracking (shotgrid).
  • Knowledge of code management software such as git and github and code review processes.
  • Knowledge of software development practices such as Agile and how to apply them in software such as Jira is a plus.
  • Degree in Animation, Film, Computer Science, Design, Engineering, Math or Physics, or equivalent combination of education & work experience in animation/VFX.

This role is based in Sydney, Australia. Hybrid Role (Minimum requirement of 3 days a week in the office).

descriptionHtml:

In a culture that supports creativity and innovation as key competencies, this position will be responsible for supporting and managing immigration and relocation for our employees and their families. Our programs are flexible, tailored, and designed with both the employee and the business in mind. We pride ourselves on assisting all employees with settling into their new location, with minimal impact on the employee, their family, and the business.

Your Responsibilities:

  • You will act as a consultant to employees and their families and work closely with internal and external partners to oversee and ensure that each employee's needs are effectively managed throughout the transfer or assignment life cycle.

You will identify opportunities to refine information available to the shared services team to improve responses and the availability of self-service information.

  • You've done this before. You will bring 5+ years of mobility and/or immigration experience in a global organization, with tax exposure a plus. 
  • You understand the technology, trends, and best practices currently affecting the mobility landscape, including AI.
  • You care about our employees and their families. You can thoughtfully and empathetically support employees/families through their relocation journey. You understand the personal nature of one’s relocation journey and are sensitive to their privacy.
  • You possess strong customer service skills and deliver high-quality customer-oriented services. You’re an active listener, can connect the dots, are proactive, and are quick to resolve open issues.

In this role, you’ll work closely with our Title and Social Marketing Managers and take ownership of the end-to-end production of marketing materials, from brief to delivery. Production Management: Oversee end-to-end production for marketing asset creation, marketing and social shoots, and marketing activations for our Nordic markets. Develop production timelines, allocate resources, and ensure deadlines are met by our production partners.

Process / Operational Improvements: Identify and implement improvements to enhance the efficiency, clarity, and effectiveness of our production processes and workflows together with internal and external stakeholders, while helping shape stronger ways of working across teams.

Risk Management: Identify potential project and production risks and develop ways to mitigate them. Continuously monitor project and production progress, and be proactive in addressing issues before they escalate.

  • Builds effective working relationships across teams and with external partners.

title: Software Engineer 5 - Android (DVX Mobile Core)
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The DVX Mobile Core team is responsible for developing and advancing the architecture of our member app for Android. We aim to leverage the systems and infrastructure that is broadly available at Netflix and figure out the best ways to adopt and apply it on Android. The Core team works with a wide range of engineering groups within the company to enable easier and more efficient patterns and canvases to be deployed to our members. Some of these changes are purely engineering-based, for example to improve key user metrics, while others serve to adopt cleaner development patterns for downstream product engineering.

We are part of a global, diverse organization that includes people of all genders, sexual orientations, upbringings, nationalities, ages, and socioeconomic & educational backgrounds. We encourage engineers passionate about building well-structured mobile experiences to apply.

What this role is:

  • You'll own major, multi-quarter initiatives that make other engineers faster and more confident. Today, that work falls into four themes:
  • Architecture. Product teams duplicate effort and step on each other. You'll help build coherent, reusable architecture, including server-driven UI, a data-centric approach to app development, modularization, and unidirectional state flow, so teams can move independently at scale.
  • Quality. Regressions are too easy to ship and too hard to see. You'll help make quality measurable through testing, trusted telemetry, and clear reliability standards in a high-commit-volume codebase.
  • Player. Product teams should spend their time on differentiated viewing experiences, not plumbing. You'll help deliver a reliable, extensible player framework they can build on.
  • Innovation. Engineering across Mobile can move faster. You'll turn emerging technologies, including AI, into practical tools that accelerate it.

What you'll do:

  • Own outcomes end to end
  • Take ambiguous problems from idea to adoption: define scope, design the solution, document key trade-offs, deliver, and measure whether it worked.
  • Influence technical roadmaps and drive forward-looking technical solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Run projects like an owner: break work into milestones, surface risk early and manage cross-team dependencies.
  • Ship the pragmatic solution and change course when the evidence says so.
  • Build what others build on
  • Design and build UI infrastructure and architecture that make the right way the easy way.
  • Write the documentation and migration paths that let other teams adopt your work without you in the room.
  • Raise the quality bar with testable code, automated tests (JVM unit, Espresso, Paparazzi bitmap diffs), and telemetry that make regressions visible.
  • Elevate the people around you
  • Treat engineers as your customers. Understand their use cases, and let them shape the solution.
  • Mentor less-experienced engineers and help set the technical bar for the team.
  • Track emerging Android technologies, and turn the promising ones into real tools and modernized code.

You're likely a fit if you have:

  • Owned something big. You've led a multi-month, cross-team technical initiative from ambiguity to adoption, and you can tell us how you scoped it, planned it, and measured its impact.
  • Driven your own agenda. You've spotted a problem nobody assigned you, built the case, and delivered the fix.
  • Run projects with discipline. You have a record of delivering in milestones, early risk communication, and delivering results.
  • Deep Android expertise. You're strong in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, and you've applied architecture patterns (MVVM, unidirectional flow, modularization) in a large codebase. You can work in Java and GraphQL when needed.
  • Practical judgment. You weigh business, user, and architectural trade-offs, and you know when good enough is right.
  • Clear communication. You build trust across product, design, and engineering by being curious, direct, and selfless.
  • Bonus: server-driven UI, Circuit, Paparazzi, media playback or player frameworks, telemetry and reliability engineering, or AI-assisted development workflows.

Why this role:

  • A rare moment. You'll help lay the mobile foundation for one of the world's most-used entertainment apps.
  • Leverage. One good framework multiplies the output of 100+ engineers and reaches hundreds of millions of members.
  • Real ownership. You'll get the business context you need and decide scope, design, and trade-offs.
  • Hard problems, good people. You'll work with talented peers across a wide range of devices and network conditions, in a culture of open communication where you value others' opinions to cover your blind spots.
  • A high-performance culture. If you've read about Netflix's culture and think you'd thrive in it, we'd like to talk.

From producing global town halls and shaping leadership meetings to fresh, creative experiences that bring employees along, this team has a front-row seat to what’s happening across the business—and helps ensure everyone else gets a clear view, too.

title: Senior Manager, Employee Onboarding
locations: Los Angeles, California, United States of America
Los Gatos, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Our Talent team supports our teams around the globe so they can do the best work of their lives. Within Talent Management, we are looking for a leader to own our onboarding strategy. Our culture drives how we work, and we need someone who cares as deeply about our culture as they do about building great onboarding experiences. 


Onboarding is how great talent becomes excellent at Netflix. At most organizations, it’s logistics: badge, laptop, benefits, go. Here, it’s where new hires learn how great work gets done: the business, the culture, the people, and the job. We aim for a Dream Team of people who are great at what they do and even better at working together, and onboarding is where that starts.


Who you are 


You’re a generalist at heart with a strong working knowledge of product ownership and strategy, experience design, project/program management, and event management. You will coach and support your team in each specialty and drive towards outcomes for the onboarding portfolio.


What this role is like


You’ll join Talent Management on a team that runs some of the most visible programs at Netflix, from Onboarding to Leader Development and Organizational Effectiveness, and everything in between. You’ll lead a high-performing, multidisciplinary team, set a clear vision for onboarding, and inspire your team and partners to move towards it. You’ll trust your team to make thoughtful decisions and create an environment where people are challenged and supported to do their best work. 


You’ll be accountable for the onboarding strategy, beginning with global leader and executive onboarding, and build it so that the work extends to other regions. You’ll also lead the delivery of our largest live learning event in the US and Canada [UCAN] and help decide how and when to scale live learning globally. Managers are the biggest driver of onboarding quality, so you’ll shape what comes next with them, not for them. 


Building something new at this scale is bold, ambitious, and sometimes uncomfortable. You won’t wait to be told what to build. You’ll make the case, farm for dissent before you decide, commit once you do, and own the result. We hire unusually responsible people and give them context, not control, and we expect you to do the same with your team.


This role is US-based, from our offices in Los Gatos, CA, or Los Angeles, CA. You’ll report to the Director, Talent Management, UCAN.


What you’ll own


You’ll own the onboarding product and be accountable for its outcome: accelerating new hire effectiveness. Onboarding is good today, and we believe it can be even better tomorrow. You’ll start with the problem, stay accountable after launch, and use data and customer signals to decide what to improve, scale, or retire. You’ll balance global consistency with local needs, and bring in Talent Analytics, Talent Tech & Operations, Talent Acquisition, Inclusion, Compensation, global HRBPs, and Talent Leadership early, as One Talent Team.


Within Onboarding, you and your team will own and develop: 


  • Exec Onboarding [VP, Sr Director]: tailored touchpoints for incoming VPs, plus VP-specific enablement for hiring managers, HRBPs, and onboarding buddies
  • Leader Onboarding [Managers, Directors]: new leaders, including live learning and leader-specific enablement for hiring managers, HRBPs, and buddies
  • Employee Onboarding: new individual contributors, including live learning for new hires and enablement for hiring managers, HRBPs, and onboarding buddies
  • Onboarding Digital Hub: the digital home for all new hires, with self-serve content on the business, our culture, and leadership
  • Early Career Hires: onboarding for new grads and early career hires

What you’ll do:


  • Lead and develop a small, multidisciplinary team of experienced designers and project managers with clear expectations, candid feedback, and room to grow.
  • Focus your team on high-impact priorities, matching capabilities to the biggest opportunities, and communicating trade-offs and non-goals explicitly.
  • Lead your team to manage the full product lifecycle, from problem discovery and launch to continuous iteration or retirement.
  • Guide the experience design direction, translating business strategy and employee insights into a cohesive onboarding experience.
  • Define target outcomes up front and track metrics for effectiveness, efficiency, engagement, and experience, ensuring equity across regions and teams.
  • Establish core standards for all new hires [onboarding plans, buddies, clear goals] while creating memorable touchpoints that keep processes lightweight and flexible
  • Set clear expectations and tools for hiring managers, and clarify who does what across recruiters, HRBPs, buddies, and leaders.
  • Build for the future by anticipating how our business and workforce are evolving, encouraging experimentation, challenging conventional approaches, and exploring new technologies and modalities.
  • Partner with global talent management teams to drive the greatest impact

Requirements


  • 10+ years  leading people, including hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing multidisciplinary teams, with candid feedback and a culture of trust and accountability 
  • 10+ years in HR, Talent Management, or Org Development, including 5+ years building and scaling onboarding or employee experience programs
  • Influence and facilitation skills across teams and leadership levels, including senior stakeholders without authority, even when the path is unclear.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen to connect business priorities and employee needs, define a future state, and turn complex problems into a roadmap
  • Experience owning a product or program against an outcome over time, and leading complex initiatives across multi-disciplinary stakeholders
  • Human-centered design leadership, from problem framing through implementation and iteration, creating scalable experiences with measurable results
  • Generalist range across product ownership, experience design, project/program management, and event management, with enough depth to coach specialists in each
  • First principles and systems thinking across the talent management system, with a willingness to challenge assumptions and try new approaches and technologies
  • Analytical rigor and sound judgment; when to rely on data versus intuition.
  • Resilience, self-awareness, and high standards, with comfort building new programs from scratch in fast-paced environments
  • Deep passion for Netflix culture
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%, domestically and internationally

Preferred experience


  • 12+ years in the field, including 7+ years building onboarding at a mid to large global organization
  • Track record of leading teams to scale programs across global regions while maintaining quality
  • Experience in leading a team through change, such as a new strategy, a reorg, or a shift in the way we get things done
  • Experience designing executive transitions and helping leaders integrate culture through practice
  • Experience leading cross-functional work with business leaders, talent partners, tech, and analytics using agile and design thinking frameworks
  • Experience leading in a product-centric model, including setting outcome measures and building early feedback loops
  • Interest in guiding your team and partners to explore how AI and new tech can improve workplace learning and productivity

title: Associate Counsel, Litigation & Regulatory - India
locations: Mumbai, India
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

We are looking for a talented legal professional to join our litigation & commerce legal team in Mumbai, India as an Associate Counsel. APAC is one of our fastest growing regions and, in this role, you will be instrumental in helping our team in India deliver quick and practical solutions for a wide range of legal issues. You will support the local team on pre-litigation, litigation, and content grievances- including maintaining and driving efficiency in grievance tracking processes- which involves working closely with business teams to give actionable advice. title: Security Software Engineer 5
locations: Poland - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Security Services Engineering organization supports the Netflix workforce by creating and operating the security access control model, including, but not limited to, authentication, authorization, and cryptographic software services. Our Access Control use cases will continue to become more complex as we increase investment in Netflix Originals content production ecosystems, including but not limited to Content, GenAI, Ads, Gaming, Live streaming, and more. Our workforce and partners are global, and they access our information in different patterns and with varying needs from various locations and devices. With security and ease of information access in mind for our fast-paced growth, we realize that the traditional corporate network security perimeter no longer meets our requirements. Instead, we invest in Identity as a perimeter in the open internet, with reliable, robust, and strong access-control models and services to protect our information.


The Role

This role is a unique opportunity to build the access experience layer at Netflix — designing, building, and operating the services that make access control safe and simple for hundreds of internal engineering teams. You will be part of the Access Experience Engineering (AXE) team in Warsaw, Poland, focusing on the integration and experience layer that sits on top of Netflix's core access control infrastructure. You will partner closely with ACE and the SSE Org, both primarily based in UCAN, as part of a follow-the-sun, async-first model.

You will be responsible for a mix of projects encompassing ownership of system design, implementation, partner integration, rollout strategy, and maintenance of access tooling and integration services — including the adoption layer for Turnstile, Netflix's next-generation access management platform, as well as APIs, SDKs, and self-service workflows that enable internal teams to implement access securely and consistently.


One engineer on this team will serve as the in-timezone security anchor — a technical lead who brings a pragmatic, risk-aware lens to AXE's designs and implementations and partners directly with ACE Core on security architecture decisions.


What you'll need to be successful:

  • You are a collaborative problem-solver who excels at navigating ambiguity, making and communicating self-driven decisions, and weighing trade-offs. You own the problems and influence others.
  • Pragmatic engineer focused on building scalable, reliable, high-availability, and low-latency services.
  • Proficiency in modern languages (Java preferred, or Kotlin, Go, Python) and a willingness to traverse the tech stack.
  • Experience designing and building developer-facing APIs, SDKs, and integration patterns that make complex systems easy for other teams to adopt.
  • Familiarity with access control and IAM concepts — identity, authentication, authorization, roles, groups, attributes, and resource models. Experience with auth protocols, including OpenID Connect, OAuth, SAML, and SCIM, is valuable; strong software engineering fundamentals with a genuine interest in the domain are equally welcome.
  • Experience with GraphQL, gRPC, Rest, etc
  • You possess strong written communication skills and a product-focused mindset, with a security-first approach, allowing you to deliver effective solutions while operating effectively across EMEA and UCAN time zones in an async-first environment.

Nice to have:

  • Expertise in designing complex Access Control Models using industry standards like RBAC, ABAC, or PBAC.
  • Experience in continuous integration and continuous deployment in a Cloud platform.
  • Experience with NoSQL technologies such as Hive, Presto, Spark, or Cassandra.
  • Experience with Graph databases.
  • React or modern frontend framework experience for full-stack roles.

locations: Los Gatos, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


Job Overview

We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test who is passionate about quality and test automation to join the TV & Web Player Developer Experience and Release Quality team. We own end-to-end testing, build systems, CI/CD, and the infrastructure and tooling behind them, so that player engineers have fast, reliable developer workflows and the clients that power Netflix playback in web browsers and on a huge range of TV and streaming devices ship quickly and with high quality.


This role focuses on test automation, covering both feature and performance testing. You will develop the test strategy, automated tests for new player features as they are built, from core streaming to live events and ad-supported viewing; you will maintain our current automated test suites; you will make sure our players perform well across the wide variety of devices our members use; and you will lead innovation in how test automation gets developed in the first place, so that coverage keeps pace with a fast release cadence and the team trusts the results enough to block a merge or a release on them.


About the Role

  • Partner with player engineers early in feature development to own the end-to-end and functional test strategy for new features: which member scenarios need coverage, which tests should gate a merge or release, and what test streams, data, and upstream support those scenarios depend on.
  • Own performance testing: build automated performance tests and benchmarks (such as playback startup time, rebuffering, memory, CPU, and frame rate) across a representative range of TV devices, catch regressions before they ship, and help engineers find and fix their root causes.
  • Innovate on how test automation is developed: build frameworks, harnesses, and reusable tooling, and apply AI-assisted approaches that make tests faster to write, easier to maintain, and more trustworthy. Engage with Netflix's test and developer tools teams to bring the latest capabilities into our workflows, and influence their roadmaps toward enhancements that support our testing needs.
  • Build the tools that make realistic end-to-end test scenarios possible, such as utilities to manipulate test streams and services that provide reliable, repeatable test data, and partner with upstream teams to get the hooks and support those scenarios need.
  • Own and improve test metrics (critical scenario coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, and performance baselines), and use them to drive priorities. Drive down flaky tests and known issues, reduce runtime, and retire tests that no longer change a decision.
  • Work closely with teammates who own the build system and CI/CD pipelines so automated tests are integrated as reliable, well-understood quality gates.
  • Support release readiness and live event readiness, clearly communicating quality, performance, and reliability risks and their impact to engineering, product, and release stakeholders, including participating in on-call rotations for player client releases.
  • Validate playback quality and client stability through A/B test variant monitoring and metrics analysis prior to driving full production rollouts.
  • Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values and you make sure every voice on the team is heard.

What Sets You Apart

  • You have deep experience ensuring the quality of consumer web or device applications at scale, and you are highly proficient in JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • You are an engineer first, with the software chops to build test frameworks, harnesses, and tooling from the ground up rather than only consuming what others build.
  • You have a track record of improving how teams write tests, not just writing more of them, and you have applied AI tooling in a testing context to generate tests, triage failures, analyze flakiness, or close coverage gaps.
  • You have hands-on experience with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Spinnaker, or GitHub Actions, and are comfortable debugging the pipelines your tests run in.
  • You are curious about audio and video and how streaming works, including adaptive bitrate streaming, DRM, codecs, and browser media APIs such as MSE and EME.
  • You understand the realities of browser and TV device diversity, and what it takes to prove consistent playback and performance across many device generations and capabilities.
  • You have experience with performance testing and profiling of client applications, ideally on resource-constrained devices, and know how to produce stable, repeatable measurements that reliably catch regressions.
  • You bring an analytical, data-driven approach to identifying root causes, and can reason through the interactions of client, network, and backend in a domain where playback failures are often emergent and hard to reproduce.
  • You have exposure to A/B testing or experimentation workflows.
  • You communicate clearly and build collaboration across boundaries, with player engineers on web and TV, fellow test and release engineers, product managers, and data science partners.

Why Netflix?

  • Collaborate every day with a high performing team that values selflessness, inclusion, and candor.
  • Make your impact on a product loved by hundreds of millions around the world.
  • Work side by side with your team and partners in Los Gatos.
