title: Software Engineer 5 - TV & Web Player
locations: Los Gatos, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is passionate about streaming media security and playback to join the TV & Web Player team. Our team powers the player client engine behind Netflix streaming across hundreds of millions of living room CE devices (such as Smart TVs, STBs, and streaming sticks) and web browsers via www.netflix.com. In this role, you will lead client content protection architecture, design DRM solutions, and secure client-server communications across the entire player client stack. You will manage streaming media content for different streaming modes (Live, Ads, SVOD), extend Digital Rights Management to enforce new content policies, and influence player UX interfaces. You will also partner with cross-functional teams in Streaming Algorithms, Encoding Technologies, Security, Content, and Device Partners to build secure, high-performance playback solutions optimized for memory and QoE.

About the Role:

  • Lead the client content protection architecture and the security aspects of client-server communication across TV & Web player clients.
  • Design, develop and deliver playback foundational capabilities required to support different streaming modes such SVOD, Live and ad-supported viewing, including dynamic ad insertion, across both TV and Web Player Clients.
  • Write design documents, drive them through review with partner teams, and make architecture decisions that hold up as the player, device ecosystem, and product evolve.
  • Own the investigation of complex, hard-to-reproduce playback problems that span the player, device, network, and backend, and fix the underlying cause rather than the symptom.
  • Define and run A/B experiments for new encodes, player behavior, and streaming algorithms. Use the results to decide what ships, and set the experimentation standards for the team.
  • Set and improve playback quality of experience (QoE) targets such as play startup time, rebuffering, and playback error rates, and lead the work to reach them.
  • Rethink and rebuild existing designs where the data shows a better approach, including player components that must run on memory-constrained and low-power TV devices.
  • Partner with UI, Encoding, Streaming Algorithms, Security, Open Connect, and device partner teams to shape product requirements and technical plans.
  • Improve continuous integration, test automation, and release management for the video player so features ship safely at scale.
  • Mentor engineers through code review, design review, and pairing, and help peers grow in scope and technical depth.
  • Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values.

What Sets You Apart:

  • You have deep knowledge of DRM systems and content protection handling for streaming media, with extensive experience in client-server security protocols and adaptive streaming technologies such as MPEG-DASH, HTML5 MSE, and EME.
  • You have 8+ years of software development experience, with expertise in streaming media playback and content protection technologies. Experience with live streaming or Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) is a plus.
  • You have architected content security and player solutions to complex problems in the streaming space and carried them from design through production rollout.
  • You are an expert in TypeScript, Node.js and proficient in C++. You set the bar for code quality and maintainability on your team.
  • You have a solid understanding of networking protocols HTTP, TCP, UDP and WebSockets and transport security mechanisms.
  • You have designed experiments, analyzed the data, and used it to improve streaming quality and to influence decisions beyond your own team.
  • You have shipped software at scale and developed software for Smart TVs, set-top boxes, or streaming sticks.
  • You have grown and mentored other engineers, and peers seek you out for design feedback and technical judgment.
  • You go deeper to find root causes, and you can reason through client, network, and backend interactions in a domain where playback failures are often hard to reproduce.
  • You communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineers, product managers, data science partners, and leadership, and you build collaboration across team boundaries.
  • You are curious, self-motivated, selfless, and seek other perspectives to improve your ideas.

descriptionHtml:

We strive to understand the underlying needs, motivations, and emotions that drive love for our content, so we can help Netflix continue creating stories and experiences that excite members around the world. 


The Innovation & Scale pod is a newly formed group that brings together a team of senior ICs. As the Senior Manager of this new pod, you will lead Researchers, Data Scientists, and Analytics Engineers who both pioneer new ways of understanding audiences and turn proven approaches into durable, scaled programs. The pod’s portfolio spans Netflix Preview Club (our internal content screening program), viewership analysis for our biggest titles, and robust audience understanding. This role requires a strong bias to action, diverse methodological expertise, experience building scalable tools, and a deep passion for entertainment and decoding consumer attitudes and behaviors.  


What you will do:

  • Set the vision and roadmap for Innovation & Scale, balancing bets on new methods with the discipline to scale what works.

  • Extensive mixed methods experience (10+ years).  A mix of data science and quantitative research experience is a must (experience with qualitative research is a nice bonus).

  • An analytical mindset; you love digging into data for hidden connections and patterns, and know how to balance analytical rigor with pragmatism and actionability.

title: Technical Director Pre Production
locations: Burbank, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

The Opportunity:


The Pre-Production Technical Director is responsible for supporting creative and visual objectives through pipeline troubleshooting, user support, technical direction, and tool development for front-end craft groups, including Story, Edit, Art, Concept, Design, Visual Development, and Previs. As a technical expert, the Pre-Production Technical Director exhibits a deep understanding of processes, technology, and tools within these domains. They contribute technical expertise to the design and development of artist workflows and tools, ensuring that the pre-production process is efficient and integrated with the overall production pipeline. 


What You’ll Do:


Technical Responsibilities: 

  • Understand the visual requirements for productions and suggest new technologies, or design procedures, techniques, and tools to meet these requirements. 
  • Provide technical expertise and guidance for all technology within the Pre-Production department. 
  • Contribute to the direction, evolution, and maintenance of the technology within the Pre-Production Department. 
  • Design, develop, and write well-maintainable and consistently high-quality code. 
  • Track and resolve the most complex technical issues within Pre-Production in partnership with other TDs and Software Engineers. 
  • Work closely with other TDs and Software Engineers within Pre-Production to drive the technical success of key development initiatives. 
  • Ensure that technology, tools, and procedures within the Pre-Production Craft Group support the creative process. 
  • Provide solutions to visual problems through existing tools or by leading the implementation of new tools. 
  • Take responsibility for the troubleshooting and optimization of Pre-Production tools, software, and workflows. 
  • Actively drive the QA, technical testing, and validation of new technology, tool releases, or pipeline changes, ensuring artist workflow is not impacted. 
  • Understand the processes of adjoining departments and provide input where required to maximize pipeline efficiency and quality. 
  • Actively participate in brainstorming and problem-solving, contributing technical expertise and insight to create and maintain technology within the canonical production pipeline. 
  • Support the organization’s overall technical goals as required.

Bidding & Scheduling Responsibilities: 

  • Be aware of the deadlines for own development initiatives and actively engage in keeping these on track. 
  • Continuously monitor the scope of the most technically challenging development initiatives within the Pre-Production department and help to ensure scope adjustments have additional estimates, etc. 
  • Prioritize and break down technical projects into organized parts. 
  • Work with the Supervising TD to prepare estimates and pitches as required.

Talent & Performance Management Responsibilities: 

  • Work with the Supervising TD for Front-End to provide technical guidance to Pre-Production TDs with day-to-day issues and escalate through the right channels when necessary. 
  • Work with Technology Talent Management and Supervising TDs to help further develop the skills and abilities of mid-level TDs within the Front End Craft Group. 
  • Mentor mid-level TDs within the team and assist in orientation with senior new starters. 
  • Create synergies between different work groups to promote efficiency and optimization and to generate innovative ideas and approaches to how we do things.

Communication Collaboration & Relationship Development Responsibilities: 

  • Strong communication skills for technical ideas, project status, problems, requirements, rollout plans, etc. 
  • Able to communicate with Program Managers to contribute to the scheduling and planning of complex technology initiatives. 
  • Able to discuss complex issues with Senior Software Engineers, developers, and supervisors. 
  • Able to present to small teams (tool demos, Show Contract process, Support Dashboards, etc.). 
  • Good written communication skills for specs, tickets, status updates, etc.

Behaviours: 

  • Takes a collaborative approach, always working towards team goals and success.
  • Is artist-focused, passionate about improving the artist experience and workflow.
  • Acts as a proactive contributor, eager to learn and help the team succeed.
  • Stays supportive and approachable, fostering a friendly and open environment.
  • Is detail-oriented, ensuring high standards in all work.
  • Remains trustworthy and reliable in all responsibilities. 

What You’ll Need:

  • Relevant education in software engineering and/or film creation process.
  • 5+ years of proven pipeline TD experience in large-scale animated features, animated TV series, games and/or VFX feature films.
  • Proven technical achievements within feature animation or VFX.
  • An understanding of traditional techniques appropriate to the Pre-Production craft group. 
  • Comprehensive experience using and troubleshooting in relevant software such as Maya, Flix, Avid, Storyboard Pro, Premiere, Photoshop, and other related software used in the Pre-Production domain. 
  • Comprehensive understanding of technical details within the Pre-Production department. 
  • Ability to code review and troubleshoot problems as they arise. 
  • Expert knowledge in Python as well as PyQt or another GUI toolkit. 
  • Knowledge of concepts like data flow, data dependencies, metadata, publishing, and retrieval. 
  • Solid understanding of C++ is a plus. A strong understanding of USD and its general concepts. 
  • Knowledge of Flow Production Tracking (ShotGrid). 
  • Knowledge of code management software such as git and GitHub and code review processes. 
  • Knowledge of software development practices such as Agile and how to apply them in software such as Jira. 
  • Degree in Animation, Film, Computer Science, Design, Engineering, Math, or Physics, or equivalent combination of education and work experience in animation/VFX.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) power the innovation in all areas of the business, including helping members choose the right title for them through personalization, better understanding our audience and our content slate, creating high-quality subtitles, dubbings, images, trailers, and other assets, optimize our payment processing, and much more. The  Online Serving and Inference team builds and maintains the infrastructure that enables ML practitioners to run their large-scale online serving and inference workflows to deploy AI models for Netflix member scale ecosystems. The team is responsible for the common framework to develop and deploy AI/ML models in Netflix infrastructure to power the AI applications and features. 


We are looking for an experienced AI/ML infrastructure engineering leader to lead the development of our next-generation serving and inference platform! You will lead this team to architect, design, develop, test, and launch a brand-new platform to enable ML practitioners across the content, studio, consumer, ads, and games domains to effortlessly package, deploy, and execute inference workflows for thousands of large-scale models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), computer vision and foundation models. title: Sales Solutions Specialist (EMEA - Emerging Business)
locations: London, United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About the team

The Sales Solutions Team serves as a strategic overlay to client sales, agency sales and account management teams, specializing in client technology integrations, audience-driven media strategies, and media sales across partner, agency and client-direct segments. The team acts as the programmatic and automation ambassador across Sales.

The Emerging Business team is the home for demand that sits outside our top segments, across mid and long tail. We activate, fulfil and accelerate business with channel partners (resellers, aggregators, sales houses), advertisers and agencies, then scale that investment through long-term strategic partnerships. We work closely with DSPs and other AdTech partners, driving proactive outbound sales through co-business development, enablement and automation.


About the Role

We are scaling the Emerging Business team in EMEA and are looking for a commercially driven Sales Solutions Specialist with deep industry experience — someone who operates with autonomy and initiative, like a segment owner. This is a senior role that requires a balance of commercial, strategic and technical acumen.

You will be accountable for driving revenue growth across the segment and will be the primary commercial contact for a large and heterogeneous portfolio of advertisers, agencies and channel partners.

You will unlock advertisers we don't reach today through partnerships, collaborating externally with DSPs, AdTech providers, channel partners and agencies, and internally across the wider organisation. Once new customers are onboarded, you will own the commercial cycle end to end: pitch, upsell, retention and renewal.

You will also build the machine: creating and optimising processes so that, as automation takes on more of the tactical workload, your time goes where it unlocks the most incremental revenue. This is equal parts execution and architecture — hands-on daily, while thinking long-term about how we grow and scale your market(s) and the wider segment.

The right person brings strong strategic sales acumen, the ability to engage senior stakeholders up to C-level, and programmatic expertise. You're used to managing large portfolios of strategic advertisers, you make data-driven decisions, and you have the judgment to prioritise ruthlessly in a fast-moving context. You're comfortable with ambiguity, proactive about surfacing what's working and what isn't, and energised by building something new.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of advertisers and partners at scale, using data to monitor performance and to decide where human attention creates the most value and where automation can be leveraged.
  • Proactively identify high-potential clients and partners and grow the business to meet or exceed revenue and product targets, driving client satisfaction, renewal and retention.

Strong knowledge of data clean room technologies and privacy-first audience activation with firsthand experience leveraging at least one of Snowflake, AWS, Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC).

Member Foundations DE builds the core datasets that represent how members interact with the Netflix Product. The team joins those client events with the algorithm and experiment data behind each member's page, and turns the results into the core information that powers analytics, data science, and product decisions for our members at Netflix.


Member Innovation DE works in close partnership with Data Scientists and Product Managers to support new innovation on the Netflix Product, from ideation to production. Much of its work supports A/B tests and product priorities: client logging, data modeling, Spark ETL, and data validation for new features, canvases, and content types. The team builds lower-latency pipelines for learning and analytics, so partners can read results on a new feature before the core datasets catch up.


The two teams run at different speeds. Foundations builds for scale, engineering rigor, and strong data quality guarantees. Innovation moves at the pace of product testing. This role owns how the two find success individually and within the wider Member organization.


To be successful in this role, you need to be a strong leader capable of operating at an extremely high bar and across high talent density. You grow senior engineers into leaders, keep two teams delivering when deadlines and priorities conflict, and earn the trust of senior partners in Product, Data Science, and Engineering. You also need a strong background in data engineering and a sharp product sense.


Responsibilities

  • Set the technical and strategic directions for both teams, ensuring they are tied to the larger Member DSE and Data & Insights priorities. Own the near-term plan and the bets that pay off a year or more out, from efficiency gains to new data capabilities for the Member  Data Products org.
  • Lead the engineers on both teams directly. Grow senior engineers into technical leads who own a domain end to end, so either team can take on more scope without you in the middle. Give people room to fail and learn.
  • Decide where work and headcount sit across the two teams. When priorities or structure change, coach your teams and lead them through it.
  • Make the hard trade-off calls between the teams, stakeholders, and competing priorities. Lead with context, not control, by explaining your reasoning so the people affected understand it, and stand behind the call.
  • Bring both teams into partner strategy and roadmap discussions early, while priorities are still forming. Build relationships with leaders up to the Senior Director level across Member Product, Data Science, and Engineering.
  • Set one engineering bar for both teams, including shared client-logging standards, strong accountability, and data-quality guarantees partners can rely on. That means data products built with engineering rigor, pipelines that stay performant as scale grows, and data quality guarantees partners can rely on. Invest in the tooling and patterns that make the bar easier to hit, and replace the ones that stop working.
  • Make AI an accelerator for the teams. Decide where it pays off most, from building and migrating pipelines to data validation, debugging, and documentation, and set what great looks like over the next 6, 12, and 18 months. Keep engineers accountable for what they ship, and judge progress through delivery speed and quality.
  • Hire senior engineers and leaders who make the teams stronger. Hold high talent density and the keeper test expectations across both teams.
  • Spend meaningful time outside your own teams on Data & Insights initiatives, hiring for peer teams, and upleveling the wider data engineering community.

Skills & Characteristics

  • You are a strong people leader who also demonstrates humility. You care deeply about people and their success, and you invest in your relationships so you understand each person as a whole and their perspective.
  • You handle the hardest people situations well, including escalated feedback and keeper test decisions, and you coach your teams through their own.
  • You spot barriers to collaboration and likely conflict between teams early, and you resolve them directly with the people involved.
  • You lead with business and product judgment and back it with technical depth. You keep process light.
  • You are comfortable without a spec. Nobody will hand these teams a list of what to build, so you form your own view of the durable investments and make the case for them.
  • You have strong opinions and act on them. You have made big bets, been wrong on some, and can say what you learned.
  • You use AI in your own work every day. You know where it can be trusted in data engineering and where it can't, and you can tell real leverage from hype.
  • You're allergic to micromanagement. You lead through your engineers: give context, delegate, and let strong people run their domains.
  • You write and speak clearly for senior audiences, and you are self-aware about how others hear and perceive you.

Preferred Requirements

  • You have 10+ years of experience in data engineering or similar distributed systems skillset, with a strong programming background (at least one major language) and SQL.
  • You have 8+ years of engineering leadership experience, including leading multiple data engineering teams.
  • You have a proven track record of strong business intuition, product sense, and analytics.
  • You have developed managers, either by growing engineers into the role or by coaching new managers through their first year.
  • You have worked in a technical role at a large-scale, consumer-facing digital company that uses A/B tests to make product decisions.
  • You have experience with large-scale client logging events and with measuring product experiments.
  • You have deep experience with distributed data processing (Spark, Flink) and data at a very large scale (PBs). You can go deep on design and architecture with senior engineers without needing to be hands-on day to day.
  • You have a MS in Computer Science/Engineering, or related field.

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


Job Overview

We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test who is passionate about quality and about mobile playback to join the Android Player team. This team owns everything about playback in the Netflix Android app outside of the UI, from streaming and offline downloads to the foundations that live events and ad-supported viewing are built on. You will own how we prove that playback works, across thousands of Android devices, on a client that ships every week. Right now that means deepening automation coverage for live and advertising, keeping a shared device lab fast and honest, and making test results a signal the team trusts enough to block a merge or a release on.


About the role

  • Own the Android Player test strategy, deciding what gets verified at the unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and which tests earn the right to block a pull request or a release.
  • Build the automation frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure that make that coverage possible, not just the tests that run on top of them.
  • Grow automated coverage for live events and ad-supported playback, where defects in the field carry the most risk and where test infrastructure is still maturing.
  • Treat the device lab as the finite, shared resource it is, making deliberate choices about device coverage so suites stay fast and lab time goes where it buys the most signal.
  • Drive down flakiness and runtime, and retire tests that no longer change a decision.
  • Support release readiness and live event readiness for a client that ships every week, including participation in the on-call rotation behind live gating.
  • Raise the quality bar across the whole team through code review, mentorship, and influence, so that testability is designed in rather than added later.
  • Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values.

What sets you apart

  • You have deep experience ensuring the quality of consumer Android applications at scale, with real depth in Kotlin, Java, and the Android SDK.
  • You are an engineer first, with the software chops to build test frameworks, harnesses, and CI tooling from the ground up rather than only consuming what others build.
  • You test at every layer of the stack, not just end-to-end UI automation, and you use judgment to put each test where it belongs across unit, Robolectric, integration, screenshot, and on-device suites.
  • You are curious about audio and video and how streaming works, including adaptive streaming, DRM, codecs, hardware and software decode, and player frameworks such as ExoPlayer.
  • You know the Android device ecosystem first-hand, including the range of hardware capabilities across SoCs and OEMs, and what it takes to prove consistent playback across many device generations and price points.
  • You have applied AI tooling in a testing context, using it to generate tests, triage failures, analyze flakiness, or close coverage gaps, and you bring that experience to quality problems rather than waiting for tools to be handed to you.
  • You are comfortable drawing the line between what should be automated and what should stay manual, and you defend that line with data and judgment rather than dogma.
  • You are a systems thinker who can reason through the interactions of client, network, and backend, in a domain where playback failures are often emergent and hard to reproduce.
  • You communicate clearly and build collaboration across boundaries, with UI counterparts, fellow Player engineers on iOS and TV, product managers, and data science partners.

Why Netflix?

  • Collaborate every day with a high performing team that values selflessness, inclusion, and candor.

Role Summary


The Creative Talent Engagement & Development (CTED) Administrative Assistant serves as a key support role for the CTED Director and team, handling essential administrative and logistical tasks. This role is responsible for the day-to-day coordination of calendars, meetings, travel, documentation, and internal systems to ensure smooth operations, allowing the team to focus on strategic programs and partnerships.


Key Responsibilities


Executive & Team Support

  • Manage calendars for the Director and Senior Manager, including scheduling, meeting prep, and ensuring adequate spacing and focus time.
  • Coordinate the CTED team calendar, including recurring meetings, cross-functional check-ins, and key program milestones.
  • Creating and maintaining itineraries.
    • Including agendas, note-keeping, etc.
  • Arrange travel for the Director (and team members as needed), including flights, hotels, and transportation
  • Prepare and submit expense reports for the Director and team PCard, ensuring timely and accurate reconciliation.
    • Source and maintain receipts, etc. 

Administrative & Office Operations

  • Monitor the CTED team email inbox; triage, respond to, and route inquiries to the appropriate team members.
  • Receive and delegate incoming requests from the General Inquiry Form Airtable to the right owner.
  • Greet and host external colleagues and partners during office visits, ensuring a professional and welcoming experience.
  • Assist with team event planning and logistics (e.g., internal offsites, team meetings, retreats), including assembling swag bags when needed.

Vendor, Finance & Systems Support

  • Support onboarding of vendors/suppliers to internal systems (e.g., Supplier Hub), working closely with FPO.
  • Assist with submitting and tracking invoices (program-related and non-program-related) and following up with vendors to confirm payment.
  • Partner with the team to ensure costs and expenses are properly coded and routed to the appropriate budgets.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Keep the CTED team shared folder on Google Drive organized and up to date, ensuring that each program has a current memo and documentation in its respective folder.
    • Generate folders as needed
    • Maintain up-to-date documentation
      • (e.g. file naming conventions, folder structure, filing new documents, updating sharing permissions)
    • Archive documentation as needed
  • Maintain and update the internal CTED Google Site with relevant resources, updates, and links
  • Support general up-keep of team Airtable databases in conjunction with team Coordinators.

What You Bring

  • Experience as an administrative or executive assistant, ideally supporting multiple executives at once.
  • Genuine passion and curiosity for workforce development, talent access, and/or program management, specifically in the tech/entertainment space.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite (Gmail, Gchat, Calendar, Docs, Slides, Sheets), Slack, and Airtable.
  • Advanced proficiency with Claude Cowork (including custom skill deployment) and Chat GPT Team Enterprise.
  • Strong time-management skills with a high comfort level for ambiguity and change.
  • Maintain total confidentiality regarding business operations, data, and internal strategy.
  • Positive and supportive attitude, providing white-glove service to both internal and external partners and guests.
  • Previous experience in entertainment is highly preferred, but not required.

title: Technical Director PaFX (Houdini) - Netflix Animation Studios
locations: Sydney, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Netflix Animation Studios is on a mission to entertain the world with bold, immersive animated films that are timeless and impactful. We are paving the way for the future of animation by building a community of amazing artists and talent across three vibrant locations globally. Come join us!

Job Summary


The Procedural Asset and FX Technical Director is a Houdini TD responsible for supporting all teams that use Sidefx Houdini. They work with the front-end assets team, such as Surfacing and Modelling, and also back end shot-based teams: Fx, Character-fx, Crowds, and Matte Painting.


They assist creative and visual objectives through pipeline troubleshooting, user support, technical direction, and tool development. The TD will participate in the development of artist workflows and tools for projects and debug problematic workflow steps to support global studio productions in that area. The TD will work closely with their craft groups and show leadership, the Solutions Engineering and R&D teams to enable high-quality technical outcomes and a standardized approach.


What You’ll Do


  • Provide technical expertise and guidance for Houdini and USD technology for the departments they support.
  • Understand the visual requirements for productions and propose new technologies, or design procedures, techniques, and tools to ensure those needs are met.
  • Provide technical expertise and guidance for technology within the PAFX department.
  • Participate in or lead the direction, evolution & maintenance of technology within the PAFX department.
  • Design, develop, review and write well-maintainable, production level and consistently high-quality code.
  • Track, debug, and resolve workflow issues in partnership with technical supervisors, associate technical supervisors, solutions engineers, and R&D.
  • Work closely with other TD’s on the team to drive the technical success of key development initiatives.
  • Communicate clearly, via instant messaging systems like Slack, to proactively report on issues that may affect others, provide updates on software releases, and offer assistance to other team members.
  • Ensure that technology, tools, and procedures support the creative process.
  • Provide solutions to visual problems through existing tools or by leading the implementation of new tools.
  • Take responsibility for the troubleshooting & optimization of the tools, software, and workflows of the PAFX department.
  • Actively participate in or drive QA, technical testing, and validation of new technology, tool releases, or pipeline changes such that artist workflow is not impacted.
  • Understand the processes of adjoining departments and provide input where required to maximize pipeline efficiency and quality.
  • Actively participate in brainstorming and problem-solving, contributing technical expertise and insight, to create and maintain technology within the canonical production pipeline.
  • Support the organization's overall technical goals as required.
  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly present work to stakeholders, actively gather feedback, and incorporate it into technical solutions.
  • Be aware of the deadlines for development initiatives and actively engage in keeping these on track.
  • Continuously monitor the scope of development initiatives and help to ensure scope adjustments have additional estimates, etc.
  • Prioritize and break down technical projects into organized parts and describe them in Jira
  • Provide technical guidance to other TDs and TAs, where appropriate, with day-to-day issues and escalation through the right channels when necessary.
  • Mentor junior team members and assist in orientation with new starters.
  • Create synergies between different work groups to promote efficiency and optimization and to generate innovative ideas and approaches to how we do things

What You’ll Need


Experience:

  • 5+ years of proven pipeline TD experience in large-scale animated features, animated TV series, the gaming industry, and/or VFX feature films.
  • Solid production/industry experience as a TD, ideally as part of a team.

Skills/Knowledge:

  • Comprehensive Houdini experience with using and troubleshooting procedural node-based workflows.
  • A strong understanding of USD and its general concepts, including Houdini’s Solaris/LOP context.
  • Proven ability to design and build production-ready Houdini Digital Assets (HDAs) to simplify artist workflows and abstract complex operations.
  • An understanding of traditional techniques appropriate to Assets (Surfacing, hair and feather grooming, lookdev, procedural vegetation, or environment modelling)
  • Good knowledge of shot-based simulation craft groups such as FX, Character-FX, Crowd and Matte-Painting and appropriate techniques they may use.
  • Expertise in configuring and customizing the Houdini environment for production use.
  • Practical experience in developing custom user interfaces using Python (PySide/PyQt).
  • Knowledge of version control software such as git, as well as the ability to code review and troubleshoot problems as they arise in GitHub.
  • Knowledge in Python as well as PyQt or another GUI toolkit.
  • Knowledge of concepts like data flow, data dependencies, metadata, publishing, and retrieval.
  • Knowledge of Flow Production Tracking (Shotgrid).
  • Knowledge of software development practices such as Agile and how to apply them in software such as Jira.
  • Degree in Animation, Film, Computer Science, Design, Engineering, Math or Physics, or equivalent combination of education & work experience in animation/VFX.
  • Knowledge of other DCCs such as Maya, Nuke and/or similar software in the animation domain is a plus.
  • A basic understanding of C++ is a plus.

This role is based in Sydney, New South Wales. Hybrid Role (Minimum requirement of 3 days a week in the office).

title: Senior Manager, Data Systems, AIMS
locations: Remote, United States
descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


We’re looking for a Senior Manager to lead the AIMS Data Systems team, which builds the web-scale datasets and systems behind personalization, recommendations, and product optimization. The team collects, processes, and attributes signals from member interactions, content, and business operations, turning them into trusted data that improves the member experience.


You’ll set strategic and technical direction for large-scale batch and streaming pipelines. You’ll ensure that data is accurate, timely, well-documented, and trusted by product, data science, ML, and engineering partners. As a senior leader, you’ll hire and develop strong engineers, set priorities across competing needs, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. You’ll balance near-term delivery with a long-term platform strategy, modernizing core data pipelines and schemas while keeping downstream consumers stable.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop a team building the ingestion, processing, and attribution systems behind engagement, content, and business data.
  • Set the roadmap and technical direction for batch and streaming data platforms, in partnership with product, data science, ML, and engineering teams.
  • Deliver reliable, timely, and well-documented data for model training, evaluation, and decision systems.
  • Establish standards for data quality, observability, lineage, and operational reliability across critical datasets.
  • Partner with measurement and experimentation teams to improve attribution methods and validate them against causal evidence.
  • Modernize core pipelines and schemas while maintaining stable contracts for downstream users.
  • Build self-service tools and clear data contracts that make trusted data easier to discover and use.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years in data engineering, data platforms, or analytics engineering, including 3+ years managing engineers or technical teams.
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale batch and streaming pipelines, such as Spark, Flink, Kafka, Iceberg, and Airflow or similar orchestration.
  • Experience owning user event and engagement data end to end: instrumentation, schema design and evolution, ingestion, and data quality.
  • Working knowledge of attribution concepts, such as joining exposures and outcomes, sessionization, and deduplication.
  • Track record of setting technical direction, prioritizing across competing stakeholders, and delivering multi-quarter roadmaps.
  • Strong communication skills with product, data science, and engineering partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data systems that feed behavioral signals back into personalization, recommendation, or machine learning models.
  • Deep attribution experience, including multi-touch or incrementality-aware approaches, and the tradeoffs between rules-based and model-based methods.
  • Experience with data contracts, lineage, observability, and SLAs for business-critical datasets.
  • Familiarity with ML data needs, such as feature stores, label generation, training-data freshness, and feedback-loop risks.
  • Experience building or scaling a platform used by many internal teams, including self-service tooling.
  • Background in streaming, media, or consumer subscription products at global scale.
  • Comfort with privacy and governance constraints on user-level data, such as consent, retention, and regional rules.
  • Experience hiring, developing, and retaining senior and staff engineers, and managing through ambiguity.

The communications team at Netflix is hiring a Specialist to support our Ads, Partnerships, and Marketing organizations and help drive compelling external narratives about our business. 


For Ads: The Netflix Ads plan provides members with optionality and helps drive revenue for the business. Our Ads team is focused on bringing the plan to more members around the world, working with advertisers to connect their brands to our broad and highly engaged audience, and improving our ads experience (for both members and advertisers alike).  This position will help tell the story of our advertising business externally and how Netflix partners with brands across the service.

As we continue to build compelling creative-driven campaigns, this position will serve as a lead on managing partner PR requests, driving compelling narrative plans for Netflix and securing high-impact coverage for the business. 


Our ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, a strong communicator, and a relationship builder, who can be a trusted partner and adviser to teams across multiple disciplines. This role will create and manage communications strategies, including pitches, announcements, and executive comms (closely partnering with our Ads and Marketing senior leaders).  They will also streamline Netflix’s internal and external B2B narrative across materials, and serve as a strong press representative for Netflix’s business. 


Key to this role is being creative and proactive, making wise decisions, and exercising sound judgment even when faced with ambiguity. Additionally, the role requires a collaborative team player who is resourceful, optimistic, and solution-oriented.

The Procurement Legal team is looking for an experienced contracts manager to handle a wide array of responsibilities related to vendors and technology across Netflix. The Procurement Legal team at Netflix is a unit of contract managers, coordinators and project managers who provide efficient, effective, and risk-calibrated deal guidance and contract negotiation support to the corporate, studio, games, and product organizations. 


The Role


As a Contracts Manager, you will work with diverse legal and cross-functional teams and play a critical role supporting and managing vendor deals across the globe. With a curious mindset, you'll continuously seek innovative solutions to enhance our processes and drive efficiency. Your ability to work proactively and independently under tight timeframes will be essential as you manage contracts in a dynamic environment. Success in this role requires adaptability and drive to excel in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and integrity. If you're ready to contribute to our success and grow with our team, we encourage you to apply. Responsibilities include:


  • Collaborate with a team of attorneys and contract managers to manage vendor agreements worldwide;
  • Independently structure, draft and negotiate vendor agreements, including data processing agreements and security requirements, ensuring alignment with Netflix standards, industry norms and deal context;
  • Establish and maintain strong internal relationships with cross-functional partners; 
  • Clearly and succinctly communicate solutions to internal business clients;
  • Efficiently resolve issues without causing delays, adapting to the fast-paced nature of Netflix;
  • Contribute to team policies, practices and workflows; 
  • Optimize and support contract and workflow systems; 
  • Create and maintain information on our internal legal portal;
  • Support the team on ad hoc matters and special projects outside core responsibilities as priorities require.

descriptionHtml:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix is seeking a Senior Manager to join the Games Content Acquisitions & Licensing (GCAL) team, a strategic execution arm of Netflix Games. GCAL is responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and securing the 1st Party (1P), 2nd Party (2P), and 3rd Party (3P) game content and licensing deals that bring each Vertical GM’s portfolio strategy to life. This is a high-impact role focused on building a differentiated catalogue of games through partnerships with world-class developers, publishers, and IP holders.


This is a unique opportunity to contribute to one of Netflix’s fastest-growing businesses by driving key strategic deals across cloud and mobile. You will help define what it means to play “only on Netflix,” with a particular emphasis on generative AI-driven game content and on transmedia experiences that deepen fandom for Netflix IP. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional colleagues to source high-fidelity PC and console quality games, live service and mobile games and entertainment IP licensing opportunities.


As a business development leader, you will source, evaluate, negotiate, and close complex commercial agreements that balance creative ambition with business value. You will build deep, trusted relationships with top-tier partners, and you will work closely with Vertical GMs, the Transmedia team, and the broader Games organization to ensure every deal reflects Netflix’s portfolio priorities and ladders up to our mission of bringing joy to members through innovation, accessibility, and unforgettable play.


Responsibilities

  • Source, negotiate, and secure high-impact game content partnerships in service of Vertical GM portfolio strategies, with a secondary focus on generative AI-driven content and Transmedia-aligned titles.
  • Partner with Transmedia and relevant cross-functional teams to secure globally recognizable IP and top-tier talent for 1P and 2P titles that strengthen the connection between Netflix stories and play.
  • Pursue partners who embrace generative AI as a creative force, from adaptive worlds and personalized narratives to procedural design and smarter development pipelines.

  • Analyze markets and turn insights into actionable sourcing plans, using member data and platform trends in collaboration with our Finance and Strategy team to inform both proactive and reactive sourcing.
  • Structure deals that are creatively aligned and commercially sound, and ensure a seamless hand-off from deal close to production.
  • Stay agile and execute across a quickly evolving range of products.
  • Champion the voice of game developers internally, bringing their needs and ambitions into every deal, policy, and platform decision.
  • Seed long-lead, platform-defining opportunities, while staying responsive to emerging player behaviors and market trends.

  • Deep experience in strategic negotiations and deal structuring, including complex contract terms and the legal and business issues behind them, with a track record of closing high-value game and entertainment IP partnerships and crafting creative solutions that work for all sides.
  • Highly attuned product sense and a strong background evaluating game content across platforms.
  • Knowledge of current and developing industry trends in the Games market, including awareness of competitors and new business opportunities.
  • Familiarity with generative AI in game development and a strong point of view on where it is headed.
